gangaṃ*/ ba lang chos can/ khyod kyi don byed nus pa de khyod kyi spyi gsal gnyis kyi nang nas gsal ba kho na la yod de/ khyod don gnyer gyi skyes bu de khyod spyi gsal gnyis kyi nang nas khyod kyi gsal ba kho na la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'jug tshul spyi gnyis yod med bshad pa ni/ ldogaṃ ba gsal chos can/ khyod la ba lang gi gzhan sel ba'i spyi yod de/ khyod ba lang min pa las log pa'i phyir ro// de chos can/ khyod la spyi dngos po ba med de/ khyod la spyi dngos po ba yod na/ dkar zal don gnyer gyi skyes bu nag sgur la 'jug par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de yis 'dzem med pa yang khegs pa la gnyis te/ rigs pa snga (57) mas khegs pa bstan/ 'gog byed rigs pa gzhan yang bstan pa'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ rang bdag tha dad rigs pas khegs/ 'jug pa 'chol ba'i rigs pas khegs pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ grangs can pa dngos po thams cad rang bzhin gcig pa 'dod pa dgag pa'i rigs pa de chos can/ gcer bu pas zho rnga gnyis po rang bzhin gcig tu 'dod pa'i log rtog kyang bsal ba yin te/ zho rnga gnyis po rang bzhin tha dad par ston pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ thamasaṃ/ zho rnga re re'ang gnyis ka'i rang bzhin yin na zho don gnyer gyi skyes bu chos can/ rnga mo thung ba la rgyu rigs par thal/ zho 'thung ba la rgyug rigs pa gang zhig de gnyis rang bzhin gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'oṃn/ gal te skyon med de/ kha dog dkar ba dang*/ 'o ma'i rnam 'gyur sogs khyad par gang gis zho 'thung ba la rgyug rigs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ zho chos can/ khyod zho rnga gnyis ka min par rnga mo las gzhan yin par thal/ kha dog dkar ba dang 'o ma'i rnam 'gyur de khyod kyi khyad chos yin/ rnga mo'i khyad chos min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ thamaṃs/ zho rnga gnyis po chos can/ sgra rtog tha dad du 'jug par mi 'gyur bar thal/ rang bzhin gcig yin pa'i phyir/

khyab pa ni/ sgra rtog yul dngos dbang gis 'jug par 'dod pa khas blangs pas so// 'dod na/ de chos can/ gnas skabs tha dad yin par mi srid par thal/ gnas skabs tha dad yin par nges pa'i blo med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dngos med gzhan sel sgra'i sgo nas bshad pa ni/ dngoṃs/ dngos med chos can/ khyod ces brjod pa'i sgras khyod kyi dngos po brjod pa min (58) te/ khyod dngos por med pa'i phyir/ des na dngos med ces pa'i sgra chos can/ sel 'jug tu grub ste/ sel 'jug dang sgrub 'jug gang rung gang zhig sgrub 'jug min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa nges gzhi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa la gnyis te/ khyad par dag ltos gnyis su dbye// dag pa ba la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ 'o na sngar bshad pa'i bdag gcig gi 'brel pa nges pa'i gzhir rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs de ji lta bu zhe na/ raṃng*/ rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs yang dag chos can/ khyod la gnyis su yod de/ khyod la khyad par ba la ltos pa'i rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs dang*/ khyad par ba la ma ltos pa'i rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ byas pa chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i khyad par la ltos pa'i rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/ khyod kyis de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod zhes brjod pa'i sgra las khyod go ba khyod kyi khyad par byed chos go ba la ltos pa'i phyir/ dngos po chos can du bzung nas snga ma de las ldog pa dgod/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ dngos po de sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag tu rung na/ de gtso bo yod par sgrub pa'i bsgrub bya'i chos su rung bar mtshungs shing*/ gal te yod tsam gtso bo'i steng du sgrub pa la shes 'dod med cing*/ yod pa khyad par ba dpe la rjes 'gro med pas bsgrub bya'i chos su mi rung na gtan tshigs la'ang mtshungs so zhe na/

gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ bsgrub byar gzung na bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid med// rtags su gzung na (59) gtan tshigs mtshan nyid tshang*/ bsgrub byar gzung na sgrub byed yang dag med/ rtags su gzung na bsgrub bya'i go byed yin pa'o// dang po ni/ yod pa sgrub bya'i chos yin na yod tsam yin nam/ rtags rdzas yod yin/ dang po ltar na/ yodaṃ/ gtso bo'i sgra don yod tsam chos can/ khyod gzhan don bsgrub bya yang dag min te/ khyod sngar rgol la zhe 'dod med cing*/ phyir rgol gyis grub zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ khyadaṃ/ gtso bo'i sgra don rtags rdzas su yod pa chos can/ khyod gzhan don bsgrub bya yang dag min te/ khyod sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs de chos mthun gyi dpe la rjes su 'gro ba med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chos la gnyis su phye na gtan tshigs la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ deṃ'i/ dngos po chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ maṃ/ gtso bo'i sgra don rtags dngos su yod pa chos can/ khyod gzhan don bsgrub bya yang dag min par thal/ khyod sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yin na 'gal ma nges ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs gsum po gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ yod pa gtan tshigs su byas pa la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ raṃng*/ dngos po chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag tu rung ste/ khyod kyi rtags kyis de skor gyi tshul gsum nges pa srid pa'i phyir/ dper na sgra mi rtag sgrub la byas pa rtags su bkod pa bzhin no// gsum pa nges byed ltos med kyi gtan tshigs bshad pa

(60) la gnyis te/ mthun dpe'i steng du rigs pa ston/ rigs pa de nyid gzhan la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gtan tshigs 'god/ phyogs chos bsgrub/ grub don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i rang bzhin gtan tshigs gnyis la bdag gcig gi 'brel pa ji ltar nges par bya zhe na/ rgyu/ bum pa chos can/ grub tsam nas 'jig pa'i ngo bor nges te/ rang rgyu las phyis 'byung ba'i rgyu don gzhan la ltos pa med par rang rgyu las 'jig par skyes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ha cang thal bas bsgrub/ rang rgyud rtags kyis bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ gtan tshigs ma grub bo zhe na/ dngoṃs/ bum pa chos can/ 'jig pa min par thal/ rang gi 'jig pa rang rgyu las tho ba sogs rgyu gzhan la ltos pa dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gal te 'jig rgyu mang po yod pas skyon med do zhe na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod dang mi 'jig pa'i gzhi mthun srid par thal/ khyod 'jig rgyu tho ba sogs dang ma phrad pa srid pa'i phyir/ deṃs/ 'jig rgyu tho ba sogs chos can/ khyod bum pa 'jig nges su sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min par thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis bum pa 'jig nges su sgrub pa'i khyab pa 'khrul pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ bum pa chos can/ rang nyid 'jig pa rang rgyu las phyis 'byung ba'i rgyu gzhan la ltos pa med de/ phyis 'byung gi rgyu des rang gi 'jig pa skyed pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'diṃ/ mthong ba'i bum sogs chos can/ 'jig pa'i ngo bor nges te/ rgyu med kyi gtan tshigs dgod/ gnyis pa ni/ (61) gangaṃ*/ mthong ba'i bum sogs las gzhan pa'i byas yod chos can/ grub tsam nas 'jig nges yin te/ gtan tshigs 'dra/ gsum pa 'brel ba'i dbang gis sgrub rtags gnyis su nges pa ni/ deṃs/ sgrub rtags yang dag chos can/ khyod la 'bras rang gi gtan tshigs gnyis su grangs nges te/ khyod la dngos 'bras de byung gi 'brel pa dang bdag gcig gi 'brel pa grub pa'i gtan tshigs gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ldog 'brel dgag pa'i rtags su sbyar ba la gsum ste/ ma dmigs dang pos dgag bya 'gog pa'i tshul/ ma dmigs gnyis pas dgag bya 'gog pa'i tshul/ ma dmigs gnyis su phye la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ yod nges 'gog pa'i tshad ma yin/ med nges sgrub la tshad ma min pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub rtags gnyis la rgyu 'bras dang bdag gcig gi 'brel pa grub na'ang*/ dgag rtags kyi rtags chos la 'brel pa ji ltar grub ce na/ thog mar mi snang ba ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs la ldog 'brel de byung 'brel pa grub pa ni/ 'aṃjug skal don sha za chos can/ khyod tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyis mdun gyi gzhi 'dir khyod yod nges 'gog pa'i gtan tshigs de mthar rgyu dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs su 'gyur te/ de skor gyi rtags yang dag gang zhig khyod dmigs byed kyi tshad ma med na khyod yod nges kyi tha snyad don mthun mi 'jug pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi yod nges kyi tha snyad don mthun 'jug na khyod dmigs byed kyi tshad ma sngon du song bas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bstanaṃ/ skal don sha za chos can/ khyod tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i gtan (62) tshigs kyis khyod skal don du song ba'i gang zag gi ngor mdun gyi gzhi 'dir khyod med nges su sgrub mi nus par thal/ mdun gyi gzhi 'dir khyod yod na khyod skal don du song ba'i gang zag gi tshad ma gsum po gang rung gis dmigs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ yodaṃ/ sha za skal don du song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi tshad ma chos can/ khyod sha za yod med gang rung la kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma min par thal/ khyod de la nges shes 'dren nus min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ khyad par yod na med nges 'grub/ med nges bsgrub pa'i rnam pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'o na med nges sgrub nus kyi gtan tshigs med dam snyam na/ rtagaṃs/ snang rung gi bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa chos can/

bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i shar gzhir snang rung gi bum pa med nges su sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ chos de tshad mas ma dmigs na chos de med nges mi 'grub ces pa'i rigs pa chos can/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs bshad pa de khyod dang mi 'gal te/ khyod dgag chos yod kyang snang du mi rung ba la dgongs nas bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'brel zla bkag pas med nges 'grub/ 'gal zlar dmigs pas med nges 'grub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rgyu dang khyab byed bkag pas 'grub/ snang rung rang bzhin bkag pas 'grub pa'o// dang po ni/ mi snang ba ma dmigs pa'i rtags chos la de byung 'brel pa'i ldog pa grub na/ ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs gzhan rnams la 'brel pa ji ltar grub snyam na/ rgyu/ཾ me med pa chos can/ me med (63) mtshan dus kyi rgya mtsho na du ba med par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin te/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ doṃn/ shing med pa chos can/ shing med kyi brag rdzong na sha pa med par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ rgyu khyab byed ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag chos can/ khyod kyi dgag bya'i chos de yin na snang rung yin dgos te/ snang du mi rung yin na khyod kyi dgag bya'i chos min dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ snangaṃ*/ bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa chos can/ khyod bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i shar gzhir snang rung gi bum pa med nges su sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'galaṃ/ tsha reg gis khyab pa tshad mas nges pa de chos can/ de 'dra'i shar gzhir grang reg med par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/

de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtad tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la lnga ste/ don gsum bzung nas 'gal med sgrub/ sgra don rang mtshan yin pa dgag sgra don bkag na skyon du 'gyur/ dpyad yul rang mtshan kho nar bstan/ lung dang 'gal ba'i dogs pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyis yod nges 'gog pa'am med nges sgrub pa yin na/ phyogs glang gis gtso bo ni yod pa min te/ ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di ma dmigs pa'i rtags min par 'gyur te/ yod nges 'gog pa'am med nges sgrub par mi nus (64) pa'i phyir zhe na/ thogaṃ sgra don chos can/ rnam pa gsum yod de/ dngos po la brten pa'i sgra don/ dngos med la brten pa'i sgra don/ gnyis ka la brten pa'i sgra don rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ de ltar gsum las dngos med gtso bo'i sgra don chos can/ gtso bo dngos po ba'i nyer len du tshad mas ma dmigs pa de khyod gtso bo dngos po ba'i nyer len can du med par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin te/ de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ gtso bo chos can/ khyod kyi sgra don med par min te/ khyod ces brjod pa'i sgra 'jug pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ doṃn/ gtso bo'i sgra don yod na/ gtso bo rang mtshan med par 'gal te/ sgra thams cad rang mtshan kho na la 'jug pa'i phyir zhe na/ mthongaṃ*/ bum pa chos can/ khyod la rtag ces pa dang*/ mi rtag ces pa'i sgra don mi 'jug par thal/ khyod rtag mi rtag gnyis ka min pa'i phyir/ bum pa 'das ma 'ongs chos can/ khyod la bum pa zhes pa'i sgra mi 'jug par thal/ khyod bum pa rang mtshan min pa'i phyir/ rdzun tshigs mi srid par thal/ sgra yin na rang mtshan kho na la 'jug pas khyab pa'i phyir/ des na rjod byed kyi sgra chos can/ sgra don la dngos su 'jug ste/ rjod byed gang zhig rang mtshan la dngos su mi 'jug pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa'i gtan tshigs des gtso bo'i sgra don nyid 'gog pa yin no zhe na/ sgra/ཾ gtso bo'i sgra don dang med pa'i tshogs don chos can/ khyod gzhan don bsgrub bya yang dag min par thal/ khyod la phyir rgol gyis grub bsal gang rung zhugs pa'i phyir// (65) bzhi pa ni/ gtso bo'i sgra don de nyid don gnyer skyes bu'i 'jug yul yin no zhe na/ sgra/ཾ gtso bo chos can/ khyod kyi sgra don de khyod don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i 'jug yul min par thal/ khyod rang mtshan gyi 'bras bu yin na khyod rang mtshan las 'byung dgos pa'i phyir/ doṃn/ chos can dang chos 'dra/ khyod kyi sgra don de don byed mi nus pa'i phyir/ dper na ma ning gis 'dod ldan gyi 'dod pa spyod pa'i don byed mi nus pa bzhin no// lnga pa sgra don chos can du byed na/ mdo las gang yang ma brtags pa'i chos mi dmigs pa zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ rtogaṃ phyogs glang chos can/ khyod kyis gang yang ma brtags pa'i chos ma dmigs pa zhes gsungs pa de gtso bo'i sgra don gtso bo dngos po'i nyer len can du ma dmigs pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin te/ khyod kyis gtso bo'i sgra don sgro 'dogs yin pa la dgongs nas de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa gtan tshigs ltar snang rgyas par bshad pa la lnga ste/ sgra tsam don la ma nges ltar snang yin/ khyad par can tshig ma grub ltar snang yin/ rig sgra bden don sgrub pa'ang ltar snang yin/ des na lung tsam brjod bya'i don la 'khrul// nang 'gal bstan te smra ba po la smad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'brel ba med pas sgrub byed min/ de la lung 'gal ba spang ba'o// dang po ni/ sgra/ཾ bum pa zhes pa'i sgra chos can/ khyod bum pa zhes pa'i sgra dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir bum pa yod par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ khyod bum pa dang ma 'brel ba'i phyir/

de chos can/ smra ba po'i gang zag gi rgyud la kun slong gi bsam pa yod par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag yin te/ de (66) sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'gal bar dogs pa'i lung tshig drang*/ lung don bshad nas 'gal med bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ yidaṃ/ sgra las don dpog mi nus na/ mdor/ yid ches zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yid ches tshig gi mtshan gzhi bshad/ mi slu ba yi don ldog bshad/ spyi las rjes su dpag tshul bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'brelaṃ/ yid ches pa'i tshig chos can/ khyod lung tsam gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa min te/ khyod 'brel sogs chos gsum tshang ba'i ngag gi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthongaṃ*/ yid ches tshig ni mi slu ba'i zhes pa'i skabs kyi mi bslu ba de chos can/ chos 'dra/ khyod gzhal bya'i gnas dang po gnyis ston pa la tshad ma dang po gnyis kyis mi gnod pa'i lung gi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yidaṃ/ bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ gzhal bya'i gnas dang po gnyis ston pa la tshad ma dang po gnyis kyi rtags kyis khyod shin lkog la mi slu bar rtogs pa'i blo de rjes dpag yin te/ de lta bu'i blo yod pa gang zhig shin lkog la tshur mthong gi dngos stobs tshad ma 'jal byed du mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ blangaṃ*/ bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ shin lkog la mi slu ba yin te/ gzhal bya'i gnas gsum brjod byar ston pa gang zhig lkog gyur gyi gtso bo bden bzhi la mi slu ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ sun 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ skyesaṃ/ dpyod pa ba na re/ thog mar gang zag (67) de skyes bu tshad mar shes par byas nas de'i lung de brjod don la mi slu bar khas len pa yin no zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/

gzhan la skyes bu phul byung med/ rang la skyes bu phul byung sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ dpyod pa ba chos can/ lung rang gi bstan don la mi slu bar ma nges par thog mar skyes bu pha rol po skyes bu tshad mar shes pa'i thabs med par thal/ des ma nges pa skyes bu pha rol po skyon dang ldan mi ldan gang rung du nges par mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ nyes pa spangs pa srid par bstan/ spangs pa slar mi ldog par bstan/ nyes pa'i sgyu la rtsod pa spong pa'o// dang po ni/ 'gribaṃ/ chags sogs chos can/ gnyen po dang bcas pa yin te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab 'phel 'grib las khyod 'grib pa dang 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na bdag med rtogs pa goms pa'i gang zag chos can/ nyes pa zad par 'gyur te/ sems rgyud bdag med rtogs pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyes pa lan gcig zad kyang slar ldog pas nyes pa gtan zad pa mi srid do zhe na/ 'tsheṃ/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi bdag med rtogs pa'i sems chos can/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis khyod zlog mi nus te/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis khyod zlog pa'i phyir ched du 'bad pa mi byed cing 'bad du zin kyang khyod yul gyi gnas tshul la zhugs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ nyes pa'i rgyu bdag 'dzin yin na gti mug nyes pa'i sgyur gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ nyesaṃ/ nyes pa chags sogs chos can/ khyod kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pa dang gti mug yin pa mi 'gal te/ khyod kyi (68) rtsa bar gyur pa'i 'jig lta de ma rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ gti mug chos can/ khyod nyes pa chags sogs kyi rgyur gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod las 'dod chags 'byung*/ de las zhe sdang sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'jig lta chos can/ khyod nyes pa chags sogs kyi rgyur gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod spangs pa'i sgo nas nyes pa chags sogs spang dgos pa'i phyir/

gsum pa rig sgra bden don sgrub pa'ang ltar snang yin pa la gnyis te/ skyes bus ma byas rtags kyis sgrub pa dgag phyogs gcig mi slu'i rtags kyis sgrub pa dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ sun 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ tshiṃg dpyod pa ba na re/ rig byed chos can/ bden pa'i don can yin te/ brjod don ston pa gang zhig skyes bus ma byas pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ brjod don log par ston pa'i rgyu ni skyes bu la brten pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i rtags kyi khyab sgrub dgag rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs brtags nas dgag rtsa ba'i rtags kyi sgrub bya dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mgo mtshungs rigs pas dgag khas blangs 'gal bas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ tshigaṃ rig byed chos can/ lag pa'i don can yin par thal/ gtan tshigs snga ma de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs te/ brjod don bden par ston pa'i rgyu ni skye bu la rag las pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ doṃn/ rig byed chos can/ khyod kyis brjod don log par ston pa srid par thal/ khyod las don rtogs pa'i rgyu brda ni skyes bu la brten pa'i phyir/ gnyis

(69) pa la gnyis te/ nyes spong brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'brelaṃ/ gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ rig byed sgra don gyi 'brel pa skyes bus ma byas pa ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ha cang thal bas dgag rnam par brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ brdaṃ/ rig byed chos can/ brda 'brel mi shes pas kyang khyod las brjod don rtogs par thal/ khyod dang brjod don gyi 'brel pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyir/ gal te brda las rang bzhin gyis 'brel pa gsal par byed pas skyon med do zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod dang brjod don gyi 'brel pa brtags pa don med par thal/ khyod las don go bar brda la ltos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ brjod don la brtags nas dgag /'brel pa la brtags nas dgag rjod byed la brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ rig byed de don gcig kho na'am/ du ma gang dang rang bzhin gyis 'brel/ dang po ltar na/ tshigaṃ rig byed kyi tshig rnams chos can/ khyod las don du ma rtogs par mi 'gyur bar thal/ khyod don gcig kho na'i rjod byed du nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ doṃn/ mtho ris 'dod pas me la sbyin sreg sbyin/ zhes pa'i rig byed kyi tshig chos can/ khyi sha za ba la 'jug par thal/ don du ma dang ngo bo nyid kyis 'brel pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rig byed chos can/ khyod bden pa'i don can du bsgrub pa'i ched du skyes bus ma byas pa'i gtan tshigs brtags pa don med par thal/ khyod kyis brjod don log par ston srid pa'i phyir/ thaṃ/ rig byed kyi sgra dang*/ brjod don bum pa lta bu chos can/ khyod la (70) 'brel ba ma grub par thal/ khyod la bdag gcig dang de byung gi 'brel pa gang yang med pa'i phyir/ skyesaṃ/ rig byed chos can/ khyod las brjod don go ba med par thal/ khyod skyes bus ma byas pa'i phyir/ ma sgrub na/ dpyod pa ba chos can/

khas blangs nang 'gal smras pa yin te/ rig byed bden pa'i don can du bsgrub pa'i ched du skyes bus ma byas pa dang*/ brjod don mi ston pa'i skyon spong ba'i ched du skyes bus byas pa smras pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtag dang mi rtag brtags nas dgag gcig dang tha dad brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'brelaṃ/ sgra don gyi 'brel pa de mi rtag pa yin nam/ rtag pa yin/ dang po ltar na/ ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa ltar na bum sogs chos can/ khyod dang rjod byed sgra'i 'brel pa rtag rdzas min par thal/ khyod mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na sgra dang don gyi 'brel pa chos can/ rtog blos sgro btags pa yin te/ tha snyad du yod cing rdzas su med pa'i phyir/ doṃn/ rig byed kyi sgra dang*/ don gsar byung rnams kyi 'brel pa gsar du skyes pa yin na/ rig sgra chos can/ don gsar byung dang sngar ma 'brel pa las 'brel pa gsar du skyes pa mi 'thad par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ rnamaṃ/ chos grags chos can/ khyod la 'brel pa rtag rdzas la bkod pa'i skyon mi 'jug ste/ khyod 'brel pa sgro 'dogs su khas len pa'i mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te rten brjod bya 'jig na yang brten pa sgra don gyi 'brel pa mi 'jig ste/ rten gsal ba 'jig na yang brten pa rigs mi 'jig pa dang 'dra'o zhe na/ gsal ba dang (71) brjod bya chos can/ khyod rigs dang 'brel ba'i don gzhan gyi rten min par thal/ rigs dang 'brel ba rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gal te sngar med gsar du skyed pa'i rten min yang grub zin gsal bar byed pa'i rten yin no zhe na/ shesaṃ/ bum gzugs chos can/ sgron 'od de khyod grub zin gsal byed du 'gyur ba srid de/ sgron 'od la ltos nas khyod rang 'dzin mig shes skyed rung du 'gyur ba srid pa'i phyir/ de nyid rigs sogs la ma grub pa ni/

'gyuraṃ/ rigs dang 'brel pa chos can/ gsal ba dang brjod don de khyod kyi grub zin gsal byed min par thal/ des khyod la phan mi 'dogs pa'i phyir te/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rig byed kyi sgra dang brjod don bum pa'i 'brel pa dngos po yin na de sgra don gnyis dang rdzas tha dad yin nam min/ dang po ltar na/ 'brelaṃ/ sgra don gyi 'brel pa chos can/ khyod sgra don gnyis dang rdzas tha dad du blo ma 'khrul ba la snang bar thal/ khyod de dang rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ deṃ/ de chos can/ de dang rdzas gcig yin par thal/ rdzas su grub/ de dang rdzas gzhan min pa'i phyir/ dngoṃs/ des na rig byed kyi sgra dang brjod don bum pa chos can/ khyod kyi 'brel pa sgro btags yin te/ khyod kyi 'brel pa yod pa gang zhig khyod rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ yodaṃ/ sgra don gyi 'brel ba chos can/ sgra don la rag las pa min par thal/ rang byung du yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sgra don gyi 'brel ba min par thal/ rdzas su grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sgra don gyi 'brel ba don la yod na// (72) ye ge dang don la yon dam/ tshig sogs dang don la yod/ dang po ltar na/ yigaṃ yi ge chos can/ khyod dang brjod don gyis 'brel ba med par thal/ khyod kyis brjod don mi ston pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ tshigaṃ ngag tshig chos can/ khyod dang brjod don la dngos po'i 'brel pa med par thal/ khyod sgro btags yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs brtags nas dgag pa la gsum ste/ phyogs chos sgrub byed bcas pa dgag khyab pa sgrub byed bcas pa dgag phyogs chos nyid kyi khyad par dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sgrub byed la brtags nas dgag mtshan gzhi la brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ byed po mi dran gtan tshigs dgag 'don pa thogs med gtan tshigs dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ byedaṃ/

rgyal dpog pa na re/ rig byed chos can/ skyes bus ma byas te/ byed pa po mi dran pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro// de chos can/ de ltar sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ de sgrub kyi phyogs chos dang khyab pa gnyis ka ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gtan tshigs brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ jiṃ/ rig byed chos can/ skyes bus ma byas te/ 'don pa snga ma sngon du song ba'i phyir te/ 'don pa yin pa'i phyir/ da ltar gyi rig byed kyi 'don pa bzhin zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ brtags na byed po thog med du mi 'grub/ thog med grub kyang ma byas pa mi grub/ ma byas grub kyang bden don can mi 'grub pa'o// dang po ni/ spelaṃ/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos gzhon nu 'byung ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ riṃg rig byed snga ma gzhan (73) yang chos can/ skyes bu las byung bar 'gyur te/ brjod don ston pa'i ngag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'bras bu'i rigs de rgyu'i rigs la mi 'khrul ba'i phyir ro// deṃ/ rig byed chos can/ khyod skyes bus ma byas pa'i gtan tshigs bstan mi nus par thal/ khyod 'jig rten pa'i ngag tshig dang ngag tshig gcig tu mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod skyes bus ma byas pa sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs byed pa po thog med yin sogs khyab pa 'khrul pa yin te/ de ltar du bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnamaṃ/ byed pa po thog med yin pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis rig byed skyes bus ma byas pa'i bsgrub pa'i khyab pa ma nges te/ byis pa rdul la rtse ba sogs kyang khyod yin pa'i phyir/ klaṃ/ ma bag mar len pa kla klo'i tha snyad dang*/ skye ba snga phyi med par smra ba'i tshig rnams kyang chos can/ skyes bus ma byas par thal/ byed pa po thog med yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yangaṃ*/ 'don pa skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis rig byed bden pa'i don can du mi 'grub par thal/

sngar gyi tha snyad gnyis po de khyod yin pa'i phyir/ rig byed chos can/ khyod kyi brjod don nges par ston pa la the tshom za bar thal/ khyod 'chad pa po dag gis brjod don du ma la sbyar nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi la brtags nas dgag pa la gsum ste/ yi ge skyes bus ma byas dgag ngag rnams skyes bu ma byas dgag sgra dang nus pa rtag pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ yigaṃ rig byed kyi yi ge chos can/ khyod skyes bu ma byas pa sgrub mi nus pa thal/ khyod 'jig rten gyi yi ge dang khyad par med pa'i phyir/ (74) gnyis pa la gnyis te/ yi ge las gzhan ngag mi 'thad/ yi ge'i rim pa ngag min pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ snang rung ma dmigs rtags kyis dgag rnam par brtags pa'i rigs pas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ ngaṃg rig byed kyi ngag chos can/ yi ge las don gzhan du med de/ yi ge las don gzhan du tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ cha shas yod med brtags nas dgag rtag dang mi rtag brtags nas dgag khyab dang ma khyab brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ yi ge las gzhan pa'i ngag yod na/ ngag de cha shas can nam/ cha med gcig yin/ dang po ltar na/ yanaṃ/ cha shas re res brjod don rdzogs par ston nus sam mi nus/ mi nus na/ deṃ/ ngag gi cha shas rnams chos can/ brjod don ston par sgro 'dogs pa yin par thal/ re res brjod don ston mi nus kyang*/ tshogs nas brjod don ston nus pa'i phyir/ bram ze'i khye'u la seṅge zhes btags pa bzhin no// nus na/ deṃ/ rig byed kyi ngag chos can/ khyod kyi brjod don ston pa la khyod kyi cha shas du ma brtags pa don med par thal/ khyod kyi cha shas re res khyod kyi brjod don rdzogs par ston nus pa'i phyir/ yaṃn/ de chos can/ khyod kyi cha shas gcig gi don rtogs pas/ khyod kyis brjod don rdzogs par rtogs pas thal/ snga ma'i gtan tshigs de'i phyir/

thamaṃs/ 'dod pa yin te/ cha shas thams cad cig car thos pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod thos pa las snga phyi'i khyad par mi 'byung bar thal/ khyod kyi cha shas thams cad cig car thos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar cha med gcig yin na/ gciṃg (75) rig byed kyi ngag chos can/ khyod kyi cha shas rim gyis thos pa mi srid par thal/ khyod cha med gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ miṃ/ yi ge las gzhan pa'i ngag de mi rtag gam rtag dang po ltar na/ de chos can/ rtsol byung yin pa thal/ mi rtag pa gang zhig rtsol ba las gzhan pa'i khyod kyi rgyu med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khas blangs 'gal lo// gnyis pa ltar na/ rtagaṃ de chos can/ rtag tu thos par thal/ thos rung gi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ skyon med de/ lhan cig byed rkyen ma tshang ba srid pa'i phyir zhe na/ de chos can/ lhan cig byed rkyen la ltos pa mi 'thad par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ rig byed kyi ngag cha mod de/ yul thams cad la ma khyab bam khyab/ dang po ltar na/ de chos can/ yul gcig las gzhan du dmigs par mi 'gyur bar thal/ yul gcig kho nar yod pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rig byed kyi sgra thams cad chos can/ gang zag thams cad kyis gcig car thos par thal/ yul thams cad la khyab pa'i thos rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dusaṃ/ gal te sgra thos rung du rkyen gyis 'dus byas pa kho na dbang po rkyen gyis 'dus byas pa kho nas thos pa yin no zhe na/ sgra chos can/ rkyen gyis 'du byed par mi 'gyur bar thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbangaṃ*/ rkyen gyis 'dus byas pa'i dbang po chos can/ sgra thams cad thos par thal/ khyod kyis thos pa'i sgra de sgra thams cad dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te rkyen gyi khyad par las sgra gcig kho na'i yul can du nges pas skyon med do zhe na/ sgra/ཾ nyan shes (76) chos can/ sgra'i tshogs pa du ma'i ca co mi thos par thal/

sgra gcig kho na'i yul can du nges pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ de'i tshe sgra tsam yan gar ba thos pa yin gyi/ rjod byed thos pa min no zhe na/ sgra'i tshogs pa las gzhan pa'i sgra tsam yan gar ba chos can/ med de/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ sgra/ཾ skyes bu gcig kho na rig byed 'don pa na nyan shes chos can/ rjed byed kyi sgra mi thos par thal/ sgra tsam yan gar kho na thos pa'i phyir/ yangaṃ*/ nyan shes chos can/ sgra tsam yan gar ba du ma mi thos par thal/ sgra tsam yan gar ba re re kho na thos pa'i nus pa nges pa'i phyir/ nyesaṃ/ sgra tsam gyis gsal bar byed pa'i ngag tshig chos can/ khyed rjod byed min par thal/ sgra tsam rjod byed yin pa la bkod pa'i nyes pa de khyed rjod byed yin pa la'ang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yi ge'i rim pa ngag min pa la bzhi ste/ bkod pa'i rim pa ma byas ngag ma yin// gsal ba'i rim pa'ang ma byas ngag ma yin/ yi ge las gzhan rim pa snga mas khegs/ des na go rim skyes bus byas par grub pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ yi ge las tha dad pa'i ngag med pas yi ge'i rim pa nyid skyes bus ma byas pa'i ngag yin no zhe na/ yi ge'i rim pa chos can/ skyes bus ma byas pa'i ngag min par thal/ yi ge rnams las don gzhan du med pa'i phyir/ yi ge chos can/ khyod kyi go rim skyes bus ma byas par mtha' gcig tu rnam par gzhag pa med par thal/ khyod kyi go rim skyes bus 'dod pas gzhan dang gzhan du sgyur du rung ba'i phyir/ khyabaṃ/ de chos can/ khyod la yul dang dus kyi go rim med par thal/ khyod yul thams cad la (77) khyab pa'i rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod mi rtag pa dang khyab byed min pa mi 'thad pa thal/ de sngar rigs pa yang dag gis gsal zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rtag pa yin na gsal bar 'gal/ ngo bo bskyed pa gsal byed min/ sgrib byed bral tsam gsal ba min/ nyan blo skyes pa gsal ba min pa'o// dang po ni/

gsalaṃ/ yi ge chos can/ khyod grub zin rkyen gyis gsal ba'i rim pa de skyes bus ma byas pa'i ngag min par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byedaṃ/ rig byed kyi yi ge chos can/ byed pa po lce rkan de khyed grub zin gsal byed kyi rgyu min pa thal/ de las khyod kyi ngo bo gsar du skyes pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ngo bo gsar du skyed byed kyang grub zin gsal byed yin na de gnyis khyad par med par thal ba'i phyir ro// byedaṃ/ rig byed kyi yi ge chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo byed pa lce rkan gyi 'bras bu yin te/ byed pa lce rkan tshogs pa las khyod kyi ngo bo skye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ byed pa lce rkan gyi rig sgra'i sgrub byed dang bral bar byas pa tsam la gsal bar 'jog go zhe na/ sgrib byed dang bral tsam chos can/ khyod byed pa lce rkan gyi 'bras bu min par thal/ khyod dngos por med pa'i phyir/ sgra/ཾ rdza bum chos can/ 'jim pa dang rdza mkhan gyi gsal bya yin par thal/ sgra de byed pa lce rkan gyi gsal bya yin pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'jim sogs chos can/ rdza bum gyi ngo bo bskyed pa la don med par thal/ khyod de'i grub zin gsal byed yin pa'i phyir//

(78) byed pa lce rkan sogs sgra rtag pa'i gsal byed du 'dod na/ ngoṃ*/ sgra rtag pa yin pa cis 'grub/ snga phyi gcig tu ngo shes pa sogs 'god na/ de chos can/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag min par thal/ khyod kyis de sgrub kyi mthun dpe yang dag med pa'i phyir/ sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun dpe yang dag med par bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ sgra rtag pa sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs ngan pa gzhan yang sun dbyung ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ blo/ཾ yi ge gsal ba ni yi ge gsal bar thos pa'i nyan blo yin la/ de'i go rim skyes bus ma byas pa'i ngag yin no zhe na/ nyan blo skyes bu la mi brten par dam bcas pa'i dam bca' chos can/ khyod dam bca' yang dag min te/ khyod la dpyod pa pas khas blangs sogs bzhis gnod pa'i phyir// gsum pa yi ge las gzhan rim pa snga mas khegs pa ni/ yigaṃ yi ge las don gzhan pa'i yi ge'i go rim chos can/ med de/ snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa des na go rim skyes bus byas par sgrub pa ni/ deṃ/ yi ge'i go rim chos can/ skyes bu la ltos te/ skyes bus rtog pas sgro btags pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sgra dang nus pa rtag pa dgag pa la gsum ste/ yod pas sgra la mi rtag bsgrub// des na sngar bshad rigs pas bsgrub/ de yis nus pa rtag pa khegs pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ khyab sgrub bcas pa'i rtsa rtags dgod/ khyab sgrub bcas la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ 'jiṃg sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dngos po yin na rang rgyu las 'jig pa'i ngo bor skyes pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ khyab sgrub rtags la ma grub spang*/ (79) rtsa ba'i rtags la ma nges spong ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ zhig pa rgyu las byung ba dgag de la ha cang thal ba spong ba'o// dang po ni/ meṃ/ gal te ma grub ste/ shing zhig pa de shing gi 'jig pa yin la/

de phyis kyi me las byung ba'i phyir zhe na/ 'o na me las shing gi zhig pa shing las don gzhan bskyed dam/ rdzas gcig bskyed/ dang po ltar na/ shing chos can/ khyod mes bsregs zin pa'i 'og tu khyod mthong bar thal/ de'i 'og tu khyod zhig pa med pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ skyon med de/ zhig pa don gzhan de nyid shing gi 'jig pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ zhig pa don gzhan chos can/ shing gi 'jig pa min par thal/ shing las don gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ bla/ཾ shing mes bsregs zin pa'i 'og tu zhig pa don gzhan des shing gzung bas mi snang ba yin no zhe na/ zhig pa don gzhan chos can/ shing mes bsregs zin pa'i 'og tu khyod kyis gzung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis shing mi snang ba min par thal/ de yin na khyod shing gi sgrib byed yin dgos pa gang zhig khyod shing gi sgrib byed min pa'i phyir/ skye/ཾ shing gi zhig pa chos can/ 'jig par thal/ skye ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shing mes bsregs zin pa'i 'og tu chos can/ shing mthong bar thal/ shing gi zhig pa zhig pa'i phyir/ gal te skyon med de/ nag pa gsod byed de bsad pa na nag pa slar mi 'byung ba bzhin no zhe na/ nag pa gsod byed chos can/ khyod bsad na nag pa slar mi 'byung ba dang*/ shing gi zhig pa zhig na shing slar mi 'byung ba gnyis mi mtshungs par thal/ khyod nag pa bsad pa min pa'i phyir/ 'jiṃg gnyis pa ltar rdzas (80) gcig bskyed na/ shing chos can/ 'jig nges su thal/ khyod kyi 'jig pa khyod dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shing gi 'jig pa chos can/ phyis med de khyod kyi rgyu min par thal/ khyod phyis kyi me'i snga rol du yod pa'i phyir/ 'diṃ/ gal te rdzas gcig dang rdzas gzhan gang yang min pa'i 'jig pa bskyed do zhe na/ shing chos can/ khyod kyi 'jig pa rdzas su ma grub par thal/ khyod kyi 'jig pa khyod dang rdzas gcig dang rdzas gzhan gang rung du min pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ zhig dngos lhan gcig 'gyur ba spang*/ dngos po 'jig pa med pa spang*/ brtags pa'i nyes pa mtshungs pa spang*/ tshul des rig can gzhan yang khegs pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jiṃg shing gi zhig pa chos can rtag rdzas su thal/ rgyu med par dngos por yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zhig dngos lhan cig tu 'gyur ro zhe na/ de chos can/ rtag rdzas min par thal/ dngos por med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ medaṃ/ shing gi zhig pa dngos por med na shing mi 'jig par 'gyur ro zhe na/ shing chos can/ khyod kyi zhig pa dngos por med na khyod mi 'jig par thal ba'i nyes pa med de/ khyod zhig pa don gzhan gyis 'jig par byed pa min pa'i phyir ro/ dngoṃs/ shing gi zhig pa rgyu med du bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ shing gi dngos por gyur ba'i 'jig pa de shing gi rgyu las gzhan pa'i rgyur med pa dang*/ shing gi zhig pa de rgyu gtan med du shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ medaṃ/ shing gi zhig pa shing dang rdzas gcig dang rdzas gzhan brtags pa'i nyes pa de khyod rang la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ chos grags chos (81) can/ shing gi 'jig pa shing dang rdzas gcig dang rdzas gzhan brtags pa'i nyes pas sun dbyung du med par thal/ shing gi zhig pa dngos med du 'dod pa gang zhig nyes pa de shing gi zhig pa dngos por 'dod pa kho na la 'jug pa'i phyir/ medaṃ/ shing zhig nas med pa yin zhes gsungs pa chos can/ zhig pa dngos po ba la dgongs nas gsungs pa min te/ shing gi dngos po med pa tsam la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ shing gi zhig pa chos can/ rgyu la mi ltos par thal/ rgyu'i nus pa mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ deṃs/ shing gi zhig pa dngos med du bstan pa'i rigs pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ zhig pa rgyu med la ha cang thal pa'i skyon gsum bsal pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ jiṃ/ dngos po yin na mi rtag pa yin pas ma khyab ste/

dngos po la rtag mi rtag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dper na skye ldan la thogs bcas thogs med gnyis yod pa bzhin no zhe na/ rgyu/ཾ dngos po chos can/ khyod la rtag pa'i dngos po med de/ khyod la rtag pa'i dngos po bskyed pa'i rgyu med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'bras bu rgyu la ltos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ dngos po la mi rtag pas khyab par bstan pa'i rig pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ sgra don gyi 'brel pa rtag rdzas yin pa khegs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sgraṃ/ sgra'i nus pa rtag rdzas min par thal/ nus pa can gyi sgra rtag rdzas min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa khyab pa sgrub byed bcas pa dgag pa la gsum ste/ ma byas gtan tshigs 'khrul pa bstan/ gtan tshigs (82) 'gal ba'i skyon yang bstan/ mi 'khrul ba yi sgrub byed dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ skyesaṃ/ skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ khyod rig sgra yang dag don shes kho na'i rgyur sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min par thal/ me dang zla ba'i 'od zer de khyod kyang yin/ log shes kyi rgyu yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ rig byed chos can/ yang dag don shes kyi rgyur mi rung bar thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtag pa yin na rang 'bras bskyed pa'i nus pa med pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'o na nam mkha' 'dzin rtog nam mkha' rtag pa las skye ba min nam zhe na/ rnamaṃ/ nam mkha' 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ khyod rang rgyu nam mkha' rtag pa'i gzung don can min par thal/ khyod rang rgyu rnam rtog ngan pa'i bag chags las byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ gal te skyes bus ma byas pa de rig byed bden pa'i don can du sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro med kyang ldog pa rkyang pa can gyi rtags yin te/ skyes bus ma byas pa de mi mthun phyogs log pa'i don can las ldog pa'i phyir te/

skyes bus ma byas pa las log pa'i don can gyis khyab pa gang zhig khyab byed gcig gis khyab bya 'gal ba gnyis la khyab pa mi srid pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sgrub byed med pas ldog pa med/ tshul gsum nges pa rtags la dgos/ ldog pa yod na rjes 'gro grub pa'o// dang po ni/ medaṃ/ skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ khyod rig byed bden pa'i don can du sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs las ldog pa ma nges par thal/ de'i sgrub byed yang dag med pa'i (83) phyir/ khyab byed gcig gis khyab bya 'gal ba gnyis la khyag pa med pa yang mi 'thad par thal/ rtsol byung dang rtsol ma byung gi dngos po gnyis la mi rtag pas khyab par mthong pa'i phyir/ skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la ma mthong tsam gyis de la med nges su mi grub par thal/ de ltar gong du bshad zin pa'i phyir/ skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis rig byed bden pa'i don can du sgrub pa'i ldog khyab ma nges par thal/ khyod kyis de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la med par ma nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ khyod de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs yang dag min par thal/ khyod kyis de sgrub kyi ldog tshul ma nges pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gtan tshigs yang dag yin na tshul gsum tshad mas drangs pa'i nges shes kyis nges dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gangaṃ*/ skyes bus ma byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis rig byed bden pa'i don can du sgrub pa'i rjes 'gro grub par thal/ khyod de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs las ldog par nges pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phyogs nyid kyi khyad par dgag pa la bzhi ste/ zhi sogs 'bras bu ster ba brda la ltos/ yi ge'i nus pa kho nas ster ba dgag de yi gnas skabs cha la rtsod pa spang*/ des na khyad par can gyi sngags byed grub pa'o// dang po ni/

'ga'aṃ/ rig byed kyi sngags chos can/ khyod skyes bus ma byas pa min te/ khyod rang 'bras sgrub byed gang zhig de yin na khyod skyes bu khyad par can gyis brda byas pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la (84) gsum ste/ go rim log pas ster bar thal/ 'bras bu rtag tu ster bar thal/ kun la 'bras bu ster bar thal ba'o// dang po ni/ ciṃ/ ma grub ste/ brda la ma ltos pa rig byed kyi sngags rtag dngos kyi nus pa kho na las 'bras bu bsgrub pa'i phyir zhe na/ rig byed kyi sngags rtag pa chos can/ khyod kyi go rim log par bzlas pa la'ang khyod kyis 'bras bu 'grub par thal/ khyod kyi go rim log ma log gi sngags sgra rtag dngos su mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ gal te go rim log pas mi grub ste/ rig byed kyi yi ge las don gzhan du gyur pa'i yi ge bkod pa'i sngags 'bras grub pa'i phyir zhe na/ rig byed kyi yi ge chos can/ khyod las don gzhan du gyur pa'i khyod kyi bkod pa'i go rim med par thal/ de sngar rigs pa yang dag gis bsal zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ rig byed kyi sngags chos can/ 'dod don rtag tu 'grub par thal/ 'dod don sgrub byed kyi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ rkyen la ltos nas rim gyis 'grub pas skyon med do zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod rtag dngos la sngags 'bras sgrub pa'i nus pa med par thal/ khyod rkyen la ltos nas sngags 'bras sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la bzhi ste/ gnod byed thal ba dngos su brjod/ byed po'i khyad par yod pa dgag byed po 'dod na khas blangs 'gal/ rang la mtshungs pa'i nyes pa spong pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ rig byed kyi sngags rtag pa chos can/ bram ze dang gdol pa kun gyi 'dod don sgrub byed du thal/ khyod rtag dngos kyi nus pa kho na las 'dod don 'grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ legasaṃ/ (85) de gnyis rigs bzang ngan gyi khyad par ngo bo nyid kyis grub pas sngags 'bras 'grub mi 'grub kyi khyad par yod do zhe na/

sngags chos can/ byed pa po bzang ngan gyi khyad par las 'bras bu 'grub mi 'grub kyi khyad par mi rung bar thal/ rkyen gyis 'dus byas pa min pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rkyen bzang ngan las byung ba'i 'bras bu khyad par de yin na 'dus byas yin dgos pa'i phyir/ bram ze dang gdol ba'i rigs bzang ngan gyi khyad par de chos can/ ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa min par thal/ 'jig rten gyi brdas bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ khyadaṃ/ sngags chos can/ bram ze khyod kyi byed pa po mi rung bar thal/ khyod rkyen gyis khyad par du bya bar mi rung ba'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te bram ze sngags la khyad par gsar du mi byed kyang sngags mngon gsal du sbyor ba byed pa po yin no zhe na/ sngags chos can/ khyod rkyen gyis gsal bya min par thal/ khyod rtag pa gang zhig rtag pa dang rkyen gyis gsal ba'i gzhi mthun bkag zin pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ sngags sgra gsal bar thos pa'i nyan blo skyes pa des sngags 'bras 'grub bo zhe na/ sngags mi zlos par nyan pa po de chos can/ sngags 'bras 'grub par thal/ sngags sgra gsal bar thos pa'i nyan blo gsal bar skyed pa'i phyir/ mngoṃn/ sngags shub bus bzlas pa dang yid kyis bzlas pa chos can/ sngags 'bras mi grub par thal/ sngags sgra mngon par mi gsal ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ mngon gsal gyi sgra yin na nyan shes kyi yul yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyudaṃ/ shub bu dang yid kyis bzlas dus kyi rtog blo (86) de sngags sgra mngon gsal ba yin te/ de sngags sgra las brgyud nas skyes pa'i phyir zhe na/ de chos can/ sngags sgra rang mtshan gyi gzung don can min par thal/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ raṃng*/ sngags shub bu dang yid kyis bzlas pas sngags 'bras mi 'grub par khyed rang la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ sngags shub bu dang yid kyis bzlas pa chos can/ sngags 'bras 'grub pa mi 'gal te/

sngags sgra rang mtshan dang don spyi gcig tu zhen pa sngags brda byed pa'i rjes su zhugs nas sngags bzlas pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyod la 'gal te sngags brda rang mtshan kho na las sngags 'bras grub pa yin pa'i phyir te/ sngags yid bzlas la sngags sgra rang mtshan med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de'i gnas skabs cha la rtsod pa spang pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ gal te yi ge las don gzhan pa'i yi ge'i go rim med na ni ra sa dang*/ sa ra zhes pa'i tshig chos can/ khyod las 'bras bu ro mtsho tha dad du go ba med par thal/ khyod kyi go rim la khyad par med pa gang zhig yi ge la yang khyad par med pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yi ge'i rgyu 'bras go rim skyes bus byas/ des na go rim gzhan la 'bras khyad yod// yi ge'i go rim skyes bus byas par bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ ra sa dang sa ra chos can/ khyod la go rim tha dad med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'bras bu'i khyad par med pa min par thal/ khyod la skyes bus byas pa'i go rim tha dad du yod pa'i phyir/ 'di bsgrub pa la gsum las/ kun slong gi go rim tha dad du yod pa ni/ yigaṃ ra sa chos can/ khyod dang sa ra gnyis la kun slong gi go rim tha

(87) dad du yod de/ khyod la ra kun slong gi shes pa las yi ge ra dang*/ sa kun slong gi shes pa gnyis cig car du skye ba gang zhig sa ra la de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu nyan shes kyi go rim tha dad du yod pa ni/ deṃ/ ra sa chos can/ khyod dang ra sa gnyis la 'bras bu nyan shes kyi go rim tha dad du yod de/ khyod la ra thos pa'i nyan shes kyi rjes su sa thos pa'i nyan shes skye/ sa ra la de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ dran shes kyi go rim tha dad du yod pa ni/ shesaṃ/ snga ma'i nyan shes kyi tshab tu dran shes sbyar te 'god do// deṃ/ ra sa dang sa ra chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu 'bras kyi go rim skyes bus byas te/ khyod la rgyu kun slong dang 'bras bu nyan shes dang dran shes gnyis ka tha dad du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ ra sa zhes pa'i yi ge'i ngo bo dang*/ sa ra zhes pa'i yi ge'i ngo bo chos can/ rang bzhin gcig min te/ kun slong gi go rim tha dad du yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'bras bu ro mtsho tha dad du go bar byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yiṃg yi ge'i go rim chos can/ skyes bus byas pa yin te/ skyes bu'i 'dod pa'i brda sbyar ba'i phyir/ skye/ཾ yi ge'i rim pa kun chos can/ skyes bus byas pa yin te/ yi ge'i rim pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na spyir me dang bud shing rgyu 'bras su grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ri'i me yang rang rgyu bud shing gi 'bras bur grub pa bzhin no// bzhi pa la gsum ste/ shes mthus skyes bu khyad par can sgrub nus/ khyad par can med sgrub byed bsal bar nus/ khyad par can med grub na khas blangs 'gal ba'o// dang po ni/ shesaṃ/ sngags khyad par can sbyor pa'i skyes bu chos can/ khyod gang zag (88) phal pa las khyad par du 'phags par grub ste/ khyod shes mthu khyad par can dang ldan pa gang zhig gang zag phal pa la shes mthu khyad par can de med pa'i phyir/

ma grub ste/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyud shes pa'i phal pas dug zhi ba la sogs pa'i sngags sbyar ba mthong ba'i phyir zhe na/ gangaṃ*/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyud shes pa'i phal pas dug zhi ba sogs kyi sngags sbyar pa de chos can/ khyod nam mkha' lding gi rgyud rtsom pa po la ma ltos par sngags sbyor ba min te/ khyod des bshad pa'i rigs pa'i rjes su zhugs nas sngags sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'brasaṃ/ sngags chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu 'dod pas khyod spyir byas pa dang*/ bye brag tu skyes bus byas pa 'dod rigs te/ khyod skyes bus ma byas pa las khyod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skyesaṃ/ shes mthu khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sngags sbyor pa po yod par bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ dpyod pa pas bkod pa'i skyes bu khyad par can med pa'i sgrub byed yang bsal nus pa'i phyir/ ci ltar bsal zhe na/ bloṃ/ blo dang ldan pa sogs chos can/ khyod kun mkhyen du 'dod pa'i skyes bu pha rol po skyes bu khyad par can min par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi khyab pa ma nges pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ don nges skyes bus brtag pa brdzun par thal/ chags sogs ldan la don nges rtogs khyad med/ byed tshig tshad ma yod na khas blangs 'gal ba'o// dang po ni/ sgra/ཾ rig sgra bden pa'i don nges yin pa de chos can/ khyod skyes bus brtag par thal/ de yin pa'am rig (89) sgra rang nyid kyis smras pa gang rung gang zhig phyi ma min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skyes bu chos can/ rig sgra bden pa'i don nges mi shes par thal/ chags sogs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ rgyal dpog pa chos can/ khyod kho nas rig byed bden pa'i don nges yin par rig pa de min par thal/ khyod kyis de rig na de rig pa'i skyes bu gzhan yang yod par mtshungs pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ skyes bu gang gis tshig shin lkog la mi bslu bar dngos stobs tshad mas grub pa'i skyes bu des rigs byed bden pa'i don nges yin par rig go zhe na/ dngos stobs tshad ma chos can/ khyod kyis shin tu lkog gyur la mi bslu bar mi grub par thal/ khyod shin tu lkog gyur la 'jal byed du mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ lung tshad ma chos can/ khyod skyes bus ma byas sgrub pa don med par thal/ khyod yin na tshig shin tu lkog gyur la mi bslu bas skyes bus byas pas khyab pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ shin tu lkog gyur gyi don rang gis rtogs pa'i skyes bu khyad par can 'ga' zhig yod par thal/ shin tu lkog gyur lung la ma ltos par dngos stobs tshad mas grub pa'i skyes bu yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtsa ba'i rtags kyi bsgrub bya dgag pa la bzhi ste/ rig byed don nges rtogs pa med par bstan// des na don nges sgrub byed tshad ma med// sgrub byed yod par 'dod pa'i gzhan lan dgag ngo bo nyid kyis don nges yin pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bdaṃg rgyal dpog pa chos can/ rig byed bden pa'i don nges yin par mi rtogs par thal/ rig byed bden pa'i don nges yin par rang nyid kyis kyang mi rtogs/ gang zag (90) gzhan las kyang mi rtogs/ rig byed nyid las kyang mi rtogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ mtho ris 'dod pas me la sbyin sreg sbyin zhes pa'i rig byed chos can/ khyod kyi brjod don yin min sgrub byed kyi tshad ma med par thal/ khyod kyi don rtogs pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'jig rten grags pas grub pa dgag rig byed nyid kyis smras pa dgag pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ grags pas lkog gyur sgrub mi nus/ grags pa nyid dang 'gal bar bstan/ grags pas grub na rang tshig 'gal// grags pa the tshom rgyu ru bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jigaṃ rig byed bden pa'i don nges yin par 'jig rten gyi grags pas grub bo zhe na/

'jig rten pa chos can/ khyod kyi tshig las rig byed bden pa'i don nges 'byed mi nus par thal/ khyod kyis rig byed kyi don mthong ba med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gragasaṃ/ rig byed chos can/ 'jig rten gyi grags pas khyod bden pa'i don nges yin par mi 'grub par thal/ khyod las 'jig rten grags pa dang 'gal ba'i tha snyad 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gragaṃs/ dpyod pa ba chos can/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa la sdang 'dod gnyis ka byed par thal/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa tshad mar mi 'dod pa dang*/ de las rig byed kyi don rtogs pa 'dod pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ rig byed bden pa'i don nges yin par 'jig rten na grags pa las bzlog ste/ khas len pa la rgyu ci yod ce na/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa chos can/ khyod tshad ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod las rig byed bden pa'i don nges su 'dzin pa de mi 'thad par thal/ khyod tshad ma min (91) pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ gragaṃs/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa chos can/ khyod las rig byed bden pa'i don nges yin pa la nges pa bskyed mi nus par thal/ khyod las rig byed don sna tshogs la 'jug par mthong ba'i phyir/ ngesaṃ/ brjod don sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i rig byed kyi sgra chos can/ khyod bden pa'i don nges yin pa'i shes byed ma mthong bas khyod bden pa'i pa'i don nges yin par mi 'grub par thal/ khyod 'dod don las gzhan la 'jug pa srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rig byed zol gyis skyes bus byas par grub// skyes bus byas pa min na don nges 'gal ba'o// dang po ni/ 'gaṃ'/ rig byed rang nyid kyis rgyal dpog pa la don nges ston cing des gzhan la ston to zhe na/ rgyal dpog pa chos can/ rang nyid kyis rig byed bden pa'i don nges smras par thal/ rig byed zol gyis rig byed bden pa'i don nges smras pa'i phyir/ dper na g.yon can 'ga' zhig sdong dum gyi zol gyis lam smra ba bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/

thamaṃs/ rig byed kyi sgra chos can/ don gcig kho na la 'jug par min par thal/ don thams cad la 'jug rung yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ brjod don dang rang bzhin gyis 'brel pa tshad mas mi shes par thal/ brjod don dang rang bzhin gyis 'brel pa tshad ma'i yul min pa'i phyir/ brjoṃd/ de chos can/ don gcig kho na'i rjod byed min par thal/ skyes bus ma byas pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ brjod bya rjod byed du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan brda de skyes bu la brten pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ rangaṃ*/ de chos can/ brjod don gzhan la brjod 'dod kyi dbang gis (92) kyang 'jug tu mi rung bar thal/ brjod don gcig kho na'i rjod byed du rang bzhin gyis nges pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod las don go ba la brda don med par thal/ gtan tshigs snga ma de'i phyir/ gal te brda las rang bzhin gyis 'brel ba gsal bar byed do zhe na/ brdaṃ/ brda chos can/ khyod la sgra don rang bzhin gyis 'brel pa gsal par byed pa min par thal/ khyod 'dod pa tsam gyis 'jug pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ brda chos can/ sgra rang bzhin gyis 'jug tu rung ba'i 'dod don kho na gsal bar byed pa min par thal/ rang bzhin gyis 'jug tu rung ba'i don la sbyar ba ma nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa phyogs gcig mi slu ba'i rtags kyis sgrub pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ sun 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gangaṃ*/ rig byed kyi sgra gzhan yang chos can/ bden pa'i don can yin te/ rig byed kyi phyogs gcig yin pa'i phyir/ dper na me grang ba las zlog byed yin zhes pa'i rig byed kyi ngag bzhin no zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sgrub byed lhag ldan nyid du brtan/ bsgrub bya nyid la gnod pa bstan/ ha cang thal ba'i sgo nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ roṃ/ rig byed kyi phyogs gcig yin pa chos can/ khyod me grang ba zlog byed yin ces pa las gzhan pa'i rig byed kyi ngag bden pa'i don can du bsgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/

khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi khyab pa ma zhes pa'i phyir/ dper na gzugs mtshungs pa'i rtags kyis de 'dra'i shing thog lhag ma ro 'dra ba sgrub pa dang*/ snod gcig tu tshud par mtshungs pa'i rtags kyis de 'dra'i 'bras lhag ma tshos par sgrub pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ skyesaṃ// (93) rig byed chos can/ tshad ma gsum dang 'gal ba'i don brjod de/ skyes bu rtag pa las byed pa po yin pa sogs dngos stobs rjes dpag gi bsal ba dang*/ rang blo rang la lkog gyur yin pa sogs mngon sum gyi bsal ba dang*/ khrus kyis sdig pa 'dag pa sogs yid chos rjes dpag gi bsal ba rnams brjod byar byed pa'i phyir/ 'gaṃl/ des na/ dpyod pa ba chos can/ mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas yin te/ tshad ma gsum dang 'gal ba ma bsal zhing 'brel sogs chos gsum ma tshang ba'i rig byed bden pa'i don can du smras pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ skyes bu chos can/ khyod kyis smras pa'i tshig yin na bden pa'i don can yin pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyis smras pa'i tshig kyang bden pa'i don can yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa des na lung tsam brjod bya'i don la 'khrul pa la gnyis te/ lung tsam don dang 'brel pa med// des na brjod don nges mi nus pa'o// dang po ni/ brjoṃd/ rjod byed kyi sgra chos can/ khyod rang gi brjod don dang 'brel pa med par thal/ khyod rang gi brjod don dang bdag gcig de byung gang rung du ma 'brel ba'i phyir/ brjodaṃ/ gal te de byung du ma 'brel ba ma grub ste/ rjod byed kyi sgra thams cad rang gi brjod bya'i don las brgyud nas skyes pa'i phyir zhe na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod la rtag ces pa dang*/ mi rtag ces pa'i sgra gnyis 'jug tu mi rung bar thal/ khyod rtag mi rtag gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun du med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ lung tsam chos can/ khyod kyi rtags las gzhi 'gar rang gi brjod don sgrub mi nus par thal/

khyod (94) rang gi brjod don dang med na mi 'byung ba'i 'brel pa ma grub pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ de chos can/ khyod tshad ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod log pas skal don med nges su mi 'grub par thal/ khyod tshad ma min pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ sha za skal don du song ba'i gang zag chos can/ khyod kyi tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i gzhi 'gar sha za med nges su mi 'grub par thal/ sha za yod na khyod kyi tshad ma dmigs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ lnga pa nang 'gal bstan ste smra ba po la smad pa ni/ riṃg nang 'gal sna tshogs ston pa'i rig byed tshad mar smras pa dang*/ skyes bu rtag pa las byed pa por smras pa dang*/ khrus kyis sdig pa 'dag par smras pa dang*/ yon tan med kyang rigs bzang po yin no zhes dregs pa dang*/ sems kyi sdig pa gzhom pa'i ched du lus me lnga bsten pa sogs kyis gdung ba rtsom pa de chos can/ khyod blun po rigs pa can pa shes rab 'chal ba dang ldan par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag yin te/ khyod de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs gang zhig khyod rang rgyu shes rab 'chal ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa tshad ma sogs so// le'u dang po'i rnam par bshad pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa don dang don min rnam par 'byed byed tshad ma grub pa bshad pa la gsum ste/ thog mar 'brel gyi mtshams sbyar bstan/ bar du le'u'i gzhung nyid bshad/ tha mar mtshan gyi mjug sdud bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ mdo'i mchod brjod kyi tshig rkang dang po gnyis bshad pa'i sgo nas don dang don min pa rnam par 'byed byed bshad pa la de'i rgyu'i gtso bo rang don rjes dpag thog mar bshad zin nas/ da ni don dang don min pa rnam par 'byed (95) byed dngos 'chad do// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bsgrub bya tshad mar gyur pa bshad/ de yi sgrub byed phun tshogs bshad/ tshad mas bstod pa'i dgos pa bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bcom ldan skyes bu tshad mar bstan/

gyur pa smos pa'i dgos pa bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ mdo las byung ba'i mtshad nyid bshad/ rang gzhung gzhan dang 'gal ba spang*/ de nyid skabs kyi don la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid don dang bcas pa bshad/ mtshan nyid de yi skyon gsum spang*/ mtshan gzhi'i steng du nges byed bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ tshadaṃ/ mi slu ba'i shis pa chos can/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ tshad ma'i dngos 'gal gcod pa'i don ldog grub pa'i phyir/ mi slu ba'i don gang zhe na/ thog mar kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma la mtshon na/ me 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod mi slu ba khyad par gsum ldan yin te/ khyod rang yul don byed nus pa la der gzhal ba'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi mtshan nyid de la ma khyab pa'i skyon yod de/ des sgra byung gi tshad ma la ma khyab pa'i phyir zhe na/ sgra/ཾ sgra byung gi tshad ma la gnyis las/ bum pa zhes pa'i tshig gi rtags las/ de smra ba'i lhas byin kun slong gi bsam ldan du rtogs pa'i rjes dpag chos can/ khyod la mi slu bas ma khyab pa'i skyon med de/ khyod bum pa zhes pa'i tshig smra ba'i lhas byin gyi rgyud kyi kun slong gi bsam pa la mi slu ba'i phyir/ doṃn/ bum pa zhes pa'i tshig gi rtags las de dang ldan pa'i shar gzhir brjod don bum pa yod

(96) par rtogs pa'i blo chos can/ khyod la mi slu bas ma khyab pas tshad ma'i mtshan nyid la mi slu bas ma khyab pa'i skyon yod pa min te/ khyod tshad ma min pa'i phyir/ rjes kyi nges shes la khyab ches pa'i skyon yod do zhe na/ gzungaṃ*/ sngo 'dzin dbang mngon gyi rjes su skyes pa'i sngon po nges pa'i nges shes chos can/ khyod mi slu ba'i shes pa min te/ khyod rang 'dren byed kyi tshad ma snga mas bzung zin gyi don la bsnan pa 'dzin pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbang po gzugs can pa la mi srid pa'i skyon yod de/ mtshan nyid kyi zur shes pa de dbang po gzugs can pa la mi srid pa'i phyir zhe na/ bloṃ/ dbang po gzugs can pa chos can/ khyod la shes pa mi srid pas tshad ma'i mtshan nyid la mi srid pas skyon yod pa min te/ khyod tshad ma min dgos pa'i phyir te/ khyod blo min pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ chod pa'i tshad ma'i 'bras bu sgrub pa la yang blo gtso bo yin pa'i phyir dang*/ ma chod pa'i tshad ma'i 'bras bu sgrub pa la yang blo gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid kyi zur gnyis po mtshan gzhi'i steng du ji ltar nges snyam na/ raṃng*/ kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma chos can/ khyod shes pa yin pa'i don nges byed yod de/ khyod myong rang rig mngon sum des khyod shes pa yin pa'i don la nges par rang stobs kyis 'dren par byed pa'i phyir/ thaṃ/ de chos can/ khyod mi slu ba yin par nges byed yod de/ rang stobs gzhan stobs gang rung gis drangs pa'i khyod kyi rjes kyi nges shes des khyod mi slu ba yin par nges pa'i phyir/ bstanaṃ/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i bstan bcos chos can/ dgos pa yod (97) de/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin min la rmongs pa bzlog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'o na slob dpon phyogs glang gis gzhung gi cha 'ga' zhig las ma shes don gsal tshad ma'i mtshan nyid du gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/

maṃ/ ma shes don gyi gsal byed chos can/ mi slu ba'i shes pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin pa dang*/ khyod tshad ma'i mtshan nyid yin pa mi 'gal te/ khyod dang de gnyis mtshon bya gcig gis mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid rang ldog tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ raṃng*/ 'o na mig shes sngo 'dzin mngon sum gyi rjes su sngon po nges pa'i nges shes de ma shes don gyi gsal byed yin par thal/ des sngon po'i spyi sngar ma shes pa gsar du shes pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ raṃng*/ phyogs glang chos can/ sngon po'i spyi gsar du shes pa la dgongs nas ma shes don gyi gsal byed gsungs pa min par thal/ kun tu tha snyad pa'i tshad ma yin na rang mtshan yod med gang rung du gsar du shes pa la dgongs nas de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ skyes bu tshad ma yin te/ skyes bu gang zhig gdul bya'i don la mi slu ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gsum ste/ rang byung dgag phyir gyur ba smos/ tshad ma thabs la ltos par grub/ rang byung dgag par rgyas par bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ maṃ/ mdo'i mchod brjod du gyur pa smos pa chos can/ dgos pa yo da de/ rang byung gi tshad ma bzlog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ sgrub byed la ltos nas skyes bu tshad mar gyur pa yin te// (98) skyes bu tshad ma gang zhig rang byung gi tshad ma bkag zin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la bzhi ste/ rtag pa rang byung tshad ma dgag mi rtag rang byung tshad ma dgag rang byung yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag rang byung nyid kyi byed las dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ rang byung gi tshad ma dgag pa'i don du gyur pa smos pa mi rigs te/ dbang phyug de rtag pa rang byung gi tshad ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ tshadaṃ/ tshad ma chos can/ khyod rtag pa med par thal/ khyod dngos po'i yul can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ yul de mi rtag pa yin na yul can de mi rtag pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/

gal te tshad ma mi rtag kyang tshad ma can gyi skyes bu mi rtag pa min pa de las tshad ma skye'o zhe na/ rimaṃ/ tshad ma chos can/ skyes bu rtag pa las skye ba mi 'thad par thal/ rim bzhin skye ba'i phyir/ rkyen la ltos pas tshad ma rim bzhin bskyed pa'i skyon med do zhe na/ skyes bu chos can/ rkyen la ltos nas tshad ma rim bzhin bskyed pa mi rung bar thal/ rkyen gyis phan gdags bya min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang phyug mi rtag pa rang byung gi tshad ma yin no zhe na/ miṃ/ dbang phyug mi rtag pa chos can/ khyod skyes bu tshad ma min par thal/ khyod skyes bu tshad ma yin pa'i sgrub byed tshad ma med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ sdodaṃ/ gal te gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ 'jig rten gyi gnas lus chos can/ skyes bu khyad par can gyi blo sngon du song ba yin te/ sdod cing 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ dbyibs kyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i phyir dang*/ don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir (99) zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bsgrub bya'i don la brtags nas dgag sgrub par byed la brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dodaṃ/ sdod 'jug sogs chos can/ khyod de ltar sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi gnas lus skyes bu'i blo sngon du song ba tsam sgrub na/ phyi rgol la grub zin/ dbang phyug gi byas par grub na/ mthun dpe yang dag ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bzhi ste/ sgrub byed spyi tsam 'khrul par bstan/ bye brag dbyibs ldan brtags nas dgag tshul des rigs can gzhan yang khegs// de yis grub pa'i 'phros don bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ yangaṃ*/ sdod 'jug sogs chos can/ khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi gnas lus dbang phyug gis byas par sgrub pa'i khyab pa ma nges te/ dbang phyug de khyod min pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa gnyis te/ dbyibs kyi don la brtags nas dgag

dbyibs kyi ming la brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ byinaṃ/ rang byed pa po'i skyes bu phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i dbyibs de chos can/ khyod 'jig rten gyi gnas lus sogs skyes bus byas par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs min te/ khyod kyi rtags las de sgrub kyi phyogs chos ma grub pa'i phyir/ thaṃ/ skyes bus byas pa'i dbyibs dang dbyibs tsam du mtshungs pa de chos can/ khyod de ltar sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi khyab pa ma nges pa'i phyir/ skya bo'i rdzas las me sgrub pa bzhin/ ma grub na/ deṃ/ grog mkhar chos can/ rdza mkhan gyis byas par (100) thal/ rdza bum dang 'jim pa'i rnam 'gyur du mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dbyibs tsam rtags su bkod pa la khyad par brtags nas skyon brjod pa 'di 'bras mtshungs kyi ltag chod du 'gyur ro zhe na/ sgrubaṃ/ dbyibs ldan chos can/ khyod kyi khyad par brtags nas 'jig rten gyi gnas lus skyes bus byas par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag tu mi rung bar bstan pa'i rigs pa de 'bras mtshungs kyi ltag chod min te/ khyod de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs su mi rung ba'i phyir/ byas pa chos can/ khyod kyi khyad par brtags nas sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag tu mi rung bar sgrub pa'i rigs pa de 'bras mtshungs kyi ltag chod yin te/ khyod de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbyibs ldan gyi don dbyibs zhes sgra 'jug pa la byed do zhe na/ riṃgs/ dbyibs zhes sgra 'jug pa de chos can/ khyod 'jig rten gyi gnas lus skyes bus byas par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ skyes bus ma byas pa'i ri bo de khyod yin pa'i phyir/ dper na go zhes pa'i sgra 'jug pa'i rtags las ngag sogs don dgu po rwa can du sgrub pa bzhin no zhes brjod/

skyes bu chos can/ khyod kyi don thams cad 'bad med du grub par thal/ khyod kyi don zhes pa'i sgra yod na/ khyod kyi don yod pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'disaṃ/ dbyibs kyi ming don so sor brtags nas snod bcud skyes bus byas par sgrub pa'i rtags yin pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa de chos can/ ser skya pas skye 'jig can de blo bde sems med du sgrub pa dang*/ gcer bu pas shun pa shun nas 'chi ba de shing sems ldan du sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang (101) dag tu 'dod pa yang bkag pa yin te/ rtags kyi don rtsod gzhi la ma grub pa gtan tshigs yang dag tu mi rung bar bstan pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ rtags kyi ngo bor gtso bor grub/ ming las don nyid gtso bor grub pa'o// dang po ni/ dngoṃs/ rtags su dgod bya'i ngo bo rtsod gzhi la grub na/ khyad par ma grub kyang phyogs chos grub pa la mi gnod de/ nam mkha'i yon tan gyi byas pa sgra la ma grub kyang byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra/ཾ rtags kyi ming rtsod gzhi la ma grub kyang*/ don rtsod gzhi la rgol phyir rgol gnyis kyi ngor grub na/ phyogs chos grub par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas pas bye brag pa'i ngor/ 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran mi rtag par sgrub pa la lus can bkod pa'i tshe/ de de sgrub kyi rtags su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ deṃ/ rtags su dgod bya'i don sgrub chos la 'khrul pa sogs yin na gtan tshigs yang dag tu mi 'gyur te/ rtags kyi don las bsgrub bya'i don sgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro// 'groṃ/ dper na dkar zal rwa can du sgrub pa la 'gro ba rtags su bkod pa dang*/ sa srung glang chen du sgrub pa la lag ldan bkod pa'i tshe/ 'gro ba dang lag ldan chos can/ de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ khyod yin na rwa can dang glang chen yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/

so sor phral la dgod/ bzhi pa rang byung nyid kyi byed las dgag pa la bzhi ste/ gcig la rgyu dang rgyu min 'gal/ ldog pa med kyang rgyur mi 'thad/ rje 'gro med pas rgyur mi 'thad/ snga ma'i gtan tshigs ma nges spang ba'o// dang po ni/ jiṃ/ dbang phyug chos (102) can/ myu gu mi skyed pa'i tshe na yang myu gu'i rgyu yin par thal/ myu gu'i rgyur gyur pa'i rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ de chos can/ myu gu bskyed pa'i tshe na yang myu gu'i rgyu min par thal/ myu gu bskyed pa'i tshe na'ang myu gu mi skyed pa'i rang bzhin las khyad par med pa'i phyir/ mtshoṃn/ khyab ste/ gzhan du na sdong dum yang nag pa'i rma skye ba dang*/ 'drub ba'i rgyur thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na de gnyis kyi rgyu gang zhe na/ nag pa chos can/ khyod kyi rma skye ba dang 'drub ba'i rgyu yod de/ rang rgyu mtshon sogs las khyod kyi rma skye ba 'byung*/ rang rgyu sman sogs las khyod kyi rma 'drub pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtagaṃ dbang phyug chos can/ khyod la myu gu skye pa'i nus pa med pa thal/ khyod ldog pa'i stobs kyis myu gu ldog pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gangaṃ*/ myu gu chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu thug med du 'gyur bar thal/ khyod kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa min pa'i phyir te/ dbang phyug de yang khyod kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ phyi'i dpe yis ma nges spong*/ nang gi dpe yis ma nges spong ba'o// dang po ni/ gtan tshigs snga ma ma nges te/ myu gu bskyed ba'i sa sogs de myu gu mi skye pa'i sa sogs las rang bzhin khyad par med kyang myu gu'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ myu/ཾ myu gu bskyed pa'i sa sogs chos can/ khyod myu gu'i rgyur gyur pa la myu gu mi bskyed pa'i sa sogs las khyad par du 'gyur ba dgos te/ khyod rkyen gyis legs par byas pa'i khyad par las myu gu bzang ba'i khyad par mthong ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/

galaṃ/ yang snga ma'i gtan tshigs ma nges te/ dbang shes rkyen gsum tshogs pa de dbang shes kyi rkyen gsum (103) ma tshogs pa'i rang bzhin las khyad par med kyang dbang shes kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ minaṃ/ dbang shes kyi rkyen gsum chos can/ khyod tshogs pa de khyod ma tshogs pa las rang bzhin khyad par med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis myu gu'i rgyur gyur pa'i dbang phyug myu gu mi skyed pa las khyad par med kyang myu gu'i rgyur sgrub mi nus par thal/ khyod tshogs pa de yang khyod ma tshogs pa las khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro// soṃ/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod tshogs pa de khyod ma tshogs pa las khyad par med na khyod tshogs pa las dbang shes bskyed pa'i nus pa med par thal ba'i phyir ro// deṃ/ myu gu dang dbang shes sogs chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu rkyen tshogs pa de khyod kyi rgyu yin te/ khyod kyi rgyu rkyen tshogs ma tshogs las khyod bskyed mi bskyed kyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dbang phyug sogs khyod kyi rgyu min te/ dbang phyug sogs yod med la khyod skye mi skye ba'i khyad par med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de'i sgrub byed phun tshogs bshad pa la gnyis te/ sgrub byed med pa'i log rtog brjod/ log rtog bkag nas sgrub byed bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ tshadaṃ/ dpyod pa ba sogs na re/ bcom ldan 'das la tshad ma zhes dang*/ gyur pa zhes gnyis ka yang mi 'thad de/ skyes bu tshad ma yin na lkog gyur gyi don ma lus pa shes dgos pa las/ de med pa'i phyir dang*/ de sgrub byed kyi thabs kyang med pa'i phyir dang*/ thabs la nan tan byed pa'ang med pa'i phyir zhes zer ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ tshad ma med pa bkag nas tshad ma bsgrub/ sgrub byed med pa bkag nas sgrub byed bstan/ nan tan (104) ma byas bkag nas byas par bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dgos pa'i don kun shes ldan 'tshol bar 'thad/

de la don shes yod med dpyod par rigs/ don shes tshad mar gyur pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa'o// dang po ni/ miṃ/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi dpyod ldan chos can/ rang nyid 'dod pa'i don shes pa dang ldan pa'i shes ldan 'tshol ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ shes ldan des bstan pa'i rang gi 'dod pa'i don la nan tan bya dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ de chos can/ bshes gnyen de la 'dod pa'i don de shes pa yod med dpyod rigs kyi/ mi 'dod pa'i don shes pa yod med dpyod mi rigs te/ rang gi 'dod don sgrub pa'i ched du shes ldan 'tshol ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ blangaṃ*/ de chos can/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i skyes bu de khyod kyis bsten bya skyes bu tshad ma yin gyi/ thag ring po'i don mthong ba tsam de min te/ snga ma des khyod kyi 'dod don 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi ma de yin na bya rgod kyang bsten dgos par thal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ sgrub byed thugs rje rigs pas bsgrub/ de las sbyor ba 'byung ba'i tshul/ de las bder gshegs 'byung ba'i tshul/ de las skyob pa 'byung ba'i tshul/ des na sgrub byed yod par bsgrub pa'o/ dang po la gsum ste/ sgrub byed kyi ngo bo/ de'i rgyu/ de la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ sgrubaṃ/ bsgrub bya skyes bu tshad ma chos can/ khyod kyi sgrub byed yod de/ sems can thams can la snyoms par sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi thugs rje de khyod kyi sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gomaṃs/

(105) thugs rje de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu yod de/ skye ba du mar snying rje'i dmigs rnam goms pa las khyod skye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ goms pa mi srid 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa spang*/ srid kyang rang bzhin las 'das min pa spang ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dgod/ sun 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bloṃ/ chad lta ba na re/ snying rje chos can/ khyod skye ba du mar goms pa las thugs rje 'grub pa med de/ rtog bcas kyi blo lus la dngos su brten pas lus zhig pa na blo rgyun chad pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ maṃ/ snying rje chos can/ yid blo lus la dngos su brten pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis goms pa las grub pa med pa min te/ de la brten pa rigs pas bkag pa'i phyir/ ci ltar na/ skye/ཾ skyes ma thag pa'i dbugs 'byung rngub sogs chos can/ rigs 'dra snga ma sngon du ma song bar lus 'ba' zhig las skye ba ma yin te/ de ltar skye na rdo ba sogs la yang sems yod par ha cang thal ba'i phyir dang*/ tshe 'di'i rig pa snga ma phyi mar mtshams sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod kyang rigs 'dra snga ma sngon du song bar grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ha cang thal ba'i rigs pa rgyas par bshad/ mtshams sbyor 'gal ba med par rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ 'byung ba'i lus las skye na ha cang thal/ dbang bcas lus las skye na ha cang thal/ rtag pa'i lus las skye na ha cang thal ba'o// dang po ni/ gal te ha cang thal ba'i skyon med de/ 'byung ba 'ga' zhig sems sogs kyi sa bon yin zhing 'ga' (106) zhig ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gangaṃ*/ 'byung ba chos can/ khyod thams cad sems sogs kyi sa bon yin par thal/ khyod thams cad la rkyen gzhan tshogs na drod gsher skyes la sogs pa'i skye bo skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs te/

skyes ma thag pa'i dbang sogs rigs 'dra snga ma sngon du ma song bar 'byung na 'byung ba thams cad las dbang sogs skye dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ ldog na rgyu 'bras nyid du grub/ de la lung dang 'gal ba spang*/ rim gyis grub na khas blangs 'gal ba'o// dang po ni/ dbaṃng*/ lus yid blo'i dngos rten du 'dod na/ dbang po dang bcas pa'i lus yid blo'i dngos rten du 'dod dgos pas de ltar na/ yid blo chos can/ khyod mig sogs dbang po la dngos su brten pa min te/ de la gnod pa khyod la gnod pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mig sogs dbang po khyod la brten pa yin te/ khyod gzhan du gyur na dbang po gzhan du 'gyur bar mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ khyod la brten pa'i las las dbang po phyi ma 'byung pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ bdag 'dzin can 'chi kha tha ma'i yid blo chos can/ khyod las phyi ma'i dbang sogs 'byung ste/ khyod las de 'byung pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'o na lus dang sems dag phan tshun rjes su byed pa can yin no zhes gsungs pa'i lung dang 'gal lo zhe na/ deṃ/ de lta bu'i lung chos can/ yid blo lus la dngos su brten pa de khyod kyi zhen don min par thal/ khyod la yid blo brgyud nas brten pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ dbang po chos can/ khyod yid blo'i dngos rten yin te/ khyod med par yid blo med pa'i (107) phyir zhe na/ yid blo chos can/ khyod dbang po'i dngos rten du thal/ khyod med par dbang po med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dbang po dang yid blo chos can/ shi ba'i 'og tu phan tshun 'bras bu yin par thal/ shi kha tha ma'i tshe phan tshun rgyu 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ riṃm/ lus chos can/ khyod las yid blo rim can du skye ba min par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gal te rkyen la ltos nas yid blo rim can du bskyed do zhe na/

lus chos can/ rkyen la ltos pa min par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ lusaṃ/ gal te blo rim can la ltos nas lus las yid blo rim gyis skye'o zhe na/ de'iṃ/ lus chos can/ khyod kyi lus sems skad cig snga ma re res phyi ma re re bskyed par thal/ khyod kyi lus sems gnyis ka snga phyi'i rim pa can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'chi kha tha ma'i tshe na yang khyod kyi lus sems snga ma phyi ma'i rgyu yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshams sbyor 'gal ba med pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ 'chi sems yin pa'i rtags ma nges/ de yi mthun dpe chos kyis stong*/ mi stong pa yi sgrub byed dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ thaṃ/ rgyang 'phen pa na re/ tha mal pa 'chi kha tha ma'i sems chos can/ rig pa phyi mar mtshams mi sbyor te/ 'chi sems yin pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom pa'i 'chi sems bzhin no zhe na/ de chos can/ de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ khyod rig pa phyi ma dang mtshams sbyor ba 'gal ba ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dgra/ཾ dgra bcom pa'i 'chi sems chos (108) can/ khyod de sgrub kyi mthun dpe yang dag min te/ khyod rig pa phyi mar mtshams mi sbyor ba'i sgrub byed tshad ma med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ sangs rgyas pa yi lung gis grub pa dgag rgyang 'phen rang gi rigs pas grub pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ dgra/ཾ dgra bcom pa'i 'chi sems rig pa phyi mar mtshams mi sbyor bar sangs rgyas pa'i lung gis grub pa dper brjod do zhe na/ khyodaṃ/ rgyang 'phen pa chos can/ sangs rgyas pa'i lung la brten nas dgra bcom pa'i 'chi sems rig pa phyi mar mtshams mi sbyor bar 'dod mi rigs par thal/ de lung tshad ma min par 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ 'dod pa brjod de 'dri bar dgod/ 'gog byed rigs pa rgyas par bshad/ de la 'khrul pa'i rtsod pa spang*/

bkag pas grub pa'i mjug sdud bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ dgra bcom pa'i 'chi sems chos can/ rig pa phyi mar mtshams mi sbyor te/ rig pa phyi mar mtshams sbyor ba'i rgyu lus dang bral ba'i phyir zhe na/ de nyid don gyi sgrub byed cis ma brjod/ de brjod do zhe na/ gnyis pa la drug ste/ lus nyid yid blo'i dngos rgyu yin pa dgag lus sems nyer len can gyi rgyu 'bras dgag skyed byed min pa'i rten dang brten pa dgag rigs pa gzhan gyis lus sems rgyu 'bras dgag /yid blo lus kyi rang bzhin yin pa dgag lus la brten nas yid blo bskyed pa dgag pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dngos rgyu yin pa brtags nas dgag rgyu tsam yin yang ldog byed min/ dngos rgyu yin na ha cang thal ba'o// dang po ni/ deṃ// (109) yid blo lus las dngos su skye na/ dbang po dang bcas pa'i lus las dngos su skye'am/ dbang po med pa'i lus las dngos su skye/ dang po ltar na/ yid blo chos can/ dbang shes kyi yul gsal bar snang bar thal/ dbang po dang bcas pa'i lus las dngos su skyes pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ shesaṃ/ mig sogs dbang po kun chos can/ khyod las yid blo gcig skye ba med par thal/ khyod kyis rang gi bdag 'bras su rgyur pa'i shes pa tha dad du bskyed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na// semaṃs/ dbang po med pa'i lus chos can/ khyod las rang gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i yid blo mi skye bar thal/ khyod bem po yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu/ཾ lus can gyi yid blo dang lus gnyis chos can/ dngos kyi rten dang brten pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lhan cig gnas pa ma yin te/ dngos rgyu tshogs pa gcig la rag las kyi 'brel pa grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lhan cig gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyi dbang po lnga dang tshogs pa gcig pa'i ro gzugs bzhin/ gnyis pa ni/ rtagaṃ yid blo chos can/
