khyod kyi ngo bo skyed byed kyi rgyu de ldog na khyod ldog pas khyab ste/ de la dgongs nas 'di yod na zhes pa'i tshig dang*/ 'di skyes pa'i phyir zhes pa'i lnga pa'i tshigs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'ga'aṃ/ yid blo chos can/ lus kyis khyod kyi khyad par la phan 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lus ldog pas khyod ldog pa mi 'thad par thal/ de 'thad na/ me ldog pas rdza bum ldog par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ ha cang thal ba'i rigs pa dgod/ mthun rkyen med (110) pa'i gzhan lan dgag 'gal rkyen yod pa'i gzhan lan dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ lusaṃ/ de rgyu zhes pa'i don lus sems kyi dngos rgyur 'dod na/ shi lus chos can/ sems gnas par thal/ lus gnas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shi lus la sems kyi mthun rkyen dbugs med pas sems med do zhe na/ reṃ/ dbugs 'byung rngub chos can/ khyod rang rgyu sems las 'byung ste/ khyod rang rgyu sems phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ sems chos can/ khyod dbugs 'byung rngub kyi nyer len las byung ba min te/ de yin na dbugs 'byung rngub 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su khyod 'phel 'grib byed par thal ba'i phyir/ nyes pa de khyod la'ang mtshungs so zhe na/ semaṃs/ slob dpon chos grags chos can/ shi lus la sems gnas par thal ba'i skyon khyod la med de/ khyod sems phyi ma gnas pa'i rgyur sems snga ma dang las gnyis ka dgos par khas blangs pa'i mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ 'dod pa brjod de gnod byed bstan/ dpe la brten pa'i nyes spong dgag rigs pa'i rnam grangs bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ 'gal rkyen nad kyis gnod pa byas pa'i lus la sems gnas par thal ba'i skyon med do zhe na/ dug gi shi ba'i shi lus chos can/ sems gnas par thal/ sems gnas pa'i mthun rkyen lus tshang zhing 'gal rkyen dug dang bral ba'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ shi lus la sems gnas pa'i 'gal rkyen dug ldog kyang sems slar ldog pa mi srid de/ me ldog kyang shing gi 'gyur ba slar shing du mi ldog pa bzhin no zhe na/ lus (111) kyi 'gyur ba chos can/ khyod shing tshig pa dang 'dra bar gsor mi rung ba min par thal/ khyod gso ba'i thabs yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'gyur ba skyed byed kyi rgyu la ldog mi rung gi 'gyur ba bskyed pa dang*/ ldog rung gi 'gyur ba skyed byed gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ slar ldog tu mi rung la/ phyi ma ni slar ldog tu rung ba'i phyir/ dper na mes shing la byas pa'i 'gyur ba dang*/ gser la byas pa'i 'gyur ba bzhin no// cungaṃ*/ 'o na sman gyi bstan bcos las gsor mi rung ba'i nad pa bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ltar bshad pa chos can/ nad pa nad kyi nyes pa 'ba' zhig gis shi ba la dgongs nas gsungs pa min te/ nad 'chos pa'i mthun rkyen rnyed par dka' ba'am nad pa'i tshe zad pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ shiṃ/ shi lus la dug dang nad sogs dang bral lam/ dug 'dus pa'i rma kha'i sha bcad pa'i shi lus chos can/ sems gnas par thal/ sems gnas pa'i mthun rkyen tshang zhing 'gal rkyen dang bral ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ nyer len yin na ldog pa grub/ ldog pa med na nyer len min/ de gnyis skabs kyi don la sbyar/ lhan cig gnas dang 'gal ba spang ba'o// dang po ni/ nyeraṃ/ nyer len gyi rgyu de 'gyur ba med na nyer lan can 'gyur ba med de/ 'jim par 'gyur ba med par rdza bum 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dngoṃs/ rgyu de 'gyur ba med par 'bras bu de 'gyur ba'i rgyu de yin na 'bras bu de'i nyer len ma yin dgos te/ ba glang 'gyur ba med par ba min 'gyur ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ba glang de ba min gyi nyer len min pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni// (112) semaṃs/

sems chos can/ lus de khyod kyi nyer len min te/ lus 'gyur ba med par yang khyod 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ lus sems nyer len dang nyer len can gyi rgyu 'bras ma yin na lhan cig gnas pa 'gal lo zhe na/ deṃ/ lus can gyi lus sems chos can/ nyer len dang nyer len can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lhan cig gnas pa min te/ dngos rgyu tshogs pa gcig la rag las kyi 'brel pa grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lhan cig gnas pa yin pa phyir/ dper na zangs ma'i zhu ba dang tsha ba bzhin/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ gzhan lan dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ yodaṃ/ lus chos can/ yid blo'i dngos rten min par thal/ rang dus na yod pa'i yid blo'i dngos rten yang min/ rang dus na med pa'i yid blo'i dngos rten yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ grub zin gnas pa'i tshul gyis brten pa dgag /grub zin gnas par byed pa'i mthun dpe dgag tshul des grub zin gnas pa gzhan yang khegs/ gnas rgyus gnas pa 'gog byed rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rnam par brtags nas dgag ha cang thal bas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ yodaṃ/ gtan tshigs dang po ma grub bo zhe na/ 'diṃ/ lus chos can/ sems kyi gnas pa'i rgyu min te/ sems kyi gnas pa sems dang rdzas gcig pa yang mi 'thad cing*/ de dang rdzas tha dad yang mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ sems chos can/ khyod kyi gnas pa de lus kyis bskyed pa ma yin par thal/ khyod sems dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub (113) na/ lus chos can/ khyod kyis sems gnas par ma byas par thal/ khyod sems las rdzas gzhan pa'i sems kyi gnas pa'i rgyu tsam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jiṃg sems chos can/ mi 'jig par thal/ mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu lus rtag tu gnas pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/

galaṃ/ lus kyis sems mi 'jig par byed kyang sems de 'jig rgyus 'jig pas skyon med do zhe na/ phyis kyi 'jig rgyu chos can/ sems kyi 'jig pa'i rgyu min par thal/ sems kyi 'jig pa sems dang rdzas gcig dang rdzas gzhan gang rung min pa'i phyir/ lus chos can/ sems mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu min par thal/ 'jig rgyu dang ma phrad na khyod med kyang sems mi 'jig pa gnas/ 'jig rgyu dang phrad na khyod yod kyang sems mi gnas pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ 'jig rgyu dang phrad kyi bar du sems mi 'jig par gnas par byed pas skyon med do zhe na/ sems chos can/ lus des khyod 'jig rgyu dang phrad kyi bar du gnas par byed mi nus par thal/ khyod rang grub tsam nas 'jig nges yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ lus de sems grub zin gnas pa'i rten byed pa'i dpe yod de/ chu grub zin gnas pa'i rten bum pa dang*/ yon tan dang*/ spyi la sogs pa'i grub zin gnas pa'i rten rdzas yin pa bzhin no zhe na/ 'diṃ/ bum sogs chos can/ khyod chu sogs mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rten min par thal/ de la yang sngar gyi nyes pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na de dag la rten dang brten pa'i tha snyad mthong ba ci ltar zhe na/ dngosaṃ// (114) bum sogs chos can/ chu sogs mi 'jig par gnas par byed pa'i sgo nas rten min te/ chu sogs skad cig snga phyi go sa mtshungs par bskyed pa'i sgo nas rten du 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'boṃ/ chu chos can/ khyod la rten don gzhan dgos te/ khyod thur du 'bo ba'i gegs byed pa'i rdzas dgos pa'i phyir/ yon tan dang spyi la sogs pa chos can/ khyod la rten don gzhan mi dgos te/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'diṃs/ grub zin gnas pa'i rten dang brten pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ 'phrod 'du'i 'brel ba dang*/ rigs sogs mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rten yang bsal ba'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/

galaṃ/ dngos po thams cad chos can/ khyod mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu don med par thal/ khyod 'jig rgyu don gzhan gyis 'jig na mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu la dgos pa med cing*/ 'jig rgyu don gzhan med par 'jig na/ mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu la nus pa med pa'i phyir/ rtenaṃ/ dngos po thams cad chos can/ khyod 'jig pa mi srid par thal/ khyod yin na/ mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rten dang bcas pas khyab pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ sems la sogs pa'i dngos po thams cad chos can/ khyod mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu med par thal/ khyod rang nyid gnas pa'i ngang tshul yin pa dang*/ min pa gang yang mi 'jig par gnas pa'i rgyu mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la bzhi te/ rgyu gzhan 'gog pa'i gtan tshigs dgod/ mi mthun phyogs la ldog khyab pa bsgrub/ gtan tshigs ma grub smra ba dgag rang rgyu sgrub byed bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po ni//

(115) lusaṃ/ shes rab dang snying rje sogs chos can/ lus kyi nyer len las byung ba min te/ lus 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su 'phel 'grib mi byed par/ blo snga ma 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su 'phel 'grib byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃ/ khyab ste/ sngar gyi gtan tshigs de mar me'i 'od la yod pa min pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ lus dar rgud las shes rab gsal mi gsal du skye ba'i phyir zhe na/ deṃ/ lus dar rgud las byung ba'i shes rab kyi khyad par de chos can/ khyod lus las dngos su skyes pa min te/ khyod lus las brgyud nas skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ lus dar rgud las chags sdang skye ba'i phyir zhe na/ 'ga'aṃ/ lus dar rgud las byung ba'i chags sdang chos can/ khyod lus las dngos su skyes pa min te/ khyod lus dar rgud las byung ba'i tshor ba bde sdug las skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'diṃs/ yid blo chags sogs lus las dngos su mi skye bar bstan pa'i rigs pa de chos can/ 'dus pa'i rims nad sogs kyis dran pa nyams pa'i shes pa de yang lus las dngos su mi skye bar bshad pa yin te/ de yang lus las byung ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal las byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ dpeṃ/ dran pa nyams pa sogs kyi rgyu yin na/ de'i nyer len yin pas ma khyab ste/ stag ces pa'i sgra thos pa dang*/ gzhan bsad pa'i khrag mthong ba las dran pa nyams pa dang rmongs pa sogs skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ deṃ/ shes rab dang snying rje sogs chos can/ rang gi nyer len sems snga ma las 'byung ba yin te/ de phan byed du yod (116) med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la gsum ste/ lus sems gcig pa ha cang thal bas dgag log sred sngon song rang rgyud rtags kyis bsgrub/ ma mthong tsam gyis snga phyi med pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/

jiṃ/ lus chos can/ khyod la yang thos sogs kyi yon tan gsal bar 'gyur bar thal/ de sems la gsal ba gang zhig khyod sems dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bdaṃg tha mal pa chos can/ log sred kyi blo sngon du song ba yin te/ gzhan gyis dbang med du dkri ba min par dman pa'i gnas su skye ba blangs pa'i phyir/ sdugaṃ khyab ste/ log sred gnyis po de yang srid skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ yang srid kyi skye ba de de phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ skye ba snga phyi med de/ skye ba snga phyi'i bar gyi lus ma mthong ba'i phyir zhe na/ rgyang 'phen pa chos can/ khyod kyis ma mthong ba tsam gyis skye srid snga phyi'i bar gyi lus med par mi 'grub par thal/ khyod dbang po mi gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis skye srid snga phyi'i bar gyi lus mi mthong pa'i phyir te/ mig mi gsal bar du ba chung ngu yod kyang mi mthong ba bzhin/ gal te skye ba len pa'i sems can de chos can/ skye gnas su thogs med du mi 'jug par thal/ lus can yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ lusaṃ/ bar do'i lus sems chos can/ khyod skye gnas su thogs med du 'jug ste/ khyod gnyis shin tu dwangs pa'i lus yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skye gnas su thogs med du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rdza gsar pa la chu dang*/ 'dul sbyong byas pa'i gser la dngul chu bzhin no// gal te mngal du 'jug (117) pa ma mthong ba'i phyir med ce na/ maṃ/ dbang po mi gsal zhes pa'i sbyor ba la bsgres la dgod/ drug pa la gnyis te/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig rgyur mi 'thad/ yan lag du ma'i lus rgyur mi 'thad pa'o/ dang po la gsum ste/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig dgag de la ha cang thal ba spang*/ gzhan gyi phyogs la sun 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ lag lus sems kyi nyer len yin na rags pa rdzas gcig pa'i lus yin nam/

rdul phran du ma'i lus gang yin/ dang po ltar na skye bu'i lus chos can/ khyod yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig ma yin te/ khyod g.yo mi g.yo dang*/ sgrib ma sgrib dang*/ tshon gyis bsgyur ma bsgyur gyi cha du ma dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ha cang thal ba brjod/ de yi sun 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ du/ཾ bye brag pa na re/ lus dang bum sogs yan lag can rdzas gcig med par rdul phran du ma yin na/ lus bum chos can/ dbang shes kyis rtogs pa dang sgrib thogs nus pa min par thal/ dbang shes kyi yul las 'das shing sgrib thogs mi nus pa'i sngar gyi rdul phran dang khyad med gcig yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sngar gyi rdul phran nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rags pa ma brtsams pa'i dus kyi rdul phran nyid bzhin no zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ khyad med phra rab rtags ma grub// grub na gzhan gyi phyogs la mtshungs pa'o// dang po ni/ khyadaṃ/ skyes bu'i lus chos can/ sngar gyi rdul phran dang khyad par med pa min te/ sngar gyi rdul phran de rdul phran gzhan dang phrad pa las rdul phran khyad par can du skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ rdul phran (118) khyad par can de chos can/ khyod rdul phran yin yang rdul phran gyi tha snyad byed pa min te/ khyod rang 'bras dbang shes kyi gzung yul yin yang dbang shes la rags pa'i rnam pa snang ba'i phyir/ khyad med phyir dang phra rab phyir// zhes pa'i gtan tshigs ma grub par bstan pa'i rigs pa de chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ gnyis po rgyu mtshan du byas nas lus sogs la sgrib thogs med par thal ba'i skyon bsal ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dngulaṃ/ dngul chu dang gser 'dres pa'am rdo tshon gyi gong bu de chos can/ rang 'bras dbang shes la mi snang bar thal/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med par rdul du ma yin pa'i phyir/ dbang shes kyi rkyen gsum chos can/ rang 'bras dbang shes dngos su mi skyed par thal/

ma tshogs pa'i rkyen gsum so so ba dang khyad par med pa'i phyir/ gnyis char gyi rtags khas/ ldanaṃ/ gal te rkyen gsum tshang bas ldan pa bskyed/ des dbang shes bskyed do zhe na/ rkyen gsum tshogs pa chos can/ ldan pa dngos su bskyed mi nus par thal/ ma tshogs pa'i rkyen so so ba dang khyad par med pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te gser dang dngul chu 'dres pa la yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med kyang rdul rigs mi mthun pa phrad pa'i ldan pa yod pas de dbang shes la dngos su snang ba yin no zhe na/ dbang shes chos can/ gser dang dngul chu 'dres pa'i ldan pa mi rtogs par thal/ ldan pa'i rten gser dang dngul chu 'dres pa de ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ roṃ/ bur chang sbyar ba'i btung ba chos can/ khyod la ro gzugs sogs kyi ldan pa med par thal/ khyod yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ gal te de la ro gzugs dngos (119) med kyang de dang ro gzugs dngos gnyis btung ba'i rdul la 'phrod pa 'du ba'i phyir ro gzugs yod ces nye bar btags pa yin no zhe na/ bur chang sbyar ba'i btung ba'i ro gzugs chos can/ khyod blo ma 'khrul pa la ro gzugs dngos las rnam pa tha dad du snang bar thal/ khyod ro gzugs btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir/ bya rgya tshar du dngar ba'i phreng ba chos can/ khyod la ring po zhes pa'i tha snyad btags nas kyang mi 'jug par thal/ khyod la ring po don gzhan med cing*/ ring po dang don gcig la 'dus pa yang med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ grangs sogs rdzas las tha dad yod pa dgag tha dad med pa'i phyogs la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ tha dad med pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ tha dad yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag de la gzhan gyis nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ bum pa'i grangs dang ldan pa sogs chos can/ rdzas bum pa dang de brjod pa'i ming las don gzhan du med de/ de las don gzhan du tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ bum pa'i grangs sogs chos can/ bum pa las rdzas tha dad du yod de/ bum pa las sgra rtog tha dad du 'jug pa'i phyir zhe na/ sgra/ཾ bum pa dang bum pa'i grangs sogs kyi yul can gyi sgra rtog chos can/ bum pa dang bum pa'i grangs sogs rdzas gzhan pa'i dbang gis 'jug pa min te/ de gnyis ldog pa gzhan yin pa'i dbang gis 'jug pa'i phyir te/ dper na yon tan sogs dang 'das ma 'ongs gnyis las/ grangs sogs don gzhan du med kyang*/ de dang grangs sogs kyi sgra rtog tha dad du 'jug pa bzhin no// gsum (120) pa ni/ galaṃ/ yon tan la grangs sogs kyi sgra btags ming du 'jug pas skyon med do zhe na/ dngos po thams cad chos can/ grangs kyi sgra btags ming du 'jug par thal/ yon tan la grangs kyi sgra btags ming du 'jug pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan khyad par med pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ dngos po kun la grangs kyi sgra btags ming du 'jug pa min te/ grangs don gzhan khyad par byed chos su yod pa la grangs kyi sgra dngos ming du 'jug de med pa la btags ming du 'jug pa'i phyir zhe na/ grangs kyi sgra chos can/ grangs don gzhan khyad par byed chos su yod med kyi khyad par gyis dngos ming dang btags ming du 'jug pa'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ khyod las grangs 'khrul med du go ba'i yul de la khyod dngos ming du 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sgra gzhan don med 'gyur ba spong*/ drug sgra mi srid 'gyur ba spong ba'o// dang po ni/ thaṃ/ bum pa dang bum pa'i grangs sogs kyi sgra rnams chos can/ rnam grangs par thal/ brjod bya don gzhan med pa la 'jug pa'i ming du ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ yon tan dkar po sogs dang*/ de'i grangs sogs brjod pa'i sgra chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ galaṃ/ yon tan dkar po sogs la'ang grangs sogs don gzhan du yod pas gtan tshigs ma grub bo zhe na/ yon tan chos can/

khyod rdzas dang khyad med du 'gyur bar thal/ yon tan gzhan gyi rten byed pa zhes pa'i rdzas kyi mtshan nyid de khyod kyi rang ldog la brten pa'i phyir/ doṃn/ bum pa dang bum pa'i grangs sogs kyi sgra chos can/ brjod bya don gzhan med kyang rnam grangs pa min te/ brjod bya ldog pa tha dad la 'jug pa'i phyir/ (121) dper na spyi las min rdzas las min zhes pa'i sgra bzhin no// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ chos dang chos can brjod pa'i 'jug tshul bshad/ rigs dang tshogs pa brjod pa'i 'jug tshul bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bum pa'i grangs sogs chos can/ drug pa'i sgras bum pa las tha dad du brjod pa mi rigs par thal/ bum pa las don la tha dad du med pa'i phyir zhe na/ dngoṃs/ bum pa'i grangs sogs chos can/ khyod brjod pa'i chos brjod kyi sgras khyod bum pa las tha dad du bstan pa brjod bya rdzas gzhan pa'i dbang gis 'jug pa min te/ de bum pa la khyad par gzhan spang ba'i ched du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ chos gzhan spangs nas bum pa'i grangs tsam shes par 'dod pa'i nyan pa po la bum pa'i grangs zhes brjod pa'i sgra chos can/ khyod kyis bum pa'i grangs de bum pa las tha dad par brjod kyang*/ de tsam gyis de gnyis don gzhan du mi 'grub ste/ khyod de gnyis ldog pa gzhan yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas de gnyis tha dad du brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na sor mo'i ldan pa zhes brjod pas sor mo dang ldan pa don gzhan du mi 'grub pa bzhin/ doṃn/ bum pa gcig ces pa'i sgra chos can/ khyod dang bum pa'i grangs zhes pa'i sgra gnyis kas don gcig brjod kyang*/ khyod chos can brjod pa'i sgrar grags pa yin te/ khyod kyis bum pa'i khyad chos thams cad brjod byar 'phangs pa las chos can brjod pa'i sgrar brda byas pa'i phyir/ dper na sor mo ldan par 'gyur zhes pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'o na tshogs pa brjod pa dang rigs brjod pa'i khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/

gzugasaṃ/ bum pa zhes pa'i sgra chos can/ (122) khyod bum pa'i rdul rdzas brgyad la ltos nas tshogs brjod kyi sgra yin te/ bum pa'i rdul rdzas brgyad kyi so so'i nus pa brjod byar spangs nas thun mong gi nus pa brjod byar byed pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ desaṃ/ khyod dang khyod kyi gzugs la gzhi mthun gyi sgra don mthun mi rung ste/ khyod ces pa'i sgras khyod kyi gzugs brjod byar spang ba'i phyir/ desaṃ/ bum pa chos can/ rigs dang tshogs pa brjod pa'i sgra chos can/ khyod kyi khyad par grub pa yin te/ rigs can brjod byar mi spong ba dang*/ tshogs pa can brjod byar mi spong ba de khyod kyi khyad par yin pa'i phyir/ gal te bum pa'i gzugs sogs don la tha dad med na bum pa'i gzugs zhes pa'i sgras tha dad du brjod pa dgos pa med par 'gyur ro zhe na/ deṃ/ bum pa'i gzugs zhes bya ba'i sgra chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bum pa'i gzugs kyi rang 'dzin mig shes bskyed pa'i nus pa bye brag tu ston pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ tsandan gyi dri zhes pa'i sgra la yang sbyar ro// gnyis pa yan lag du ma nyid kyang rgyur mi 'thad pa la gnyis te/ yan lag tshogs pa rgyur mi 'thad/ yan lag re re rgyu mi 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ lus kyi yan lag du ma yid blo'i dngos rgyu yin no zhe na/ yan lag thams cad tshogs pa'am/ re re ba yin/ dang po ltar na/ maṃ/ yid blo chos can/ lus kyi yan lag gang rung gcig dang bral na khyod mi bskyed par thal/ lus kyi yan lag kun tshogs pa de khyod kyi dngos rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gnod byed thal ba brjod/ de yi nyes spong dgag rang la mtshungs pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ phyogs gnyis pa ltar na/ reṃ/ lus can gcig la chos can/ yid blo (123) rdzas rgyun du ma gcig car 'byung bar thal/ lus kyi yan lag du ma cig car yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/

dbugs gcig yid blo'i rgyur mi 'thad/ du ma yid blo'i rgyur mi 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ dbugs 'byung rngub gcig kho na yin pas yid blo re re kho na skye bar nges pa yin no zhe na/ duṃ/ dbugs 'byung rngub chos can/ khyod gcig kho na yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yid blo re re kho na skye ba nges par min par thal/ khyod du ma yin pa'i phyir/ gal te ma grub ste/ dbugs dang lus rtag pa gcig nyid kyis yid blo rim gyis bskyed pa'i phyir zhe na/ gcigaṃ lus can gcig la chos can/ yid blo rdzas rgyun du ma gcig car 'byung bar thal/ dbugs dang lus rtag pa du ma gcig car yod pa'i phyir ro// galaṃ/ gal te yid blo cig car bskyed pa ma yin gyi/ rim gyis bskyed pa yin no zhe na/ dbugs dang lus rtag pa chos can/ yid blo rim gyis kyang mi skyed par thal/ sngar yid blo mi skyed pa dang khyad par med pa'i phyir/ dbugasaṃ/ dbugs 'byung rngub de chos can/ khyod gcig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yid blo gcig kho nar nges pa min par thal/ khyod gcig gi yun tshad la yid blo du ma skye ba'i phyir/ duṃ/ gal te ma grub ste don du ma yid blo cha med gcig gis shes pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir phran gcig chags 'dug /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ du ma rim

(124) gyis 'byung bas bskyed pa dgag du ma cig car 'byung bas bskyed pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ rangaṃ*/ gal te lus rtag pa las rim gyis 'byung ba'i dbugs rim can des/ yid blo skad cig rim can du skyed par byed pa yin no zhe na/ goṃ dbugs rim can chos can/ rim can du mi skyed par thal/ rim can du bskyed pa'i rgyu med pa'i phyir/ raṃng*/ gal te rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma las rim can du skye'o zhe na/ lus can chos can/ dbugs skad cig dang po mi 'byung bar thal/ dbugs skad cig dang po bskyed pa'i rigs 'dra snga ma med pa'i phyir/ dbugasaṃ/ dbugs chos can/ khyod du mar thal/ khyod 'byung sa du ma nas 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lus can gcig la chos can/ yid rdzas rgyun du ma cig car skye bar thal/ dbugs du ma cig car skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ gal te dbugs du ma dus gcig tu tshogs pa de yid blo gcig gi rgyu yin pas yid blo du ma cig car mi skye'o zhe na/ yid blo chos can/ dbugs kyi cha shas gcig ma tshang na yang khyod mi skye bar thal/ dbugs kyi cha shas ma lus pa tshogs pa de khyod kyi dngos rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ ciṃ/ dbugs kyi yan lag ci ltar yod pa bzhin yid blo'i rgyu yin pas skyon med do zhe na/ lus can chos can/ dbugs rgyu ba drag zhan las yid blo drag zhan du 'gyur bar thal/ dbugs rgyu ba drag zhan ci ltar yod pa bzhin yid blo'i dngos rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ chos de 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su 'phel 'grib mi byed na/ chos de'i nyer len las byung ba ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rang la mtshungs pa spong ba ni/ rtog pa du (125) ma cig car du skye bar thal ba'i nyes pa de khyod la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ rnamaṃ/ rtog pa chos can/ khyod du ma cig car skye ba min te/ khyod snga ma re res phyi ma re re bskyed pa'i nus pa nges pa'i phyir/

gtan tshigs grub ste/ rtog pa sgra la lhag par chags pa'i tshe/ gzugs 'dzin mig shes skye ba'i de ma thag rkyen gyi nus pa nyams pas gzugs 'dzin mig shes mi skye ba'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te dang por lus las yin blo du ma cig car skyes nas phyis yid blo snga ma re res phyi ma re re kho na bskyed pa yin no zhe na/ lus chos can/ phyis yid blo du ma cig car bskyed pa'i nus pa ldog pa de mi 'thad par thal/ sngar yid blo du ma cig car bskyed nus pa gang zhig khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de la 'khrul pa'i rtsod pa spong ba la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ lus can shi pa'i sa na chos can/ sems 'ba' zhig yan gar du gnas par thal/ sems gnas pa gang zhig rten lus med pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ skye mched phyi ma'i rgyu gnyis bshad/ mtshams sbyor med pa'i sgrub byed dgag mtshams sbyor 'thad pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ bdag 'dzin can gyi skyes bu chos can/ shi ba'i 'og tu sems 'ba' zhig yan gar du gnas pa'i skyon med de/ 'chi kha tha ma'i sems de phyi ma'i lus kyi lhan cig byed rkyen du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'o na tshe phyi ma'i lus kyi nyer len gang zhe na/ tsheṃ/ phyi ma'i lus chos can/ khyod kyi nyer len yod de/ rang gi nyer len 'chi kha tha ma'i dbang po'i skye mched (126) las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ 'chi kha'i lus sems chos can/ lus sems phyi ma'i rgyu rkyen min te/ lus sems phyi ma'i rgyu rkyen du ma dmigs pa'i phyir zhe na/ de chos can/ de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs yang dag ma yin pa bshad zin pa'i phyir/ gal te ma dmigs pas mi khegs kyang dbang po yin pa dang*/ sems yin pa sogs kyi rtags kyis khegs so zhe na/ dbang po yin pa sogs chos can/ khyod 'chi kha'i dbang po dbang po phyi ma'i nyer len min par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag min te/

khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi khyab pa ma nges pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dbaṃng*/ 'chi kha'i dbang po chos can/ rkyen gzhan tshang zhing gegs med na dbang po phyi ma bskyed de/ rkyen gzhan tshang zhing gegs med na dbang po phyi ma bskyed pa'i nus pa nges pa'i phyir/ tshe 'di'i dbang po snga mas phyi ma bskyed pa bzhin/ galaṃ/ tshe 'di'i dbang po de dbang po snga ma las mi skyed par lus rtag pa las skye ba yin no zhe na/ lus can gcig la chos can/ dbang po'i rigs 'dra du ma cig car skye bar thal/ de'i dngos rgyu lus rtag pa yod pa'i phyir/ semaṃs/ gal te tshe 'di'i dbang po sems las skye ba yin no zhe na/ tshe phyi ma'i dbang po yang chos can/ sems las skye bar thal/ tshe 'di'i dbang po sems las skye ba gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bkag pas grub pa'i mjug sdud bstan pa ni/ desaṃ/ tha mal pa dang dgra bcom pa 'chi kha ma'i sems chos can/ nyer len rgyu lus dbugs dang bral ba de khyod rig pa phyi ma mtshams mi sbyor ba sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag min te/ de de ltar sgrub (127) pa'i ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa srid kyang rang bzhin las 'das pa min pa spong ba la gsum ste/ dpe la brten pa'i rtsod pa dgod/ gzhan gyis bkod pa'i dpe don dgag rang phyogs 'thad pa'i dpe don bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gomaṃs/ snying rje goms pa las khyad par cung zad 'phel yang mtha' med du 'phel ba min te/ mchongs pa dang chu yi drod mtha' med du 'phel ba ma yin pa bzhin no zhe na/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ dpe la mtha' med 'phel ba'i khyad par med/ don la mtha' med 'phel ba'i khyad par yod/ dpe la don dang mtshungs pa'i rtsod pa spang*/ don la ha cang thal ba'i rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ byasaṃ/ mchongs pa chos can/ khyod goms pa las mtha' med du 'phel ba min te/ khyod kyi rgyu de la khyod mtha' med du 'phel ba bskyed pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir te/

khyod goms zin lus kyi 'bad rtsol bskyar ma la ltos pa'i phyir/ chu drod chos can/ khyod mtha' med du 'phel ba men te/ khyod kyi rgyu de la mtha' med du 'phel ba bskyed pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi rten chu de rgyun mi brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gangaṃ*/ brtse sogs chos can/ goms rkyen dang ma bral bar goms par byas na mtha' med du 'phel te/ lus kyi 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par sems rgyud la goms pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ dper na mes shing rang gi ngang gis sreg pa dang*/ gser la dngul chu rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa bzhin no// desaṃ/ brtse sogs chos can/ goms rkyen dang ma bral par goms par byas na mtha' med du 'phel te/ rang gi rigs mthun snga ma las 'phel ba'i sems kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sems kyi yon tan yin na rten brtan pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ brtse sogs rigs 'dra snga ma las 'phel ba ltar mchongs (128) pa yang rigs 'dra snga ma las 'phel bar mtshungs so zhe na/ deṃ/ mchongs pa chos can/ khyod rigs 'dra snga ma las 'phel ba min te/ khyod kyi rgyu lus kyi stobs dang 'bad rtsol tshad nges pas khyod kyang tshad nges pa'i phyir/ 'o na dang po nas phyis byang ba'i dus bzhin du mchongs par 'gyur ro zhe na/ deṃ/ mchongs pa goms pa'i skyes bu chos can/ dang po nas phyis byang ba'i dus bzhin du mchongs pa min te/ dang por khyod kyi lus 'gal rkyen gyis mchongs pa dang mi mthun par byas pa'i phyir dang*/ phyis mi mthun pa bsal nas yang rang gi lus kyi stobs nyid du mchongs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ brtse sogs rigs 'dra snga ma las 'phel na tha mal pa rnams la brtse sogs 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ brtseṃ/ tha mal pa chos can/ khyod las brtse sogs mtha' med du mi 'phel te/ khyod kyi sems rgyud la 'gal rkyen zhe sdang gis gnod pa byas pa'i phyir/

'gal rkyen zhe sdang med na mtha' med du 'phel bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'diṃ/ brtse sogs chos can/ 'gal rkyen med cing mthun rkyen tshang ba'i sgo nas goms na mtha' med du 'phel te/ de ltar goms na khyod snga ma des khyod phyi ma gsal ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gomasaṃ/ brtse sogs goms pa las sems rgyud brtse sogs kyi bdag nyid du 'gyur ba chos can/ khyod kyi mthun dpe yang dag yod de/ chags bral sogs goms pa las sems rgyud chags bral sogs kyi bdag nyid du 'gyur ba de khyod kyi mthun dpe yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de las ston pa 'byung ba'i tshul la bzhi ste/ brtse bas ston pa drangs pa'i tshul/ ston pa'i dmigs rnam sbyong ba'i tshul/ dmigs rnam goms par ston par bstan/ des na bsam sbyor rgyu ru grub pa'o// dang po ni/ brtseṃ/ sems (129) rgyud snying rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i brtse ldan de chos can/ bden bzhi dngos su rtogs pa'i thabs la sbyor bar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir du bden bzhi bstan dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden bzhi rang la lkog tu gyur na/ bden bzhi gzhan la phyin ci ma log par ston mi nus pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spang bya'i rgyu dang rang bzhin dpyad/ de rgyu gzhom phyir gnyen po dpyad/ dpyad pas grub pa'i spang gnyen bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ lungaṃ*/ brtse ldan chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yod pa dang*/ mi rtag pa yin par dpyad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sdug bsngal spang bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu med pa dang*/ rtag pa yin na sdug bsngal spong mi nus pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ brtse ldan chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i gnyen po dpyad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu gzhom par 'dod pa'i phyir/ rgyu/

de chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i gnyen po shes par 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu shes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdaṃg bdag 'dzin las byung ba'i sred pa chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin te/ sdug bsngal rang dbang du bskyed pa'i phyir/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i gnyen po yin te/ bdag 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnamaṃs/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lam bskal pa grangs med gsum du goms par byed pa'i blo chos can/ (130) goms rkyen dang ma bral bar goms par byed na bden bzhi'i gnas tshul la gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin pa 'byung ste/ rten brtan/ goms pa rang gi ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul goms pa yin pa'i phyir/ desaṃ/ ston pa sangs rgyas chos can/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ma lus pa spangs pa yin te/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul la thugs gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin pa yin pa'i phyir/ thubaṃ/ de chos can/ bse ru sogs las khyad par du 'phags te/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ma lus pa spangs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ deṃ/ bdag med goms pa'i blo chos can/ ston pa zhes brjod du rung ste/ 'bras dus kyi ston pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ grubaṃ/ theg chen gyi bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa gnyis po chos can/ mdo'i mchod brjod du skyes bu tshad ma'i rgyur bshad de/ mdo'i mchod brjod du spangs rtogs las dang por 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa de las bde gshegs 'byung ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ spangs pa phun tshogs bde bar gshegs su bstan/ spangs pa phun tshogs med pa'i rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyu/ཾ sangs rgyas pa'i spangs pa chos can/ bder gshegs yin te/ yon tan gsum ldan gyi spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la gsum ste/ legs par spangs pa/ slar mi ldog par spangs pa/ ma lus par spangs pa'o// dang po ni/ sdugaṃ de chos can/ legs par spangs pa yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi rten mi byed pa'i sgo nas phyi rol pa'i spangs (131) pa las mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skye/ཾ de chos can/ slar mi ldog par spangs pa yin te/ bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pas nyan rang slob pa'i spangs pa las mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyonaṃ/ de chos can/ ma lus par spangs pa yin te/ nyon mongs kyi bag chags spangs pas nyan rang dgra bcom gyi spangs pa las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ khaṃ/ dpyod pa ba sogs na re/ ston pa go'u ta ma chos can/ skyon zad pa min te/ ngag smra ba'i phyir dang*/ skyes bu nyid yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sgrub byed lhag ldan nyid du bstan/ sgrub byed nyid la brtags nas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'diṃ/ ngag smra sogs chos can/ khyod kyis ston pa skyon zad pa min par sgrub pa'i khyab pa 'khrul te/ khyod kyis de grub kyi mi mthun phyogs la ldog par ma nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtagaṃ ston pa skyon zad pa min pa'i rgyu mtshan skyon rtag pa yin nam/ spong byed kyi gnyen po med pa yin nam/ yod kyang mi shes pa yin/ dang po ltar na/ rgyuṃ/ skyon chos can/ khyod rtag pa min te/ khyod skyed byed kyi rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rgyu/ཾ de chos can/ khyod spong byed kyi thabs med pa min te/ khyod kyi rgyu'i gnyen po goms pas khyod zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ltar na/ rgyu/ཾ de chos can/ khyod kyi gnyen po shes par 'gyur te/ khyod kyi rgyu bdag tu 'dzin pa shes pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa de las skyob pa 'byung ba'i tshul (132) ni/ skyobaṃ/ ston pa chos can/

skyob pa yin te/ rang nyid kyis gzigs pa'i yon tan gzhan la bstan pas gzhan sdug bsngal rgyur bcas las skyob nus pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rdzun gsungs pa dang snying brtse dang mi ldan pa'i sgo nas phyin ci log gsungs pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ lnga pa des na sgrub byed yod par bsgrub pa ni/ deṃ/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ khyod kyi sgrub byed yod par grub ste/ khyod kyi sgrub byed thugs rje las ston pa sogs 'byung bar bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa nan tan ma byas par sgrub pa la lnga ste/ skyob pa dngos stobs rigs pas bsgrub/ de las bder gshegs grub pa'i tshul/ de las ston pa grub pa'i tshul/ de las brtse ba grub pa'i tshul/ des na nan tan byed par grub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bden bzhi ston pa skyob par bstan/ bstan bya bden bzhi rigs pas bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ yaṃng*/ ston pa chos can/ skyob pa yin te/ gdul bya la bden bzhi phyin ci ma log par bstan pas sdug bsngal rgyur bcas las skyob par mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid sgrub ste sdug bden bshad/ sdug bsngal rgyur bcas sgrub ste kun 'byung bshad/ sdug bsngal 'gag pa sgrub ste 'gog bden bshad/ bdag lta'i gnyen po sgrub ste lam bden bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mtshan gzhi 'khor ba can du bsgrub/ mtshan nyid mi rtag la sogs bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can du bstan/ 'khor ba med pa'i rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ sdugaṃ bden bzhi phyin ci ma

(133) log par ston pa'i sgrub byed gsung rab las ji ltar bstan pa ltar rigs pas sgrub tshul ston te/ skye ba du mar yang nas yang du 'khor ba'i zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa yin te/ sdug bsngal rnam pa gsum po gang rung gis sdug bsngal ba'i zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la rtsod pa dgod pa ni/ 'khor ba can zhes pa mi 'thad de/ skye ba snga ma med pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan la gnyis te/ 'khor ba yod par rigs pas bsgrub/ 'khor ba med na ha cang thal ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ goms las gsal ba'i rtags kyis bsgrub/ nyer len rigs mthun rtags kyis bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ gtan tshigs dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ gomaṃs/ skyes ma thag pa'i tha mal pa chos can/ chags sogs goms pa sngon du song ste/ rang rgyud la chags sogs gsal bar dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ chags sogs rgyu med skye ba dgag rigs mi mthun las skye ba dgag des na rigs mthun rgyu ru grub pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dodaṃ/ skyes ma thag pa'i chags sogs chos can/ rgyu med min te/ res 'ga' skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nad kyi rgyu las skye ba dgag 'byung ba'i rgyu las skye ba dgag pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ ldog pa med pas 'bras bu min/ rjes 'gro med pas 'bras bu min/ 'bras bu yin na ha cang thal/ rang la mtshungs pa'i rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ 'khruṃl/ gti mug dang zhe sdang 'dod chags gsum po chos can/ rim pa ltar rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi 'bras (134) bu min te/ rim pa ltar de gsum la ldog pa 'khrul pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te bad kan shas che ba'i gang zag la mkhris pa 'dres pa'i phyir/ zhe sdang 'byung bas skyon med do zhe na/ gang zag de chos can/ khyod la mkhris pa'i 'bras bu sha ser ba sogs de yi chos mthong bar thal/ khyod la dngos rgyu mkhris pa yod pa'i phyir/

dug gsum chos can/ khyod nad gsum re re las skyes pa min par thal/ de yin na bad kan mtshungs pa'i gang zag thams cad 'dod chags mtshungs pa'i skyon yod par thal ba'i phyir/ gzugaṃs/ gal te lus can gyi 'byung ba mtshungs kyang 'byung 'gyur gyi gzugs bzang ngan sogs tha dad pa bzhin du snga ma la yang skyon med do zhe na/ deraṃ/ lus can gyi gzugs bzang ngan sogs khyad par chos can/ khyod 'byung ba kho na las skye ba min par thal/ khyod rang gi bdag rkyen tshe snga ma'i las las skyes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gtan tshigs dgod/ tshul gsum bsgrub/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ skyonaṃ/ dug gsum po chos can/ nad gsum gyi nyer len las skyes pa min te/ nad gsum 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su khyod 'phel 'grib mi byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te rtags ma grub ste/ mkhris pa 'phel ba na lus gdungs pas zhe sdang 'phel bar mthong ba'i phyir zhe na/ maṃ/ zhe sdang chos can/ mkhris pa 'phel ba na khyod 'phel ba tsam gyis khyod mkhris pa'i nyer len las skyes par ma grub par thal/ de 'grub na khyod nad gsum ka'i nyer len las skyes par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod nad gsum gyi nyer len las skyes pa min par thal/ nad gsum (135) mtshungs pa thams cad khyod mtshungs pa min pa'i phyir/ rgyu/ཾ rtsa ba'i rtags la khyab pa yod de/ nyer len gyi rgyu 'phel na de'i 'bras bu 'grib pa mi rung ba'i phyir/ mkhris pa 'phel na tsha ba 'grib pa mi rung ba bzhin no// chaṃgs/ gal te nad gsum cha mnyam pa las chags pa dang mi mnyam pa las zhe sdang skye ba'i phyir na rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs ma grub bo zhe na/ nad gsum cha mnyam mi mnyam las skyes pa'i chags sogs chos can/ khyod nad gsum las dngos su skyes pa min te/ khyod nad gsum cha mnyam mi mnyam gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i tshor ba las dngos su skyes pa'i phyir/

gsum pa la gnyis te/ nyes spong brjod de rgyu gnyis dri/ smras pa'i rgyu gnyis so sor dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ chaṃ/ gal te nad gsum cha mi mnyam pa las skyes pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gegs byas pa'i tshe/ bad kan gyis 'dod chags mi bskyed do zhe na/ nad gsum cha mnyam pa'i tshe rgyu cis bskyed/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ khu ba chags pa'i rgyur mi 'thad/ gzugs sogs chags pa'i rgyur mi 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ chaṃ/ nad gsum cha mnyam pa las khu ba 'phel la/ de las 'dod chags skye ba yin no zhe na/ chaṃ/ chags pa chos can/ khyod nad gsum cha mnyam pa dang de las byung ba'i khu ba'i dngos 'bras min par thal/ khyod de gnyis la rjes su 'gro ldog 'khrul pa'i phyir/ budaṃ/ chags ldan chos can/ bud med gzugs mdzes pa gcig la chags pa drag po skye ba mi 'thad par thal/ de la khu ba nges par 'phel ba med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ bud med kyi gzugs mdzes pa sogs kyang khu (136) bas chags pa bskyed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen du dgos pas skyon med do zhe na/ bud med kyi gzugs mdzes pa sogs chos can/ khyod chags pa'i dngos rgyu min par thal/ khyod nye bar yod pa'i gang zag kun chags pa skye bar ma nges pa'i phyir/ desaṃ/ chags pa chos can/ gzugs mdzes phan byed du yod med kyi 'gro ldog byed par thal/ de'i dngos 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gzugs mdzes sogs la yon tan du 'dzin pa yang chags pa bskyed pa yan lag yin no zhe na/ thamaṃs/ bud med kyi gzugs mdzes nye bar yod pa'i gang zag thams cad chos can/ gzugs mdzes pa la yon tan du 'dzin par thal/ de'i dngos rgyu tshang ba'i phyir/ gsum pa 'bras bu yin na ha cang thal ba ni/ gnaṃs/ bad kan shas che ba'i gnas skabs na chos can/ zhe sdang can min par thal/ chags pa mngon gyur du yod pa'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ bad kan can la zhe sdang skye bar mthong ba'i phyir/

bzhi pa rang la mtshungs pa'i rtsod pa spang ba ni/ nyes pa de khyod rang la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ gaṃng*/ sangs rgyas pa chos can/ chags sogs nad gsum gyi nyer len las skye ba la bkod pa'i nyes pa khyod la med de/ khyod chags sogs rigs mthun snga ma'i bag chags las skye bar khas blangs pa'i mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'byung ba'i rgyu las skye ba dgag pa la gnyis te/ sngar med gsar du skye ba dgag grub zin gnas par byed pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'disaṃ/ chags sogs rlung sogs kyi 'bras bu yin par dgag pa'i rigs pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ dug gsum (137) po 'byung ba'i nyer len las skye ba'ang khegs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rigs pa snga mas khegs/ khas blangs 'gal ba spong*/ ha cang thal ba dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ rtenaṃ/ chags sogs chos can/ khyod grub zin 'byung ba la brten pa yang min te/ khyod de yin pa/ yod med rtags la rten med phyir// zhes pa'i rigs pas khegs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'byung gyur grub zin 'byung ba la brten par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ dkaraṃ/ 'byung gyur chos can/ grub zin gnas pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba la brten pa min te/ grub zin gnas pa'i rten mi srid pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'byung gyur 'byung ba la brten pa'i don gang zhe na/ deṃ/ de chos can/ khyod 'byung ba la brten pa'i don grub zin gnas pa'i tshul gyis brten pa min te/ khyod rang rgyu 'byung ba snga ma las skyes pa'am rang dang dus mnyam pa'i 'byung ba dang dbyer med du skyes pa de/ khyod 'byung ba la gnas pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ chang ma log kyang myos pa'i nus pa ldog pa bzhin/ dus mnyam pa'i 'byung ba dang 'byung gyur yang dbyer yod yin no zhe na/ dngoṃs/ chang gis myos pa'i nus pa chos can/ chang las don gzhan pa'i tshul gyis brten pa min te/ chang dang grub bde rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/

galaṃ/ chang dang chang gi myos pa'i nus pa grub bde rdzas gcig yin pa de 'byung sems la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ miṃng*/ 'byung sems chos can/ grub bde rdzas gcig min par thal/ blo ma 'khrul bas rdzas tha dad du rtogs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ jiṃ/ yid blo rtog pa chos can/ lus (138) gnas skabs gzhan du ma gyur gyi bar du khyod kyi rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur bar thal/ khyod lus dang rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ lus dang de la brten pa'i gzugs sogs bzhin/ gal te gzung don gyi dbang gis rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ro zhe na/ de chos can/ gzung don can min par thal/ 'dod pa tsam gyis 'jug pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa des na rigs mthun rgyu ru grub pa ni/ gaṃng*/ chags sogs chos can/ khyod rang gi rigs mthun snga ma las skye ba yin te/ khyod nyer len lus las skye ba mi 'thad pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs mthun snga ma'i bag chags rkyen gyis sad pa las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa nyer len rigs mthun rtags kyis sgrub pa la gnyis te/ rnam shes yin pas nyer len rigs mthun grub/ grub zin sgrub pa'i grangs can rtsod pa spong pa'o// dang po ni/ rnam/ཾ skyes ma thag pa'i rnam shes chos can/ rnam shes snga ma ngan du song ste/ rnam shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtswa/ཾ rtswa la sogs pa'i dngos po thams cad rnam shes nus pa'i ngo bor ldan pa'i phyir na thal ba de 'dod pa yin no zhe na/ rtswa/ཾ rtswa dang 'byung ba sogs kyi rtse na glang chen brgya'i rnam shes nus pa'i ngo bor yod par dam bcas pa'i dam bca' chos can/ khyod dam bca' yang dag min te/ khyod la rigs pa yang dag gis gnod pa'i phyir/ ci ltar gnod na/ rgyu/ཾ rtswa dang 'byung ba sogs kyi rtse na chos can/ glang chen brgya'i rnam shes med de/ de snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'khor ba med na ha cang thal ba la gnyis te/ chags sogs bcas par 'byung ba'i nges pa med par thal/

chags sogs res 'ga' skye ba'i nges pa med par thal ba'o// (139) dang po la gnyis te/ ha cang thal ba dgod/ khyab pa ma nges spong ba'o// dang po ni/ sngaṃ/ tha mal pa chos can/ skyes ma thag nas chags sogs dang ldan pa'i nges pa med par thal/ chags sogs snga ma sngon du ma song ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rgyu yi sgo nas ma nges spong*/ dpe yi sgo nas ma nges spong ba'o// dang po ni/ 'byungaṃ*/ gal te lus can kun chos can/ chags sogs dang ldan par nges te/ chags sogs kyi dngos rgyu 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ thamaṃs/ de chos can/ 'dod chags che chung mtshungs par thal/ 'dod chags kyi dngos rgyu 'byung ba mtshungs pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te rtags ma grub ste/ 'byung ba che chung gi khyad par las chags sogs du ma 'byung ba'i phyir zhe na/ 'byungaṃ*/ 'byung ba chos can/ khyod las 'byung ba'i srog chags de la srog chags tsam dang*/ ches srog chags dang*/ ches shin tu srog chags kyi khyad par yod par thal/ khyod las 'byung ba'i srog chags yod pa gang zhig khyod che chung gi khyad par las chags sogs che chung gi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ de med kyang tha mal pa chos can/ khyod sngar chags sogs dang bcas pa las phyis chags sogs med par 'gyur ba srid par thal/ khyod kyi rgyud la 'byung ba 'phel 'grib kyi khyad par las/ chags sogs 'phel 'grib kyi khyad par byed pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te tha mal pa chos can/ chags sogs gtan med du 'gyur ba min te/ chags sogs kyi dngos rgyu 'byung ba mi ldog pa'i phyir zhe na/ bdaṃg tha mal pa chos can/ 'dod chags che chung mtshungs par thal/ (140) rgyu 'byung ba mtshungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs te/ sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la ba lang spyi 'dzin gyi shes pa la ba lang che chung du 'dzin pa'i khyad par med pa dang*/ rgyang 'phen gyi lugs la'ang sa sogs las skyes pa'i srog chags la srog chags tsam la sogs pa'i khyad par med pa'i phyir/

drodaṃ/ gal te me la drod che chung gi khyad par yod na yang drod gtan med kyi me mi srid pa bzhin 'byung ba dang chags sogs la mtshungs so zhe na/ miṃn/ drod chos can/ khyod gtan med kyi me mi srid pa dang*/ chags sogs gtan med kyi 'byung ba mi srid pa de dpe don du mi mtshungs par thal/ khyod me las don gzhan min pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ chags sogs chos can/ 'byung ba la rgyun chad pa srid de/ khyod 'byung ba las don gzhan pa'i yon tan yin pa gang zhig 'byung ba 'phel 'grib kyi rjes su khyod 'phel 'grib kyi khyad par byed pa'i phyir/ dper na 'byung ba las don gzhan pa'i dkar sogs 'byung ba la rgyun chad pa srid pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ gaṃzugs/ gzugs sogs 'byung ba las gsar du byung yang*/ 'byung ba la nges pa yod pa de bzhin du chags sogs kyang yin pas snga na med pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi thal ba ma nges so zhe na/ chags sogs chos can/ gzugs sogs dang 'byung ba la yod par mtshungs pa de min par thal/ gzugs sogs 'byung ba dang 'bral mi rung yin pa gang zhig khyod 'byung ba dang 'bral rung yin pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te de gnyis mtshungs so zhe na/ gzugs sogs chos can/ khyod 'byung ba dang 'bral mi shes pa de chags sogs la mtshungs pa min par thal/ de mtshungs na/ chags (141) sogs de 'byung ba dang lhan cig skye bar thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ rnamaṃ/ chags sogs chos can/ gzung don gyi dbang gis res 'ga' skye bar nges pa min par thal/ sgro btags dngos yul du byed pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chags sogs res 'ga' skye ba'i nges pa med par thal ba ni/ skalaṃ/ chags sogs chos can/ res 'ga' skye ba'i nges pa med par thal/ rigs 'dra'i rgyu dang bral ba'i phyir/ gal te 'byung ba dngos rgyur 'dod na/ chags sogs chos can/ skyes bu kun la dus kun gyi tshe skye ba yin par thal/ de'i tshe 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa mtshan nyid mi rtag la sogs bsgrub pa la bzhi ste/ mi rtag sdug bsngal/ bdag med/ stong pa bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ mi rtag pa yin te/ res 'ga' skye ba'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyesaṃ/ de chos can/ sdug bsngal yin te/ nyes pa bdag 'dzin sogs kyi rten yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sred pa'i rkyen las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdagaṃ de chos can/ bdag min te/ bdag dang mtshan nyid mi mthun pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ byinaṃ/ de chos can/ bdag gis byin gyis brlab bya min te/ bdag de khyod kyi rgyu min pa'i phyir te/ bdag rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtag pa yin na rang 'bras skyed byed min dgos pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ bdag chos can/ khyod las 'bras bu du ma rim gyis skye ba min par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu/ཾ rtag pa chos can/ khyod sdug bsngal sogs (142) kyi rgyu min par thal/ sdug bsngal sogs kyi rgyu gzhan tshogs na yang khyod ldog pa'i stobs kyis sdug bsngal sogs ldog pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sdug bsngal rgyur bcas sgrub ste kun bden bshad pa la gsum ste/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bsgrub/ rgyu nyid gzhan du rtog pa dgag rgyu yi gtso bo sred pa bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ res 'ga' skye bas rgyur bcas sgrub/ rgyu med sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ reṃs/ sdug bsngal chos can/ rgyu dang bcas pa yin te/ res 'ga' skye ba'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ldog khyab rtags/ gnyis pa ni/ jiṃ/ rgyang 'phen pa na re/ tsher ma'i rno ba sogs rgyu med yin pa bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yang rgyu med yin no zhe na/ gangaṃ*/ tsher ma'i rno ba sogs dang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa chos can/ rgyu dang bcas pa yin te/ don gzhan snga ma phan byed kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/

'o na mig shes kyi dmigs rkyen gyi rgyur gyur pa'i reg bya chos can/ mig shes kyi rgyu yin par thal/ mig shes phyi ma'i rjes su 'gro ldog bya sa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ reṃg de chos can/ de'i brgyud rgyu yin te/ de'i dmigs rkyen du gyur pa'i gzugs kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtagaṃ sdug bsngal chos can/ dbang phyug sogs rtag pa las skye ba min te/ spyir rtag pa rgyu yin pa bkag zin pa'i phyir dang*/ rtag pas 'bras bu bskyed pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ sred pa rkyen gyi gtso bor bstan/ de la lung gi sgrub byed dgod/ sred pa kho na bshad pa'i [WP:MRG:ENDFIELD][WP:MRG:ENDFIELD]rgyu'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ srid pa'i

(143) sred pa chos can/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal rang dbang du skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ de ltar na mdo las/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i kun 'byung la 'dod pa'i sred pa dang*/ srid pa'i sred pa dang*/ 'jig pa'i sred pa dang gsum bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ srid pa'i sred pa chos can/ khyod sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i kun 'byung la de ltar bshad pa mi 'gal bar thal/ 'do[WP:MRG:ENDFIELD]da sred dang 'jig sred gnyis khyod kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ bdaṃg tha mal pa chos can/ sred pa gsum po de khyod yang srid du skye ba'i rten yin te/ sdug bsngal la bde bar 'dzin pa'i log shes las byung ba'i sred pa gsum gyi dbang gis khyod yul gyi blang dor la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ chagaṃs/ srid pa'i sred pa chos can/ khyod yang srid skye ba'i rgyu yin te/ de yin par slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyisapa ni/ lusaṃ/ 'o na lus las kyang 'dod chags 'byung bar thal/ lus med pa la chags pa ma mthong ba'i phyir zhe na/ rgyuṃ/ lus snga ma chos can/ rang 'bras 'dod chags phyi ma'i rgyu yin te/ de'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na sngar rgyu yin pa bkag pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ lus chos can/ khyod 'dod chags phyi ma'i rgyu tsam yin pa bkag pa min te/ khyod 'dod chags phyi ma'i nyer len yin pa sngar bkag zin pa'i phyir/ riṃgs/ gal te rig pa snga ma la brten pa'i lus snga ma chags pa phyi ma'i rgyur 'dod na/ (144) rgyang 'phen pa chos can/ skye ba phyi ma yod par 'dod rigs par thal/ lus dang chags pa snga ma de gnyis phyi ma'i rgyur smras pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ chags pa chos can/ lus kyi rgyu min te/

lus skye ba dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i phyir zhe na/ lus kyang chos can/ chags pa'i rgyu min par thal/ chags pa dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skalaṃ/ tshe 'di'i chags pa skad cig dang po chos can/ rigs 'dra snga ma sngon du song ba grub ste/ rang nyid skal mnyam kyi rgyu las skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sred pa kho na yang srid du skye ba'i rgyu yin na/ mi shes las dang srid las 'byung rig mdzod// ces rgyu gsum pa can du bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ miṃ/ ma rig pa chos can/ spyir yang srid kyi rgyu yin yang skabs 'dir yang srid kyi rgyur ma brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ yang srid kyi phung po bskyed nges min pa'i phyir/ sred pa chos can/ khyod kho na skabs 'dir yang srid kyi rgyur bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod yang srid kyi phung po skyed nges yin pa'i phyir/ las kyang chos can/ skabs 'dir yang srid kyi rgyur ma bshad de/ khyod yod na yang srid 'byung bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sdug bsngal 'gog pa sgrub ste 'gog bden bshad pa la bzhi ste/ sdug bsngal las grol thar pa bsgrub/ grol ba po la rtsod pa spong*/ grol ba'i tshul la rtsod pa spong*// bcing thar bdag gis byed pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ rgyu'i gtso bo sred pa chos can/ gtan du ba min te/ rgyu ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ma rig pa'i gnyen po yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khoṃr/ sems can rdzas yod chos (145) can/ 'khor ba las thar pa med par thal/ 'khor ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ maṃ/ thal ba de chos can/ sangs rgyas pa la gnod byed kyi thal 'gyur yang dag min par thal/ sangs rgyas pas khyod la 'dod pa dang*/ rtags ma grub pa'i lan don mthun thebs pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'khor ba dang thar pa gang la 'jog ce na/ jiṃ/ bdag chos can/ don dam par khyod med na yang tha snyad du 'khor ba spangs nas thar pa thob pa'i ched du 'bad pa byed par 'thad de/

don dam par phung po sdug bsngal gyis gdung pa la khyod sdug bsngal gyis gdungs par sgro btags pa gang zhig log par sgro btags pa de gzhom pa'i ched du khyod kyis tha snyad du thar lam la brtson dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod chags bral bar gnas pa med pa spang*/ 'phags lam dang por yang srid med pa spang ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ chags bral gnas pa'i rgyu gnyis bshad/ rgyu yi don la rtsod pa spong*/ gnas pa'i don la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ 'doṃd/ chags bral gyi gang zag chos can/ khyod re zhig 'khor bar gnas pa'i rgyu yod de/ khyod brtse ba dang las gang rung gis re zhig 'khor bar gnas pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod las kyi dbang gis 'khor bar gnas pa yod de/ khyod snga ma'i las kyis tshe 'di'i phung po 'phangs zin cing re zhig phung po mi ldog par 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ las kyi don la rtsod pa spong*/ brtse ba'i don la rtsod pa spong pa'o/ dang po ni/ chags bral las kyis 'khor bar gnas na yang srid gzhan du mtshams sbyor bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ sridaṃ/ chags bral (146) las kyi gnas pa de chos can/ 'khor ba las ma grol ba min te/ yang srid 'grub byed kyi sred pa zad par spangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chags bral la snying rje yod na sems can du lta ba yod par 'gyur ro zhe na/ sdugaṃ chags bral gyi rgyud kyi brtse ba chos can/ bdag lta min te/ 'gal rkyen zhe sdang med cing*/ mthun rkyen snying rje snga ma'i rjes su 'jug pa'i sems kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ chags bral la snying rje yod na chags pa can du 'gyur ro zhe na/ deṃ/ chags bral gyi rgyud kyi snying rje chos can/ khyod chags pa min te/ khyod chags pa dang rgyu 'gal ba'i phyir/ chags bral la snying rje yod na de'i yul la gnod pa byas pa'i tshe khong khro skye bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ deṃ/ chags bral gyi gang zag chos can/

khong khro skye ba min te/ rgyu bdag 'dzin ma lus pa spangs pa'i phyir/ deṃs/ chags bral chos can/ dug gsum gyi nyes pa med pa yin te/ dug gsum gyi nyes pa med par bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ las kyis gnas la rtsod pa spong*/ brtse bas gnas la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ chags bral la las kyis 'phangs pa'i lus yod na 'khor ba las ma grol bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ grolaṃ/ chags bral chos can/ 'khor ba pa min te/ yang srid gzhan du mtshams sbyor ba'i rgyu zad par spangs pa'i phyir dang*/ las kyi nus pa ma zad na yang 'khor ba'i nyes pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chags bral snying rjes gnas na sems can gyi don du yun ring por gnas par 'gyur ro zhe na/ snyingaṃ*/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa chos can/ gzhan don la (147) yun ring du gnas pa'i nus pa med de/ snying rje dman pa nyid kyi phyir/ gangaṃ*/ theg chen 'phags pa chos can/ gzhan don la yun ring du bzhugs pa yin te/ de'i rgyu brtse ba chen po mnga' ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ 'jig lta yang srid kyi rgyu yin na nyan thos mthong lam pa chos can/ yang srid du skye ba med par thal/ 'jig lta spangs pa'i phyir zhe na/ lhanaṃ/ de chos can/ 'jig lta spangs pa min te/ 'jig lta lhan skyes ma spangs pa'i phyir/ gal te spangs na de chos can/ yang srid du mi skye bar thal/ 'jig lta lhan skyes spangs pa'i phyir/ bdeṃ/ de chos can/ 'jig lta lhan skyes ma spangs par thal/ bdag bde ba dang 'phrad pa dang sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ ngaṃ*/ khyab ste/ ngar 'dzin med na/ bdag bde ba dang 'phrad pa dang sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i blo med dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bcing thar bdag gis byed pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ rtag pa'i bdag gis byed pa dgag brjod du med pas byed pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ phyi rol pa na re/ bdag rtag pa 'khor bar bcing ba dang*/

'khor ba las thar pa yin no zhe na/ sdugaṃ bdag rtag pa chos can/ 'khor ba 'ching ba min par thal/ sdug bsngal skye ba'i rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'khor ba las thar pa min par thal/ sdug bsngal ldog pa'i rgyu min pa'i phyir/ miṃ/ bdag chos can/ 'ching 'grol gyi rgyu min par thal/ mi rtag pa min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnas ma bu pa na re/ bdag rtag pa la bcing thar (148) mi 'thad kyang*/ rtag mi rtag gang rung du'ang brjod du med pa la bcing thar 'thad do zhe na/ brjoṃd/ bdag chos can/ bcing thar mi 'thad par thal/ rtag mi rtag gang rung du brjod du med pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ bdag chos can/ rtag pa yin par thal/ mi rtag pa min pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'jig med yin na rtag pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bdag lta'i gnyen po sgrub ste lam bden bshad pa la gnyis te/ bdag med rtog pa gnyen por bstan/ gnyen po yin pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ bdag med goms pas gnas 'gyur thob par bstan/ gnas 'gyur thob kyang spang byas 'joms pa dgag gnas 'gyur thob pa med pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bshadaṃ/ bdag med rtogs nas goms pa'i blo chos can/ 'khor ba'i gnyen por gyur pa'i thar lam yin te/ goms pa las gnas 'gyur thob pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spang byas 'joms pa'i nus pa med par bstan/ nus pa med pa'i sgrub byed rgyas par bshad/ sgrub byed 'dzin stangs 'gal la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ nyes pa dang bcas pa'i sems nyes med du lhan cig tu gnas 'gyur ba srid kyang nyes pa slar yang 'byung ste/ nyes pa dang bcas pa'i sems la nyes med kyi lam 'byung ba bzhin no zhe na/ gnas gyur pa'i sems chos can/ nyes pa slar 'byung ba min te/ nyes pa slar 'byung ba'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ spang gnyen 'dzin stangs 'gal zhing gnyen po don la zhugs/

rang bzhin glo bur khyad par yod pas sngar nus med/ nus (149) yod na yang gnyen po 'bad med bskyed pa nus/ khyad par gsum ldan gnyen po 'bad kyang ldog mi nus pa'o// dang po ni/ rnamaṃ/ gnas gyur pa'i sems chos can/ khyod la bdag 'dzin sogs kyi nyes pa slar 'byung ba'i nus pa med de/ khyod yul gyi gnas tshul 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i blo yin zhing*/ bdag 'dzin de yul gyi gnas tshul phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ ldogaṃ bdag 'dzin chos can/ gnas gyur thob pa'i sems la khyod 'byung mi nus te/ khyod bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ dper na thag khra la sbrul du 'dzin pa'i blo bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ semasaṃ/ nyes pa chags sogs chos can/ gnas 'gyur thob pa'i sems la rang bzhin gyis gnod pa'i nus pa med de/ sngar gnas ma gyur pa'i dus su yang sems la rang bzhin gyis gnod pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nusaṃ/ nyan thos mthong lam pa'i sems rgyud chos can/ nyes pa cung zad skye yang yun ring du gnas pa'i nus pa med de/ gnyen po bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab rang dbang du bskyed nus pa'i phyir/ dper na sa rlon pa la me bzhin no/ bzhi pa ni/ 'tsheṃ/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi gnas gyur pa'i sems chos can/ nyes pa chags sogs kyis 'bad du zin kyang ldog mi nus te/ gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i phyogs 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ 'dzin stangs tha dad tsam gyis gnyen po min/ phyogs re'i mgo gnon tsam gyis gnyen po min/ des na mtha' dag dpyis 'byin gnyen por bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dzin stangs 'gal (150) ba tsam gyis gnyen por gyur na chags sdang gnyis kyang phan tshun gnyen por 'gyur ro zhe na/ bdaṃg 'dod chags dang khong khro chos can/ phan tshun gnyen por 'gyur ba min te/

rang rgyu bdag 'dzin du gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ phan tshun rgyu 'bras su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ zhe sdang gi gnyen po byams pa sogs kyang gsungs pa min nam/ ci'i phyir bdag med rtogs pa kho na gnyen por 'chad ce na/ byamaṃs/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams sogs chos can/ nyes pa chags sogs drung nas 'byin pa'i gnyen po min te/ nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa dang 'dzin stangs mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nyes pa chags sogs ni ma rig pa'i rtsa ba can yin pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa ni rig pa bkag tsam yin pas 'di ltar mi 'thad do zhe na/ riṃg ma rig pa chos can/ rig pa ye shes dang dmigs pa gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa log par zhugs pa yin gyi/ rig pa bkag tsam min te/ rig pa ye shes kyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sems byung yin pas dmigs rnam 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'o na lta ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma rig pa zhes bshad pa dang 'gal te/ rang nyid rang dang mtshungs par ldan pa mi srid pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'galaṃ/ ma rig pa chos can/ khyod lta ba dang mtshungs ldan yin pas de khyod lta ba dang 'gal ba'i sgrub byed min par thal/ khyod lta ba dang phyogs gcig pa dang phyogs gcig pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ stongaṃ*/ nyer len gyi phung po bdag gis stong pa nyid du lta ba'i lam de chos can/ nyes pa chags sogs drung nas 'byin pa'i gnyen po yin te/ bdag lta dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal zhing*/ yul gyi gnas tshul la zhugs (151) pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ zadaṃ/ nyes pa rnams chos can/ gnyen po goms kyang zad pa ma yin par thal/ sems kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs can la gzugs mi zad pa bzhin no zhe na/ miṃn/ de chos can/ khyod sems kyi chos nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod zad mi srid pa de min par thal/ khyod da lta gnyen po skyes pa'i tshe mngon gyur ldog pa mthong ba'i phyir/

gal te gser gyi zhu ba slar yang sra ba bzhin du/ gnyen po dang bral ba'i tshe slar yang ldog go zhe na/ nyesaṃ/ gnas 'gyur thob pa'i sems rgyud chos can/ gnyen po dang bral nas nyes pa slar ldog pa min te/ gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i blo dang bral ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyen po dang bral na spang bya slar ldog pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gnyen po yin pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa la gsum ste/ bdag med rtogs pa bdag lta'i gnyen por bstan/ bdag med rtogs pa srid pa'i gnyen por bstan/ de las logs su las lus gnyen por med pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ bdag lta 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bstan/ bdag lta nyes pa'i rtsa bar bstan/ rtsa ba yin pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ des na rtsa ba dbyung bar gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ gangaṃ*/ bdag lta chos can/ khyod 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin te/ khyod las bdag dang bdag gir chags pa 'byung*/ de las zag bcas kyi las la sogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bdaṃg de chos can/ khyod nyes pa'i rtsa ba yin te/ khyod las bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin pa 'byung*/ de la chags sdang sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ bdag ltas chags pa (152) gnyis ka bskyed/ gnyis po spong ba'i thabs gzhan med/ chags bral med na 'khor bar 'khor ba'o// dang po ni/ ngesaṃ/ bdag gi ba la chags bral du 'dod pa'i bdag 'dzin can de chos can/ bdag gi ba la chags pa dang ma bral bar thal/ bdag la chags pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ nyesaṃ/ de chos can/ der thal/ bdag nyes med kyi yon tan can du 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bdag la chags pa spong ba'i thabs gzhan med/ bdag gir chags pa spong ba'i thabs gzhan med pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ skyon bcas shes pas zhen yul spong mi nus/ skyon bcas shes pas dngos rgyu ldog mi nus/ skyon bcas nyid la khas blangs 'gal ba bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ bdag nyes med yin kyang bdag la chags pa skyon bcas su shes pas bdag la chags pa spong bar 'gyur ro zhe na/

'diṃ/ bdag la chags pa skyon can du mthong ba'i skyes bu chos can/ bdag la chags pa spong mi nus par thal/ bdag la chags pa'i zhen yul sun phyung mi nus pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ zhen yul spong pa'i sgo nas zhen byed kyi blo spong dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chagasaṃ/ bdag la chags pas skyon can du mthong ba'i bdag 'dzin can chos can/ bdag la chags pa spong mi nus pa thal/ bdag nyes med kyi yon tan can du mthong ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ chagaṃs/ bdag la chags pa skyon can yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi rten byed pa'i phyir zhe na/ deṃ/ bdag la chags pa chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi rten byed na yang chags pa dang bral bar bya ba min par thal/ bdag skyon med kyi bdag gi bar mthong ba'i phyir/

(153) dper na bdag sdug bsngal gyi rten byed kyang chags pa dang bral bar bya ba min pa bzhin no// galaṃ/ bdag skyon med yin te/ bdag kho na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu min pa'i phyir zhe na/ deṃ/ bdag la chags pa chos can/ khyod skyon med yin par thal/ khyod kho na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bdag dang bdag la chags pa gnyis ka chos can/ chags pa dang bral bar bya ba min par thal/ skyon med yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ dbang sogs sdug bsngal bsgoms pas spong mi nus/ dbang bdag tha dad shes pas spong mi nus/ sdug bsngal las yid 'byung bas spong mi nus/ sdug bsngal bsgom byar gsungs dang 'gal ba spong ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ sum 'byin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/ sbrul gyis gzung ba'i yan lag sdug bsngal gyis rgyur bsgoms pas spong ba bzhin du bdag la chags pa dang*/ bdag gi ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyur bsgoms pas spong ngo zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dpe dgag don dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bdagaṃ sbrul gyis gzung ba'i yan lag chos can/ khyod sdug bsngal du bsgoms pa tsam gyis 'dor ba min te/ khyod la bdag gi ba'i blo ma bcom na khyod mi 'dor ba mthong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bdun te/ bdag gir 'dzin pa yod na 'dor mi srid/ bdag gir 'dor na bdag gi mtshan nyid med/ bdag 'dzin yod na bdag gir chags pa 'byung*/ sdug bsngal bsgoms pas brtsams pa don med 'gyur/ bdag skyon med na chags dang bral yul med/ skyon can shes pas (154) chags pa spong mi nus/ rgyu la gnod pa med pas spong mi nus pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bdag gir 'dzin pa yod na chags bral med/ bdag gir 'dzin pa bcom pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ dbaṃng*/ dbang sogs sdug bsngal du bsgom pa'i bdag 'dzin can chos can/ dbang sogs la chags pa dang bral ba min par thal/ dbang sogs la rang gi ba'i blo ma dor ba'i phyir te/

dbang sogs longs spyod kyi rten du gzung ba'i phyir/ lusaṃ/ khyab ste/ lus las bog pa'i skra sogs la rang gi ba'i blo dor zhing gzhan la zhen pa skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sdug bsngal bsgoms pas bcom pa dgag sdug bsngal bskyed pas bcom pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag la chags pa sogs sdug bsngal du bsgoms pas rang gi ba'i blo spong ngo zhe na/ deṃ/ bdag la chags pa sogs chos can/ khyod sdug bsngal du mthong yang rang gi ba'i blo dor bar mi 'gyur bar thal/ khyod sdug bsngal du mthong yang khyod dang bdag gi 'du sogs kyi 'brel ba gnas pa'i phyir/ 'aṃdu/ de chos can/ khyod bdag gi 'du sogs kyi 'brel pa de khyod la rang gi ba'i blo skye ba'i rgyu min par thal/ 'du sogs kyi 'brel pa med na yang phan 'dogs byed du gzung ba las rang gi ba'i blo skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sdugaṃ grol ba thob pa'i skyes bu chos can/ dbang sogs la rang gi ba'i blo skye bar mi 'gyur te/ dbang sogs mtha' gcig tu sdug bsngal skyed byed du mthong ba'i phyir/ dug sbrul gyis bzung ba'i sor mo bzhin no zhe na/ gcigaṃ dbang sogs chos can/ khyod sdug bsngal skyed byed du mthong bas khyod (155) la rang gi ba'i blo 'dor ba min par thal/ khyod mtha' gcig tu sdug bsngal skyed byed du mthong ba min zhing*/ phal cher sdug bsngal skyed byed du mthong na rang gi ba'i blo 'dor bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ khyadaṃ/ gtan tshigs phyi ma grub ste/ blang dor gyi bsam pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis phal cher sdug bsngal skyed byed la chags pa dang bral yang blang dor gyi bsam pa med pa'i gang zag gis phal cher sdug bsngal skyed byed la chags pa skye bar mthong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bdaṃg 'khor ba'i gnas skabs kyi bdag de chos can/ 'jig par thal/ sngar bdag gi ba dang bcas pa las phyis bdag gi ba dang bral bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/

'dod na/ bdag mi 'jig par 'dod pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// myongaṃ*/ thar pa'i gnas skabs kyi bdag de chos can/ bye brag pa ci ltar zhen pa ltar gyi bdag tu med par thal/ myong sogs kyi rten byed ldog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ sgrub byed dngos/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ rnamaṃ/ bdag gi ba la chags bral du 'dod pa'i bdag 'dzin can de chos can/ bdag gi ba la chags pa 'byung ste/ bdag 'dzin dang ldan pa'i phyir/ brtson/ bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral ba'i ched du bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du bsgom pa'i gang zag chos can/ bdag la chags pa des bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral ba'i gegs byed pa nyid yin te/ bdag la chags pa des rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gi ba la chags pa 'jug par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ gal te thar pa'i tshe bdag la yang chags pa dang bral bas skyon med do zhe na/ chags bral chos can// (156) bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral yang bdag gi ba 'dor ba min par thal/ bdag la chags pa dang bral yang bdag mi 'dor ba dang rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thar pa don gnyer chos can/ bdag gi ba 'dor ba'i ched du bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du bsgom pa don med par thal/ bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral pas bdag gi ba mi 'dor pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ de chos can/ der thal/ bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du bsgoms pas bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du shes par byed pa tsam yin pa gang zhig bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du shes pa tsam gyis bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du mthong na chags pa dang bral te/ bdag gi ba'i nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir zhe na/ bdag 'dzin can chos can/ bdag gi ba'i nyes pa mthong ba tsam gyis bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral ba min pa thal/ bdag gi ba gzhan 'ga' zhig la chags pa skye ba'i phyir/

khyab ste/ yul gcig la chags pa de rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe gzhan la yang chags pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ dper na 'dod ldan 'ga' zhig bud med gzhan gyi nyes pa mthong ba'i tshe sngar blo ldog pa'i bud med la yang chags pa skye ba bzhin no// lnga pa la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ skyonaṃ/ thar pa don gnyer chos can/ chags pa dang bral ba'i yul med par thal/ bdag dang*/ bdag la chags pa dang*/ bdag gi ba gsum ka skyon med yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa ni/ deraṃ/ bdag la (157) chags pa skyon med yin pa'i rtags ma grub te/ sdug bsngal gyi rten byed pa'i phyir zhe na/ bdag chos can/ skyon bcas su thal/ sdug bsngal gyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thar pa don gnyer chos can/ skyon can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral bar byed pa min par thal/ bdag skyon bcas yin yang bdag la chags pa dang bral bar byed pa min pa'i phyir/ drug pa ni/ yoṃn/ bdag gi ba la chags pa chos can/ bdag gi ba yi yon tan mthong ba kho nas byas pa min par thal/ bdag gi ba yi yon tan mthong ba phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bdag gi ba'i nyes pa mthong bas 'jig pa min par thal/ bdag gi ba'i yon tan mthong ba las byung ba min pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ gal te bdag gir chags pa'i rgyu ni bdag gi ba'i blo yin la/ de yon tan mthong ba las byung bas sdug bsngal du bsgoms pas de spong ngo zhe na/ bdag gi ba'i blo skye ba'i rgyu'ang chos can/ bdag gi ba'i yon tan mthong bas byas pa min par thal/ bdag gi yon tan mthong ba phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngar bzhin no// bdun pa ni/ gzhaṃn/ bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du bsgom pa'i sgrub pa chos can/ bdag gi ba la chags pa la mi gnod par thal/

bdag la chags pa la mi gnod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bdag la chags pa yod na bdag gir chags pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbang bdag tha dad shes pas spong mi nus pa ni/ grangs can pa na re/ yon tan mthong ba la chags pa skye ba min gyi/ chags yul (158) dang skyes bu gcig tu 'khrul pa las yul de la chags pa skye/ tha dad du shes na chags bral du 'gyur ro zhe na/ mchoṃg skye bo tha mal pa chos can/ bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral bar thal/ bdag gi ba dang skyes bu tha dad du shes pa'i phyir te/ bdag gzhan du 'gyur bar mi 'dod kyang bdag gi ba mchog gzhan don du gnyer ba'i phyir dang*/ bdag rtag par gzung yang bdag gi ba mi rtag par gzung ba'i phyir/ deṃ/ dbang sogs la chags pa chos can/ yul dang skyes bu gcig tu mthong ba las byung ba min par thal/ de phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi byed pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rang rgyu bdag la chags pa las byung ste/ de phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sdug bsngal las yid 'byung bas spong mi nus pa la gnyis te/ yid 'byung chags bral min pa bstan/ chags bral med par thal ba spong ba'o// dang po ni/ bye brag pa na re/ dbang sogs sdug bsngal du mthong bas de la yid 'byung skye zhing des yul de la chags pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ gangaṃ*/ tshor ba sdug bsngal drag pos da ltar yid 'byung ba'i blo de chos can/ chags bral min te/ sdug bsngal dor nas bde ba la chags pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ chags bral min te/ rang rgyu zhe sdang log na chags par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ blangaṃ*/ 'o na chags bral mi srid par 'gyur ro zhe na/ yul 'dod mi 'dod kun la mgo snyoms can gyi gang zag de chos can/ chags bral zhes brjod de/ yul 'dod mi 'dod pa blang dor du 'dzin pa spang ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/

dper na phyogs gcig nas tsandan gyis byug pa dang*/ phyogs (159) gcig nas ste 'us bcad pa gnyis mgo snyoms par gnas pa lta bu'o/ bzhi pa sdug bsngal bsgom byar gsungs pa dang 'gal ba spong ba ni/ 'o na mdo las sdug bsngal bsgom byar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ 'aṃdu/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la dgongs nas sdug bsngal bsgom byar gsungs pa min te/ sred pa'i rkyen las skyes pa'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la dgongs nas sdug bsngal bsgom byar gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsgom pa chos can/ khyod kho nas grol ba min te/ khyod bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba'i rten tsam yin pa gang zhig bdag med rtogs pa'i lta bas grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ mi rtag sogs bsgom pa bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba'i rten yin pa khyod kyi dgongs pa yin te/ khyod 'du byed mi rtag par shes pa las zag bcas sdug bsngal du shes pa 'byung zhes sogs kyi mdo gsung pa po yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa chags bral med na 'khor bar 'khor ba ni/ chagaṃs/ bdag gi ba sdug bsngal du shes pa'i bdag 'dzin can chos can/ 'khor ba pa yin te/ las nyon las ma grol pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gal te thar pa'i gnas skabs su bdag gi ba la'ang chags pa dang bral pa yin no zhe na/ bdaṃg thar pa thob pa'i tshe chos can/ bdag gi ba'i za ba po med par thal/ bdag gi ba la chags pa dang bral pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bdag med par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ gsum pa des na rtsa ba dbyung bar gdams pa ni/ deṃ/ rnam grol don gnyer chos can/ 'jig lta (160) sun dbyung bar rigs te/ 'khor ba spong 'dod can yin pa gang zhig 'jig lta sun ma phyung na 'khor ba spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bdag med bsgoms pas sred pa spong bar nus pa la gsum ste/ cho ga gnyen po yin pa'i sgrub byed dgag

cho ga gnyen po min pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ des na yang dag lta ba gnyen por bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ lung gi sgrub byed dgag dpe'i sgrub byed dgag rigs pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ gal te 'jig lta sun ma phyung yang dbang phyug gi dbang bskur thob na grol te/ de ltar du dbang phyug gi lung las bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ lungaṃ*/ dbang phyug gi dbang bskur chos can/ khyod lung tshad ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod las bshad pa'i dbang phyug gi dbang gis grol bar bsgrub nus pa min pa thal/ khyod lung tshad ma min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang phyug gi lung las bshad pa'i sngags kyis btab na 'khor ba las grol te/ des btab pa'i sa bon gyis myu gu mi skyed pa'i phyir zhe na/ dbang phyug gi lung las bshad pa'i sngags chos can/ khyod kyis btab pa'i sa bon gyis myu gu mi skyed pas khyod kyis btab pa'i skyes bu yang srid mi skyed par bsgrub mi nus par thal/ de ltar nus na lus la til mar bskus pa sogs las kyang yang srid mi skyed par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ me lnga bsten pas yang srid las grol te/ lus sngar lci ba phyis yang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir zhe na/ sngaraṃ/ me lnga bsten pa'i skyes bu chos can/ sdig pa bcom pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lus sngar lci ba phyis yang ba min par thal/ lus kyi lcid chung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis lus sngar lci ba phyis yang ba (161) yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ cho gas skye rgyu nyams pa med/ nyams par 'dod pa'i sgrub byed dgag nyams pa med pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ bdag kyang skye rgyur dgos pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ logaṃ log sred dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems pa chos can/ khyod spangs na yang srid skye bar mi 'gyur te/ khyod yang srid kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ de yin te/ khyod yang srid rang dbang du skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/

gal te sngon gyi las kyang rgyur dgos pa min nam zhe na/ semaṃs/ de chos can/ yang srid kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i las khyod las gzhan du med de/ khyod yang srid kyi rgyur gyur pa'i las kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ des na dbang phyug gi dbang bskur thob pa'i bdag 'dzin can de chos can/ yang srid skye bar 'gyur te/ log sred kyi sems pa ma nyams par yod pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ skye rgyu gzhan du rtog pa dgag skye rgyu de nyid nyams pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'groṃ/ de chos can/ yang srid du 'gro ba med de/ ma mthong pa'i las zhig pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ yul gzhan du 'gro ba dang gzugs sgra sogs rtogs pa'i rten ni dbang sogs yin la/ de ni ma mthong ba'i las las gyur pa'i phyir/ des na bdag gi yon tan 'du byed yang srid kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin gyi log sred kyi sems pa min no zhe na/ yodaṃ/ byed pa dbang sogs chos can/ log sred kyi sems pa khyod kyi rgyu yin gyi/ bdag gi yon tan 'du byed khyod kyi rgyu ma yin te/ snga mas khyod bskyed par nus la/ phyi mas khyod bskyed par mi nus pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ skye rgyu nyams pa med ces pa'i sbyor ba dgod/ gnyis pa ni/ galaṃ/ dbang phyug gi dbang bskur ba des log sred kyi sems pa nus med du byas bas yang srid mi skye'o zhe na/ dbang phyug gi dbang bskur

(162) thob pa'i skyes bu chos can/ dbang bskur byas ma thag tu sems pa'i dbang gis lus 'dzin pa sogs med par thal/ dbang bskur des sems pa nus med du byas pa'i phyir/ ciṃ/ dbang phyug gi dbang bskur ba'i skyes bu shi ba'i tshe skye ba gzhan du 'phen par mi 'gyur te/ blo phyi ma 'phen pa'i nus med du byas pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'chi kha tha ma'i log sred kyi blo chos can/ rigs pa phyi mar mtshams sbyor te/ rig pa phyi mar mtshams sbyor nus pa'i rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i phyir/ gal te dbang gis log sred phyi ma bskyed pa'i nus med du byas so zhe na/ dbang phyug gi dbang bskur chos can/ gson pa nyid na'ang log sred snga ma phyi ma mtshams sbyor ba'i nus med du byas pa thal/ 'chi ba'i tshe de ltar byas pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gnyeṃn/ log sred kyi rgyun chos can/ dbang phyug gi dbang bskur bas khyod ldog pa med pa thal/ khyod rang rgyu bdag 'dzin las byung ba gang zhig dbang phyug gi dbang bskur des de la gnod pa med pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ rtag pa'i bdag la gnod byed bstan/ de la ha cang thal ba spang pa'o// dang po ni/ gal de bdag rtag pa'ang 'khor ba'i rgyur dgos pas/ log sred dang sems pa kho na 'khor ba'i rgyur mi 'thad do zhe na/ rtagaṃ bdag rtag pa chos can/ 'bras bu rim gyis bskyed par mi byed par thal/ rkyen la ltos pa med pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rang 'bras mi bskyed par thal/ rang 'bras byed pa dang mi byed pa khyad par med pa'i rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu/ཾ las byed pa po dang 'bras bu za ba po gcig par thal/ bdag rtag pa de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis tha dad yin na las byed pa po'i bdag chos can/ rnam smin za ba po'i bdag min par thal/ de las don gzhan yin pa'i phyir// (163) bdag chos can/ khyod la 'bras bu bskyed pa'i nus pa med par thal/
