rang yul 'jal tshul gcig par thal/ rang yul lkog gyur gyi blo 'das pa la 'jug pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ doṃn/ lha sbyin chos can/ rang rgyud la don rig 'das pa yod pa rjes dpag gis mi 'grub par thal/ rang rgyud la don rigs 'das pa yod pa bsgrub pa'i mthun dpe dang gtan tshigs yang dag mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de yod par tshad mas ma grub par thal/ de yod pa mngon sum gyis kyang ma grub/ rjes dpag gis kyang ma grub pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ don rig 'das pa'i rnam par shar ba'i blo phyi mas don rig 'das pa grub ste/ mdo sde pa'i lugs la gzugs sogs kyi rnam par shar ba'i blos gzugs sogs grub pa bzhin no zhe na/ sngaṃ/ don rig rgyud ldan du skyes pa'i rjes de ma thag pa'i shes pa chos can/ don rig skad cig snga ma rnams nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas 'dzin par mi 'gyur bar thal/ de dang khyod kyi bar du shes pa gzhan gyis chod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ jiṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon nyams su myong ba'i blo de chos can/ rtog med yin te/ rang yul la brda byed mi nus pa'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ spyi/ཾ rang mtshan snang nas 'jal ba'i shes pa med par thal/ rtog med kyi shes pa med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rjes kyi sgra dang rtog pa gnyis spyi la dngos su 'jug pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ gal te dbang shes rtog med 'ga' zhig yod pas der khyad par rang mtshan snang nas rtogs pa yin no zhe na/ rkyen gsum tshan pa gcig las skyes pa'i dbang shes

(218) thams cad chos can/ rtog med yin par thal/ rkyen gsum tshan pa gcig las skyes pa'i dbang shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'bras bu rigs 'dra mi 'dra de rgyu rigs 'dra mi 'dra la ltos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgrub byed shugs bstan sbyar te bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ sgrub byed dgod/ nyes spang dgag grub don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ phyiṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon su ma chos can/ khyod dang ming sbyor rtog pa'i gzhi mthun med de/ ming sbyor rtog pa yin na rang rgyu brda dran la ltos pas khyab/ khyod yin na rang rgyu gzung don la ltos pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃl/ gal te ma grub ste/ gzugs des rang gi brda dran la ltos nas gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum bskyed pa yin gyi gzhan du min pa'i phyir zhe na/ rtagaṃs/ gzugs chos can/ khyod kyis gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dngos su mi skyed par rang gi brda dran dngos su skyed par thal/ khyod rang gi brda dran la ltos nas gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon dngos su skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ dper na gtan tshigs du ba des rtags can rjes dpag dngos su mi skyed par thog mar rtags 'dzin sems skyed pa bzhin no// dranaṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod rang rgyu rkyen gsum phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi byed par thal/ khyod rang rgyu gzugs kyi brda dran las dngos su skyes pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ skyon med de/ gzugs des gzugs kyi brda dran dang gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gnyis rim gyis bskyed pa'i phyir zhe na/ thaṃ/ gzugs chos can/ gzugs kyi brda dran gyi dus su gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon (219) bskyed par thal/ khyod gzugs kyi brda dran gyi dus na gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyi gzung don dang khyad par med pa'i rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbangaṃ*/ gal te ma grub ste/

gzugs skad cig dang po gzugs kyi brda dran gyi dngos rgyu dang*/ skad cig gnyis pa gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyi dngos rgyu yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ gzugs des khyod bskyed pa la gzugs kyi brda dran don med par thal/ khyod kyi gzung don dang gzugs kyi brda dran gyi gzung don gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ brda dran brda la dngos su 'jug dbang po'i mngon sum gzugs la dngos su 'jug na/ dbang po'i mngon sum bskyed pa brda dran don med pas khyab pa'i phyir/ spyi/ཾ dbang shes kyis spyi tsam yan gar 'dzin pas brda'i yul 'dzin no zhe na/ dbang shes ma 'khrul pa chos can/ gzung don gyi skad cig gnyis pa dmigs rkyen yod pa la mi ltos par thal/ spyi tsam yan gar ba 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum de chos can/ rang gi bdag rkyen mig dang*/ dmigs rkyen gzugs las skye ba yin te/ de phan phyed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan mtshon gnyis la rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis te/ mtshon bya'i ming la rtsod pa spang*/ mtshan nyid don la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni mdor/ thun mong ma yin rgyu yi phyir// de yi tha snyad dbang pos byas// zhes pa'i don 'grel pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ gaṃl/ dbang po'i mngon sum de yul dbang gnyis (220) las skyes par mtshungs na/ dmigs rkyen gyi sgo nas yul gyi mngon sum zhes tha snyad mi byed par bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbang po'i mngon sum zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ goṃ dbang po'i mngon sum zhes pa'i tha snyad chos can/ yul dbang gnyis las skyes pa'i shes pa ma 'khrul pa la brda sbyar bar bya ba yin te/ yul dbang gnyis las skyes pa'i shes pa ma 'khrul ba thun mong ma yin par go nus kyi tha snyad yin pa'i phyir/

khyab ste/ rtog ldan yul de la ming de brda sbyar ba'i dgos pa ni yul de thun mong min par go byed yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ snga ma'i gtan tshigs de chos can/ de skor gyi rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag yin te/ de skor gyi sgrub rtags yang dag gang zhig yul dbang gnyis las skyes pa'i shes pa ma 'khrul pa la brda sbyar bar bya ba dang rang bzhin gcig yin pa'i phyir/ khyabaṃ/ yul gyi mngon sum zhes pa'i tha snyad chos can/ de la brda sbyar bar bya ba ma yin te/ de thun mong min par go nus ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lung gis gnod pa'i rtsod pa spang*/ rigs pas gnod pa'i rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ mdoṃr/ de don du mas bskyed pa'i phyir// rang don spyi yi spyod yul can// zhes gsungs pa'i don 'grel pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ bsaṃgs/ dbang shes chos can/ rtog pa yin par thal/ spyi dngos yul du byed pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs te/ khyed nyid kyi grub mtha' las rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga ni bsags pa la dmigs pa can no zhes dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ 'di rnams skye mched kyi rang gi mtshan nyid la rang gi mtshan nyid kyi (221) yul can yin gyi/ rdzas kyi rang gi mtshan nyid la ni min no zhes gsungs pa'i bsags pa dang skye mched gnyis spyi yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ grub pa'i mtha' dang 'gal ba spang*/ mkhas pa'i gzhung dang 'gal ba spang*/ lung gi don la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ doṃn/ lung snga ma de'i don dbang po'i mngon sum rigs spyi snang yul du byed pa la dgongs nas bshad pa min te/ de rdul phran khyad par ba gzung yul du byed pa la dgongs nas bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rdulaṃ/ lung phyi ma de'i don chos 'dra/ rdul phran du ma ma tshogs pa phyi mas dbang shes bskyed mi nus pa la dgongs nas bshad pa'i phyir/

gsum pa la gnyis te/ rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ gaṃl/ rdul phran du ma chos can/ dbang shes kyis cig car du mi 'dzin par thal/ yan lag can gyi rdzas med pa'i rdul phran du ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na rdzas du ma shes pas 'dzin na rim gyis 'dzin pas khyab bo zhe na/ gnyis pa la lnga ste/ til sogs cig car 'dzin pa med par thal/ khra bo cig car 'dzin pa med par thal/ nog sogs cig car 'dzin pa med par thal/ sna tshogs gzhan du shes pa med par thal/ du ma cig car 'dzin na gzhan la'ang yod pa'o// dang po ni/ tilaṃ/ 'bras bu rigs mi mthun pa du ma chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ gal te rim gyis mthong yang 'jug pa myur bas cig car 'dzin par snang ba yin no zhe na/ 'diṃ/ 'jug pa mgyogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang yul cig car 'dzin pa chos can/ khyod mi 'thad par thal/ khyod yi ge'ang cig car thos par 'gyur zhes pa'i skabs su (222) bkag zin pa'i phyir/ riṃm/ nam mkha' nas rim bzhin babs pa'i til sogs 'dzin pa'i dbang shes chos can/ rang yul cig car snang bar thal/ rang yul 'dzin pa'i 'jug pa mgyogs pa'i phyir/ bloṃ/ yul 'dzin pa'i blo rnams chos can/ khyod la rang yul cig car du snang ba dang*/ rim gyis snang ba'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ khyod rang yul 'dzin pa'i 'jug pa mgyogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de chos can/ deṃ/ yul 'dzin pa'i blo yin na/ rang yul cig char du snang bas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gnod byed thal ba dgod/ gtan tshigs ma grub pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ phyeṃ/ phye ma leb dang snam bu sogs kyi khra bo chos can/ dbang shes la cig char mi snang bar thal/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med pa'i rdul phran du ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sna tshogs gcig tu 'dod pa'i grub mtha' smad/ sna tshogs gcig tu med pa'i sgrub byed bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ galaṃ/

gal te ma grub ste/ phye ma leb kyi khra bo'i kha dog sna tshogs pa de yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ deṃ/ de ltar dam bcas pa'i dam bca' chos can/ khyod dam bca' yang dag ma yin te/ khyod la rigs pa yang dag gis gnod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sna tshogs yin pas gcig nyid med/ sna tshogs yin pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ rags snang la brten rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ gtan tshigs dgod/ gzhan lan dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ snaṃ/ phye ma leb kyi sngo ser sna tshogs pa chos can/ rdzas gcig ma yin te/ rdzas (223) sna tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ dper na nor bu du ma spungs pa'i gzugs bzhin/ gnyis pa ni/ dpe de rnam pa dbyer yod kyi gzugs yin pas don dang mi mtshungs so zhe na/ sngoṃ/ snam bu'i kha dog sna tshogs chos can/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med par thal/ rnam pa dbyer yod kyi sna tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ snam bu'i sna tshogs de la yan lag gi sngo ser sna tshogs la rnam pa dbyer nus pa yin gyi/ yan lag can gyi sna tshogs la min no zhe na/ snam bu'i khra bo chos can/ yan lag gi sna tshogs las ma gtogs pa'i yan lag can gyi sna tshogs pa med de/ de snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ snam bu'i khra bo ni bcos ma'i khra bo yin pas sna tshogs su snang ngo zhe na/ dusaṃ/ bcos ma'i khra bo chos can/ khyod dbang shes la rim ldan dang don mang po'i rnam par snang ba dang*/ bcos min gyi khra bo dbang shes la rim min cig char snang ba dang*/ don gcig gi rnam par snang ba'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ khyod dang bcos min gyi khra bo gnyis dbang shes la snang ba'i don gyi rnam pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gtan tshigs dgod/ gzhan lan dgag grub don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ bloṃ/ phye ma leb kyi sngo ser rnams chos can/ rdzas sna tshogs pa yin te/ blo ma 'khrul pa la rdzas sna tshogs su snang ba'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ gaṃl/ blo ma 'khrul pa la sna tshogs su snang ba de sna tshogs yin pa'i 'jog byed ma yin no zhe na/ thaṃ/ bum snam sogs chos can/ khyod sna tshogs su 'jog byed med par thal/ blo ma 'khrul pa la rdzas sna tshogs su snang bas khyod rdzas sna tshogs su mi 'grub pa'i phyir// (224) gal te blo la sna tshogs su snang ba de yan lag gi rdzas yin gyi/ yan lag can gyi rdzas min no zhe na/ riṃg ri mo sna tshogs chos can/ blo la sna tshogs su mi snang bar thal/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med pa'i phyir/ gal te ri mo sna tshogs de las rdzas rigs mi mthun 'phrod pa'i ldan pa yod pas de blo la sna tshogs su snang ngo zhe na/ gzugaṃs/ ldan pa chos can/ blo ma 'khrul ba la rdzas sna tshogs su mi snang bar thal/ gzugs med pa'i phyir/ niṃ/ ldan pa chos can/ phye ma leb la sogs pa la yod pa'i yan lag can gyi sna tshogs dang 'dra bas sna tshogs su btags pa min par thal/ phye ma leb la sogs pa la yod pa'i yan lag can gyi sna tshogs mi srid pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ sngon po la sogs yan lag re re ba chos can/ khyod la ldan pa dang sna tshogs pa 'phrod pa 'du ba min par thal/ khyod la sna tshogs 'phrod pa 'du ba min pa'i phyir/ riṃm/ dbang shes chos can/ khyod kyis sngo sogs rim bzhin du bzung nas phyis kyi rtog pas gcig tu bsre ba min par thal/ blo gcig gis don du ma cig char mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ blo chos can/ khyod kyis don du ma cig car 'dzin te/ khyod kyis khra bo'i kha dog sna tshogs cig car 'dzin pa'i phyir/ sngon po mthong ba'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod rtog med du grub ste/ khyod rgyud ldan gang zag gi rgyud la khyod dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i rtog pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ rags snang la brten rtsod pa dgod/ phyogs gnyis brtags te lan gnyis bshad pa'o// dang po ni/

snaṃ/ blo ma 'khrul pa la sna tshogs su snang na rdzas gcig ma yin pas khyab na/ khra 'dzin (225) dbang shes la khra bo rags pa snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ blo ma 'khrul pa la rdzas sna tshogs su mi snang bar thal/ rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rnam pa bden pa med pas rdzas gcig nyid mi 'grub/ grub kyang rtags la khyad par yod pas gnod pa med pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ rnam pa brdzun pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med pa bsgrub/ tshul des rigs can gzhan yang khegs/ de la ha cang thal ba spang ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sgrub byed dngos po stobs zhugs bstan/ gtan tshigs de yi phyogs chos bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ jiṃ/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo rags par snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ bden par med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang rung du ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gciṃg mdo sde pa na re/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo rags par snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod don dam par grub pa la skyon med de/ khyod khra bo rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ bloṃ/ de chos can/ khyod bden par ma grub par thal/ khyod bden par grub na khra 'dzin dbang shes du ma dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa gcig tu thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ galaṃ/ gal te rags par snang ba'i rnam pa mi bden par 'dod do zhe na/ rags par snang ba'i rnam pa mi bden pa de chos can/ khyod rnam rdzun pas dgag par bya ba min par thal/ khyod rnam rdzun pas 'dod pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo rags par snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod bden par med de/ phyi rol don dang nang shes pa gang rung du mi bden pa'i phyir/ gnyis (226) pa la gnyis te/ rdzas su snang ba 'khrul pa yin/ des na gnyis stong gnas lugs yin pa'o// dang po ni/ rnam bden pa na re/ phyi rol don la ltos pa'i gzugs 'dzin rdzas gzhan med kyang shes pa gcig nyid gzugs 'dzin gnyis su snang ba de snang ba ltar bden no zhe na/

yoṃngs/ sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ khyod la gzugs 'dzin gnyis su snang ba de snang ba ltar bden par med de/ khyod gcig nyid bag chags kyi dbang gis gzugs 'dzin gnyis su snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ thaṃ/ sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ khyod snang yul la 'khrul shes yin te/ khyod gzugs 'dzin rdzas gzhan du med kyang gzugs 'dzin gzhan du snang ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ de chos can/ khyod la snang ba'i gzung rnam dang de la ltos pa'i 'dzin rnam gnyis ka bden par med de/ khyod la snang ba'i gzungs rnam bden par med pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ gnyis snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod gzugs 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa de khyod kyi gnas lugs yin te/ khyod gzugs 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa dang gzugs 'dzin gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ phung po la brten gzugs 'dzin khegs/ mtshan nyid la brten byed pa khegs pa'o// dang po ni/ dngoṃs/ phung po lnga la brten pa'i gzugs 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i blo chos can/ 'khrul shes yin te/ gzugs 'dzin rdzas gzhan du snang ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzungaṃ*/ mtshan nyid kyis mtshon par bya ba'i cha chos can/ rang bzhin med de/ gzugs 'dzin gnyis su snang ba las gzhan pa'i khyod med pa'i phyir/ phungaṃ*/

(227) mtshan mtshon gyi bya byed chos can/ bden par med de/ gzugs 'dzin rdzas tha dad la brten nas btags pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gsum ste/ gnyis su snang dang 'gal ba spang*/ kun gyis de nyid rig pa spong*/ thub pa'i lung dang 'gal ba spong ba'o// dang po ni/ maṃ/ tshur mthong gi dbang shes chos can/ khyod la gzugs 'dzin gnyis su snang bas gzugs 'dzin rdzas gzhan yod par mi 'grub ste/ khyod la ma rig pa'i bag chags rkyen gyis sad pa las gzugs 'dzin gnyis su snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ phaṃ/ tshur mthong chos can/ khyod kyis gnyis stong gi de bzhin nyid ma mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyis de bzhin nyid mngon sum du mthong ba la gnyis snang bag chags kyis gegs byas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ ston pas tha snyad du phyi rol don gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ don smra ba rnams gnas lugs rtogs pa la gzhug pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub kyang rtags la khyad par yod pas gnod pa med pa la gsum ste/ shes pa'i sna tshogs rnam dbyer med/ don gyi sna tshogs rnam dbyer yod/ rdzas gcig med kyang yul du 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo rags par snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ rdzas gcig min par thal/ blo la sna tshogs su snang ba'i phyir zhes pa'i lan mdo sde pas grub mtha' la brten nas 'debs pa ni/ nged kyis/ blo rnam sna tshogs ngo bo'i phyir// zhes pa'i rtags rnam rnam par dbye nus kyi sna tshogs su snang ba yin pa'i phyir ro zhes khyad par can yin la/ khra 'dzin dbang shes kyi rnam pa (228) ni/ rnam par dbyer mi nus pa'i gtan tshigs mi 'grub bo zhes ston pa ni/ sheṃs/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo rags par snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ shes pa las rdzas gzhan du grub pa med de/ shes pa las rnam par dbyer nus kyi rdzas gzhan du tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/

gal te rjes kyi rtog pas rnam dbyer byed pa yod do zhe na/ sngo ser rnam par dbye ba'i rjes kyi rtog pa chos can/ dbang shes la snang ba'i sngo ser gyi rnam pa la dngos su rnam dbyer byed pa ma yin te/ rang la snang ba'i rnam pa la sngo ser du zhen nas rnam dbyer byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ sheṃs/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo rags par snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ sna tshogs su snang yang shes pa gcig gi ngo bor bden te/ sna tshogs su snang ba'i shes pa gcig gi ngo bo rang rig mngon sum gyis myong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rasaṃ/ ras dang phye ma leb la sogs pa'i sngo ser rnams kyang rdzas gcig yin no zhe na/ deṃ/ ras khra bo'i sngo ser chos can/ rnam par dbyer med par thal/ rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ thaṃ/ ras la sogs pa'i gzugs chos can/ yan lag gi sna tshogs las ma gtogs yan lag can gyi sna tshogs med de/ de snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gaṃl/ gal te yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med na rdul phran tshogs kyang dbang shes kyi yul du mi rung bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ sngon po'i rdul phran gzhan dang tshogs pa'i rdul phran khyad par can de chos can/ yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med kyang rang 'bras dbang shes kyi yul du rung ste/ de med kyang rang 'bras dbang shes la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed yin pa'i (229) phyir/ dper na dbang po sogs rkyen gsum po yan lag can gyi rdzas gcig med kyang dbang shes kyi rgyu yin pa bzhin/ gal te rgyu yin yang dbang shes kyi yul du mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ rgyu de chos can/ de'i gzung yul yin te/ de'i rkyen gsum gyi nang nas de la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa nog sogs cig char 'dzin pa med par thal ba la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ jiṃ/ dkar zal ba lang du shes pa'i blo chos can/ ba lang rang gi yan lag dang bcas pa cig char ma bzung bar thal/

blo gcig gis cig car mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ dkar zal ba lang du ngo shes pa min par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃl/ gal te ba lang dang de'i yan lag can chos can/ blo gcig gis cig car 'dzin te/ khyad gzhi khyad chos su gyur pa'i don du ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na khyad gzhi khyad chos su ma gyur ba'i don du ma blo gcig gis cig car mi 'dzin pa yin no zhe na/ gciṃg ba lang 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ ba lang gi yan lag cig car mi 'dzin par thal/ khyad gzhi khyad chos su ma gyur pa'i don du ma cig car mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ ba lang gi rna ba 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ ba lang gi rna ba de sngon po sogs kyis khyad par du byas nas 'dzin pa min par thal/ gtan tshigs snga ma de'i phyir/ khyadaṃ/ khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi 'brel pa chos can/ don dam par ma grub par thal/ rtog pas sgro btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ yaṃn/ ba lang chos can/ khyod rang gi yan lag du (230) mas khyad par du byas nas 'dzin pa mi srid par thal/ khyod kyi yan lag du ma cig car 'dzin mi srid pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sna tshogs gzhan du shes pa med par thal ba la gnyis te/ thal ba dgod/ nyes spong dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ rangaṃ*/ bum snam 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ bum snam gnyis po gzhan du mi shes par thal/ bum snam gnyis po gzhan du 'jog par byed pa'i khyad chos cig car ma bzung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te sngar bum pa sogs kyi rdzas 'gaṃ' zhig bzung nas phyis khyad chos bzung bas gzhan du rtogs par 'gyur ro zhe na/ yoṃn/ bum snam sogs chos can/ khyod kyi yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel pa 'chol bar thal/ khyod kyi yan lag gi sngar yan lag can gzung dgos pa'i phyir/ lnga pa du ma cig car 'dzin pa gzhan la'ang yod pa ni/ sgra/ཾ grangs can pa ltar na/ sgra 'dzin dbang shes chos can/ bde sdug btang snyoms gsum cig car gzung bar thal/

de gsum gyi bkod par gyur pa'i sgra cig car gzung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa rigs pas gnod pa'i rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis te/ ldog pa du ma dbang po'i spyod yul min/ dbang po'i spyod yul sgra yi brjod bya min pa'o// dang po ni/ mdor/ du ma'i ngo bo'i chos can ni// dbang po las rtogs srid ma yin// zhes pa'i don 'grel pa la gnyis te/ du ma'i ngo bo'i chos can bsgrub/ dbang po'i spyod yul min pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ choṃs/ sgra chos can/ sel ngor ldog pa du ma dang ldan te/ ma byas rtag sogs las log par don la gnas pa'i phyir// (231) gnyis pa ni/ rtaṃgs/ sgra'i steng gi byas mi rtag sogs kyi ldog pa du ma chos can/ dbang shes la sna tshogs su snang ba min te/ dbang shes kyi yul min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mdor/ rang rang rig bya tha snyad kyis// bstan min ngo bo dbang po'i yul// zhes sogs kyi don 'grel pa la gsum ste/ gtan tshigs dgod/ khyab pa bsgrub/ phyogs chos bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ gaṃl/ dkar 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod kyi gzung yul de sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya min te/ khyod dang sgra la brten pa'i rtog pa gnyis rang yul gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te dkar 'dzin mngon sum dang dkar 'dzin rtog pa gnyis gzung don gcig yin yang bdag rkyen tha dad pas rang yul gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par du 'gyur ro zhe na/ bloṃ/ dbang po'i mngon sum lnga po chos can/ rang yul gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par yod par thal/ bdag rkyen gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ seṃms/ dkar po nyid kyi spyi de chos can/ khyod dkar 'dzin dbang shes la gsal ba dang dkar 'dzin rtog pa la mi gsal ba'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ khyod de gnyis kyi gzung yul yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gal te mngon sum dang sgra rtog yul gcig nyid yin te/ mngon sum gyis mthong ba kho na la sgra rtog 'jug pa'i phyir zhe na/

mthoṃng*/ ba lang chos can/ khyod mngon sum gyis mthong ba kho na la sgra rtog 'jug pa min par thal/ khyod mngon sum gyis mthong ba med pa khyod ces brjod pa'i sgra dang rnam rtog 'jug pa'i phyir/ baṃ/ mngon sum dang sgra rtogs dngos yul tha dad du (232) bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ ba lang gi yul can gyi sgra rtog 'jug pa'i rtags las mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i ba lang la ba lang gi rigs sogs don gzhan yod pa dpog pa de yang gsal ba'i phyir/ mthoṃng*/ ba gsal rnams chos can/ khyod la ba spyi rdzas gzhan pa med kyang ba lang du ngo shes pa'i blo 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod ba lang gi don byed mi nus pa las log pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ba lang du ngo shes pa'i blo 'jug pa'i phyir// gnyis pa rkyen gsum rtsod spong bcas te yid kyi mngon sum bshad pa ni/ mdor/ yid kyang don dang zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyi don 'grel pa la bzhi/ mtha' gnyis brtags pa'i rtsod pa dgod/ snga ma 'thad pa'i gzhan lan dgag phyi ma 'thad pa'i rang lan brjod/ de la rtsod pa brgyud ma dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ sngaṃr/ mu stegs rna ba ma phugs pa na re/ yid kyi mngon sum des sngar dbang po'i mngon sum gyis gzung zin gyi don 'dzin nam/ ma gzung ba'i don 'dzin/ dang po ltar na yid kyi mngon sum chos can/ tshad ma min par thal/ tshad mas gzung zin gyi don 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na long ba'i rgyud la gzugs 'dzin yid mngon yod par thal/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon des gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyis ma gzung ba'i don 'dzin pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'das phyir sngar myong mthong ba med/ mthong na thal ba gsum gyis gnod pa'o// dang po ni/ skadaṃ/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon chos can/ rang gi de ma thag rkyen gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyis gzung don mthong ba min te/ de khyod kyi dngos rgyu'i (233)

dus na 'das pa'i phyir te/ de khyod kyi dngos rgyu'i snga rol du byung ba'i skad cig snga ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skadaṃ/ gal te gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung don de rtag pa yin pas gzugs 'dzin yid mngon gyis gzung ba yin no zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid la gzung zin gyi don la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhes pa'i khyad par brjod dgos par thal/ khyod tshad ma snga mas gzung zin gyi don la bsnan nas 'dzin pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ byaṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig gnyis pa dang*/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon skad cig dang po gnyis chos can/ rang gi gzung don gyi sgrub byed min par thal/ rang gi gzung don la gsar rtogs kyi bya ba mi byed pa'i phyir/ dngoṃs/ yid mngon skad cig snga phyi thams cad chos can/ cig car skye bar thal/ gzung don rtag pa'i dngos po las skyes pa'i phyir/ rtag pa chos can/ rkyen la ltos nas yid mngon rim can du bskyed pa min par thal/ rkyen gyis khyad par byar med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon chos can/ rang gi de ma thag rkyen gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung don las gzhan gyi gzugs 'dzin te de 'dzin pa'am rang gi de ma thag rkyen gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung don de nyid 'dzin pa gang rung gang zhig phyi ma bkag zin pa'i phyir/ long ba chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la gzugs 'dzin yid mngon med de/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi rgyun 'gags nas skad cig du ma (234) lon pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la gsum ste/ yul gzhan 'dzin na nges med 'dzin pa spang*/ yid kyi gzung don dus mnyam yin pa spang*/ dus tha dad na gzugs 'dzin min pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ raṃng*/ gzugs 'dzin yid kyi mngon sum chos can/ rang yul nges par 'dzin pa yin te/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung don skad cig gnyis pa de khyod kyi gzung don yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ gal te yid kyi mngon sum gyi gzung don chos can/ dbang mngon skad cig dang pos yid kyi mngon sum bskyed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen min par thal/ dbang po'i mngon sum dang dus mi mnyam par yid kyi mngon sum dang dus mnyam pa'i phyir zhe na/ meṃd/ yid kyi mngon sum gyi gzung don chos can/ khyod yid kyi mngon sum dang dus mnyam med par thal/ khyod yid kyi mngon sum gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam la rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ duṃs/ yid kyi mngon sum gyi gzung don chos can/ yid kyi mngon sum gyis mi 'dzin par thal/ yid kyi mngon sum dang dus mi mnyam pa'i phyir zhe na/ mdo sde pa chos can/ khyod kyi lugs la dus mi mnyam pa'i gzugs 'dzin yod de/ khyod kyi lugs la mngon sum la rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi phyi don de mngon sum dang dus mi mnyam yang de'i gzung don yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu/ཾ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung don skad cig gnyis pa chos can/ gzugs 'dzin pa'i yid mngon gyi rkyen gsum gyi nang nas khyod kho na gzugs 'dzin yid mngon (235) gyi gzung yul yin te/ gzugs 'dzin yid mngon de rkyen gsum gyi nang nas khyod kyi rnam ldan du skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa myang bya shes pa bsgrub ste rang rig mngon sum bshad pa ni/ mdor/ chags la sogs// rang rig rtog pa med pa yin// zhes pa'i don 'grel pa la gnyis te/ myong byed rtog bral nyid du bsgrub/ myang bya bem po yin pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bdeṃ/ tshor ba bde ba chos can/ khyod myong byed de rtog pa min te/ khyod la brda dngos su sbyar mi nus pa'i phyir te/ khyod brda dus su yod pa tha snyad kyi dus su rjes su mi 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bde sogs nang don bem po yin pa dgag bde sogs phyi don bem po yin pa dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/

'dod pa brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ gzhanaṃ/ tshor ba bde ba chos can/ rang gi ngo bo mi rig par thal/ yul gzhan yang rig byed min pa'i phyir te/ bem po yin pa'i phyir/ des na bde ba de bdag gi don la brten nas rnam shes rdzas gzhan gyi myang bya yin no zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bde sogs shes pa yin par bsgrub/ rnam shes gzhan gyis myong ba dgag yul gzhan rig byed nyid du bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ khyab pa bstan te gtan tshigs dgod/ phyogs chos rkyen gsum mtshungs pa bsgrub/ rkyen gsum mtshungs la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor gyi tshor ba bde ba chos can/ shes pa yin te/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi (236) rnam par shes pa dang rkyen gsum tshogs pa gcig las skyes pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'bras bu rigs 'dra mi 'dra de yin na rgyu rigs 'dra mi 'dra ba la ltos dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ doṃn/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khor gyi tshor ba bde ba chos can/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i rnam par shes pa de dang rkyen gsum mtshungs par gcig las skyes te/ khyod kyi rkyen gsum po de las gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i rnam par shes pa de yang skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa dang de'i 'khor gyi tshor ba bde ba chos can/ khyod rang rgyu rkyen gsum las skyes pa yin gyi/ bdag gi yon tan 'du byed las mi skye ste/ khyod rang rgyu rkyen gsum phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor gyi tshor ba bde sdug chos can/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gsum las skyes pa mtshungs kyang sim gdung gi khyad par yod de/ der mtshungs kyang rkyen gsum nyid kyi nang sel gyi khyad par las sim gdung nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir/

dper na rtog pa mtshungs kyang phan tshun ltos nas gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par yod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ blo gnyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i phyogs la gzhan myong med/ blo gnyis cig car 'byung ba'i phyogs la gzhan myong med pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ dus mnyam gzhan gyis myong ba dgag phyis 'byung gzhan gyis myong ba dgag gcig gis gnyis ka 'dzin pa dgag bde sogs 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa dgag

(237) gzung yul 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ doṃn/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ gzung don gzugs bor nas bde ba gzung don du byas nas mi 'dzin par thal/ khyod dang khyod kyi 'khor gyi bde ba gnyis ka khyod kyi gzung don gzugs las skyes pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rigaṃs/ thog mar dbang shes kyis gzung don 'dzin/ de'i rjes su yid shes kyis bde ba rim gyis spel nas 'dzin no zhe na/ bde ba myong ba'i blo chos can/ bde ba bar ma chad du myong bar mi 'gyur bar thal/ bde ba myong ba'i snga phyi'i bar du gzugs sogs 'dzin pas bar du chod pa'i phyir/ gal te bde ba myong ba 'jug pa mgyogs pa'i phyir/ bar chad med par snang ngo zhe na/ gzugs sogs 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ gzugs sogs bar ma chad du snang bar thal/ gzugs sogs 'dzin pa 'jug pa mgyogs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dbang po'i rnam par shes pas yul gzugs sogs dang bde ba gnyis ka cig car 'dzin par byed do zhe na/ gciṃg gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ khyod kyis gzugs dang bde ba gnyis ka gzung don du byas nas 'dzin pa min par thal/ khyod kyi gzung don yin na gzugs yin pas khyab pa'i phyir dang*/ khyod bskyed pa la rang dang dus mnyam pa'i bde ba de nus pa grub pa med pa'i phyir te/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i bde ba med kyang rang gi gzung don gzugs las skyes pa'i phyir/ gnyisaṃ/ gal te gzugs dang bde ba gnyis kas gzung don so sor byed do zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi (238) rnam par shes pa chos can/ res 'ga' bde ba 'ba' zhig 'dzin par thal/ bde ba rkyang pas khyod kyi gzung don byed nus pa'i phyir/ dper na sngo ser so sor rang 'bras dbang shes kyi gzung don nus pas res 'ga' sngon po rkyang pa dbang shes kyis 'dzin nus pa bzhin no// 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod kyis gzugs ma gzung na bde ba 'dzin mi nus pa'i phyir/

doṃn/ gal te dbang shes kyis gzugs sogs dang bde ba lhan cig tu 'dzin no zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ bde bas khyod kyi gzung don byed mi nus par thal/ bde bas gzung don byed pa'i sgo nas khyod bskyed pa med pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ doṃn/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa des phyi rol gyi don gzung don du mi byed par bde ba 'ba' zhig gzung don du byed do zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ bud med sogs kyi gzugs mdzes sogs mi 'dzin par thal/ bde ba 'ba' zhig gzung don du byas nas 'dzin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bde ba gzung don du byed na phyi rol gyi don mi mthong bas khyab pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ doṃn/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa des gzugs kho na gzung don du byas nas 'dzin no zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ rang las rdzas gzhan pa'i bde ba myong ba mi 'gyur bar thal/ gzugs kho na gzung don du byas nas 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yuṃl/ yul gzugs dang bde ba gnyis cig car yod pa'i tshe/ de gnyis cig car du myong ba'i blo skye'o zhe na// (239) skyes bu gcig gi rgyud la chos can/ bde sdug gnyis cig car du myong bar thal/ yul 'dod mi 'dod gnyis cig car du yod pa'i phyir/ gangaṃ*/ gal te nyer len yid kyi rnam par shes pa gcig las med pas bde sdug gnyis cig car du mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ gangaṃ*/ bde sdug gnyis chos can/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa de khyod kyi nyer len min par thal/ khyod bem po yin pa'i phyir/ bdagaṃ gal te mig gi rnam pa shes pa de bde sdug gnyis kyi bdag rkyen yin pas bdag rkyen gcig las bde sdug 'gal ba gnyis mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ deṃ/ bdag rkyen gcig gis bdag 'bras 'gal ba gnyis bskyed pa yod par thal/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig gis 'ug pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pas gzugs mi mthong ba dang*/

mi'i mig gi rnam par shes pas gzugs mthong ba'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yul gzhan rig byed nyid du bstan pa ni/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor gyi tshor ba bde ba chos can/ yul gzhan rig ste/ don gyi rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam par snang ba'i phyir/ deṃs/ rang gi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i rnam par rig pa'i bde sogs chos can/ phyi don dngos su myong ba ma yin te/ phyi don gyi rnam par myong ba la/ phyi don myong ba btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ doṃn/ de chos can/ don gyi rnam par myong ba la don myong ba btags nas bshad de/ don gyis rang ngos gtad nas pa'i rnam par shes pa rang gi bdag nyid du gyur pa de myong ba yin pa'i phyir/ de (240) chos can/ phyi don dmigs pa yin te/ phyi don gyis gtad pa'i rnam par snang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa bde sogs phyi don bem po yin pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'gaṃ'/ grangs can pa na re/ bde sogs ni phyi rol de tsam lnga'i rang bzhin dang*/ sems med pa'i bem po dang*/ rnam par shes pa rdzas gzhan gyi myang bya de khyad chos gsum ldan yin gyi/ rang rig pa min no zhes zer ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bde sogs gzhan gyis gzung ba dgag bde sogs phyi rol yin pa dgag bde sogs sems med yin pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam shes chos can/ gzugs dang bde sogs gnyis ka cig car gzung don byed pa min par thal/ khyod kyi gzung don yin na gzugs yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ snang rung ma dmigs rtags kyis dgag ha cang thal ba'i rigs pas dgag de yi nyes spong brgyud mar dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ sngoṃ/ gal te phyi rol de tsam lnga dang bde sogs gcig yin pas gcig car 'dzin no zhe na/ thaṃ/ sngo sogs dang bde sogs chos can/ rdzas tha dad yin par thal/

blo ma 'khrul pa la rdzas tha dad du snang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ phyiṃ/ skyes bu du ma'i rgyud la chos can/ phyi rol gyi don gcig la dmigs nas 'dod mi 'dod goms pa las dga' gdung gi khyad par du mi 'gyur bar thal/ nyams su myang bya'i bde sdug gnyis ka phyi rol gyi don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ galaṃ/ gal te phyi don gyi ngo bor (241) gyur pa'i bde sogs goms pa las dga' gdung gi khyad par du mi 'gyur yang*/ blo'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bde sogs goms pa las dga' gdung gi khyad par du 'gyur bas mi 'gal lo zhe na/ deṃ/ de tsam lnga po de bde sogs min par thal/ dga' gdung gi ngor nyams su myang bar bya ba de yin na blo yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ de tsam lnga po chos can/ bde sogs yin te/ bde sogs kyi bdag nyid can gyi blo'i gzung yul yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rigs tha dad yin na gzugs 'dzin min dgos pa'i phyir zhe na/ bdag shes rig gi skyes bu chos can/ yul kun gyi 'dzin byed min par thal/ yul kun dang rigs tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ yul kun gyi za ba po min par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'diṃs/ rigs tha dad yin na gzugs 'dzin min pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ rigs tha dad yin na rgyu 'bras min pas khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de tsam lnga po bde sogs su 'dod pa de yang bsal ba'i phyir/ phyi rol gyi bde sogs dang blo'am chen po chos can/ rnam par 'jog pa'i rgyu dang des bzhag pa'i 'bras bu min par thal/ rigs tha dad yin pas gzugs 'dzin min pa'i phyir/ gal te gzugs 'dzin yin pa tsam gyis rgyu 'bras su 'gyur na/ bdag shes rig gi skyes bu dang yul chos can/ rgyu 'bras su thal/ gzugs 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bde sogs sems med yin pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ myang bya yin pas sems su grub/

myong byed gzhan gyis myong ba dgag pa'o// (242) dang po ni/ deṃ/ bde sogs chos can/ nang nyid yin te/ goms pa las dga' gdung du gyur pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sems kyi rang bzhin yin te/ sems kyi myang bya yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ myang bya de'i rang bzhin min na myang bya de'i myong byed min dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ blo myong tha dad ma dmigs rtags kyis dgag khyab pa ma nges mtshon pa'i dpe gnyis dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ gaṃl/ ma grub ste/ bdag shes rig gi skyes bu de bde sogs kyi rang bzhin min yang blo'am chen po la rnam par shar ba'i bde sogs myong ba'i phyir zhe na/ mngoṃn/ bde sogs chos can/ nyams su myong ba'i rnam pa can dang rjes kyi dran pa'i rnam pa can las ma gtogs pa'i khyod kyi rnam par shar ba'i blo'am chen po med par thal/ de snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ phyi'i dpe dgag nang gi dpe dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ lcagaṃs/ blo myong gnyis po don la tha dad kyang 'dres pas blo la tha dad du mi snang ba yin te/ lcags gong dmar 'bar bar song ba'i tshe lcags rdul dang me rdul bzhin no zhe na/ deṃ/ dngos po la rdzas tha dad dang rdzas tha dad ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag mi 'thad par thal/ mngon sum gyis rdzas gcig tu ma dmigs na rdzas gcig min pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ thaṃ/ mngon sum gyis rdzas tha dad du dmigs pa de rdzas tha dad pa'i sgrub byed min par thal/ mngon sum gyis rdzas gcig tu dmigs pa de rdzas gcig pa'i sgrub byed min pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ldog khyab rtags/ gduṃg dngos po la 'ga' zhig rdzas tha dad dang 'ga' (243) zhig rdzas tha dad med par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan med par thal/ rdul dang dkar sogs rdzas tha dad du snang yang rdzas tha dad min/ blo dang myong ba gnyis rdzas gcig tu snang yang rdzas gcig min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam shes gcig gi 'khor du tshor ba bde ba lta bu gsal por skyes pa'i tshe/

sdug bsngal sogs tha dad du ma dmigs kyang tha dad pa bzhin du blo myong gnyis po tha dad du yod kyang tha dad du ma dmigs so zhe na/ gciṃg gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor du tshor ba bde ba gsal por skyes pa'i tshe/ tshor ba sdug bsngal ma dmigs kyang tshor ba bde sdug gnyis rdzas tha dad du grub ste/ khyod kyi rgyun phyi ma la tshor ba sdug bsngal skyes pa'i tshe/ sdug bsngal de sngar gyi bde ba de las tha dad du dmigs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yang dag gsal snang sgrub ste rnal 'byor mngon sum bshad pa ni/ tshad ma mdor/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi bla mas bstan// ma 'dres pa yi don tsam mthong*// zhes pa'i don 'grel pa la gsum ste/ mtshan gzhi sgom byung bstan/ mtshan nyid rtog bral bsgrub/ bral bya rtog pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rnaṃl/ bden bzhi'i steng gi mi rtag sogs bcu drug goms pa las goms bya'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i blo de chos can/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin te/ yang dag pa'i don goms pa las yang dag pa'i don la gsal snang bskyed pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ goms las gsal snang 'byung ba bsgrub/ gsal ba snang bas rtog med bsgrub/ yang dag min (244) la'ang gsal snang yod/ tshad ma yin min phye ste bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rtoṃg 'phags pa'i bden bzhi bsgom pa'i blo chos can/ goms pa mthar thug pa na goms bya'i don la gsal snang 'byung ste/ goms pa mthar thug pa na goms bya'i don la rtog bral du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na 'dod 'jig sogs goms pa'i blo bzhin/ gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃl/ rnal 'byor mngon sum chos can/ yang dag pa'i don la rtog pa med pa yin te/ yang dag pa'i don gsal ba snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ yul de la rtog pa yin na yul de mi gsal ba snang bas khyab pa'i phyir/ gal te rtog pa la yang gsal snang yod de/

rmi lam gyi shes pa bzhin no zhe na/ rmiṃ/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kyi dran pa rtog pa chos can/ rang yul mi gsal ba snang ba yin te/ rang yul mi gsal ba snang ba rjes kyi dran shes kyis dran pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ miṃ/ yang dag pa min pa'i don bsgoms pa las kyang gsal snang 'byung ba yod de/ mi sdug pa dang zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin sogs pa bsgoms pa las bsgom bya'i don la rtog med dang gsal snang 'byung ba mthong ba'i phyir/ deṃ/ yang dag pa bdag med pa'i don dang yang dag pa min pa zad par sogs kyi don bsgom pa'i blo chos can/ sgom pa rdzogs pa na bsgom bya'i don la gsal snang dang rtog med du 'gyur te/ rten brtan/ goms pa rang gi ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur ba'i bsgom bya'i don de sgom pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ deṃ/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bsgoms pa las bsgom bya'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i blo chos can/ tshad ma yin te/ mi bslu (245) ba'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin goms pa las goms bya'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i blo chos can/ tshad ma ma yin te/ bslu ba'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sheṃs/ bum 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ bum pa la rtog pa yin te/ bum pa la sgra don dngos su 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rang gi ngo bo la rtog bral yin te/ rang gi ngo bo la sgra don mi 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rang gi ngo bo la mngon sum yin te/ rang gi ngo bo la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma 'khrul rtogs phyir mngon sum ltar snang bshad pa ni/ mdor/ 'khrul dang kun rdzob shes pa dang*// rjes dpag rjes su dpag las byung*// dran dang mngon 'dod ces bya 'oṃ// mngon sum ltar snang rab rib bcas// zhes gsungs pa'i don 'grel pa la gsum ste/ mngon sum ltar snang bzhi ru bsdu/

rtog pa gsum gyi dgos pa bshad/ bslad pa logs su bkar ba'i don no// dang po ni/ mngoṃn/ mdor mngon sum ltar snang bdun du bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa'i sgo nas bzhir 'dus te/ brda rten can dang don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa'i dang*/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don can dang*/ rtog pa mngon sum ltar snang gsum dang*/ rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gcig rnams su 'dus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dgos pa mdor bstan/ rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dbaṃng*/ kun rdzob pa'i shes pa dang 'khrul pa'i shes pa gnyis mngon sum ltar snang (246) gi dbye ba bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ de gnyis dbang po las skyes pa'i shes pa min par sgrub pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ rjeṃs/ rjes dpag sogs bzhi mngon sum ltar snang gi dbye ba bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rtog pa snga ma gnyis dbang shes min par sgrub pa'i mthun dpe bstan pa'i khyad yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'khrul pa spong ba rgyas par bshad/ rjes dpag sogs sgrub rgyas par bshad/ snga ma sgrub tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ brdaṃ/ brda rten can dang don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa chos can/ khyod dbang shes su 'khrul rgyu yod de/ khyod dbang po'i mngon sum dang*/ yul la lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis der 'khrul pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ji/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don can gyi rtog pa bzhi po chos can/ mngon sum ma yin te/ rang yul 'dzin pa brda dran la ltos pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ brda rten can gyi rtog pa dang don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ gsum pa la gsum ste/ dbang shes yin pa'i rang lugs brjod/ yid rtog yin pa'i gzhan lugs dgag dgag sgrub gnyis kyi don bsdu bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'diṃr/ mdor mngon sum ltar snang gi dbye ba 'chad pa'i skabs su rab rib can sogs kyi tshig gsungs pa chos can/
dgos pa yod de/ rtog pa dang bral mngon sum mo// zhes spyir btang ba la rtog pa dang bral yang 'khrul na mngon sum ltar snang yin zhes dmigs kyis bsal ba'i ched yin

(247) pa'i phyir/ rtog med mngon sum ltar snang ston pa'i skabs su rab rib can gyi shes pa dper smos pa chos can/ dbang shes 'khrul pa thams can mtshon par byed de/ dbang shes 'khrul pa bskyed pa'i rkyen tsam ston pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ mdo'i 'grel byed kha cig na re/ rab rib can dang zla ba gnyis snang la sogs pa'i shes pa de yang yid rtog kho na yin pas de bsal ba la dmigs bsal gyi tshig don med de/ mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid rtog bral gyis sel ba'i phyir zhes zer ro// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ yid blo lung dang rigs pas dgag rtog pa dngos stobs rigs pas dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rtsod sgrub mkhan po'i lung gis dgag dbang rten gzhan la mtshungs pas dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ sngoṃ/ zla gnyis gsal snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod yid kyi shes pa min par thal/ khyod yid kyi shes pa yin pa la rtsod sgrub las de dag kyang don dam par rnam pa gzhan du yod pa dag ni zla ba gnyis la sogs par snang ba dang*/ sngon po la sogs par snang ba'i shes pa'i rgyu yin no zhes pa'i lung gis gnod pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ lung de'i don dbang po gzugs can pa zla gnyis gsal snang gi shes pa'i brgyud rgyu yin pa la dgongs pas skyon med do zhe na/ phyi don dbang shes kyi dmigs rkyen yin pa 'gog pa'i skabs 'dir chos can/ yid shes kyi brgyud rgyu yin pa'i phyir na/ dbang shes kyi dmigs rkyen du thal ba skabs su babs pa min par thal// (248) dbang shes kyi rgyu yin pas dbang shes kyi dmigs rkyen yin par 'dod pa 'gog pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbaṃng*/ dbang po la brten pa'i shes pa'i 'jog byed gang yin/ dbang po gzugs can pa phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir zhe na/ zla gnyis gsal snang gi shes pa chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir/ gal te dbang po gsal mi gsal du 'gyur pa'i rjes su gsal mi gsal du 'gyur ba dang ldan pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ zla gnyis gsal snang gi shes pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ha cang thal ba bzhi yis dgag gsal ba snang ba'i rtags kyis dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'diṃr/ zla gnyis gsal snang gi shes pa chos can/ rang gi bdag rkyen dbang po bslad pa phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi byed par thal/ yid rtog yin pa'i phyir/ thag khra la sbrul du 'khrul pa'i blo bzhin/ de chos can/ rang yul brjod pas rang nyid skye bar thal/ yid rtog yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rang gi yul mthong ba brda dran la ltos par thal ba dang*/ rang yul mi gsal ba snang bar thal/ yid rtog yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyiṃd/ gnyid log pa'am sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi rang yul gsal snang can gyi blo chos can/ rtog med yin te/ sgra don 'dzin pas stong pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis ka'ang yul mi gsal ba snang ba'i de chos can/ rtog pa yin te/ sgra don dngos su 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa (249) ni/ deṃ/ zla ba gnyis gsal snang gi dbang shes chos can/ khyod rtog med yin na'ang tshad mar 'gyur ba rab rib bcas// zhes pa'i tshig gis bkag pa yin te/ khyod rtog med yin yang bslu ba'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pa dang rtog med kyi mngon sum ltar snang gi sde tshan gnyis so sor bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 'khrul shes yin na mngon sum min par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gzhal bya rtogs pa'i sgrub byed tshad 'bras bshad pa la gnyis te/ tshad 'bras gzhal gsum rnam gzhag bshad/ rnam gzhag de yi sgrub byed bshad pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ phyi don las byung don rig tshad 'bras bshad/ bag chags brtan byung rnam rig tshad 'bras bshad/ phyi don yod kyang rang rig 'bras bur grub/

rnam pa rdzun yang rang rig 'bras bur grub pa'o// dang po la gsum pa ste/ tshad 'bras bdag nyid gcig par bsgrub/ tshad 'bras don gzhan yin pa dgag bdag gcig pa la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ don rtogs 'jog nus sgrub byed yin/ 'jog nus khyad par gnyis ldan dgos/ des na tshad 'bras don gzhan min/ de ltar yin yang bya byed rung ba'o// dang po ni/ byaṃ/ spyir bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed zhes pa'i skabs 'dir chos can/ bsgrub bya gang rung gcig sgrub pa la sgrub byed thams cad dang*/ sgrub byed gang rung gcig gis bsgrub bya thams cad bsgrub nus pa min te/ bsgrub bya gsum po so so la sgrub byed gsum po so sor 'jug pa'i phyir/ 'o na skabs 'dir gang yin zhe na// (250) tshad 'bras kyi skabs 'dir chos can/ sgrub byed gsum gyi nang nas rnam par 'jog byed nyid sgrub byed yin te/ bsgrub bya gsum gyi nang nas rnam pa gzhag bya'i 'bras bu bsgrub byar 'jog pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ shes pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dgos/ don gyi rnam par shar ba dgos pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ shes pas don rtogs 'byed par nus/ des na dbang po 'jog byed min pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod kyis don rtogs so sor 'byed par byed pa'i chos de yin na khyod kyi bdag nyid yin pa dgos te/ khyod las rdzas gzhan yin na khyod kyis don rtogs so sor 'byed par byed pa'i chos min dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang po gzugs can pa chos can/ khyod gsal mi gsal las dbang po'i mngon sum gsal mi gsal du gyur pa yod kyang*/ dbang po'i mngon sum gyis don rtogs so sor 'byed mi nus te/ khyod dbang po'i mngon sum las rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ don 'bras don rtogs 'jog par nus/ des na dbang po 'jog byed min pa'o// dang po ni/

deṃ/ dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod kyis don rtogs so sor 'byed par byed pa'i chos de yin na don gyi rnam pa tha dad du shar dgos te/ don gyi rnam pa tha dad du ma shar na khyod kyis don rtogs so sor 'byed mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnaṃms/ dbang po gzugs can pa chos can/ khyod gsal mi gsal las dbang po'i mngon sum gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par yod kyang*/ khyod kyis dbang po'i mngon sum gyi don (251) rtogs so sor 'byed mi nus te/ khyod la don gyi rnam pa ma shar ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum la/ sngon pos rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam par shar ba chos can/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyis sngon po rtogs pa'i sgrub byed yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ gal te don rtogs kyi sgrub byed don dang 'dra ba las gzhan yin na/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ sngon po dang yul yul can gyi 'brel pa ma grub par thal/ sngon po'i rnam pa ma shar ba'i phyir/ sngon po rtogs pa chos can/ sngon po'i rnam par shar ba las gzhan ma yin te/ sngon po'i rnam par shar ba de khyod kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ tshad 'bras bdag nyid gcig yin zhing bya byed don gzhan med na bya byed kyi tha snyad mi rung bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ deṃ/ sngor snang dbang shes kyi rang bzhin sngon pos rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam par shar ba de chos can/ don la byed pa don gzhan med kyang sngon po rtogs pa 'jog pa'i byed pa dang bcas pa lta bur snang ste/ don la byed pa don gzhan med kyang khyod kyi dbang gis sngon por rtogs pa 'jog nus pa'i phyir/ dpeṃr/ dper na 'bras bu bu tsha'i lus de pha ma'i gzugs dang 'dra bar skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bu tsha des pha ma'i gzugs 'dzin zhes brjod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyir dgag

so sor dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ don la lta ba dang*/ dbang po gzugs can pa dang*/ dbang don phrad pa dang*/ khyad par 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ don rtogs tshad ma'i sgrub byed min (252) te/ don rtogs tshad ma dang rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ byaṃ/ khyab ste/ don rtogs tshad ma'i sgrub byed gsum gyi nang nas skabs 'dir don rtogs tshad ma'i 'jog byed de/ don rtogs tshad ma'i sgrub byed du 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ dbang po don rtogs 'jog byed min/ khyad par 'dzin pa 'jog byed min/ dbang don 'phrad pa 'jog byed min/ goms las 'dus byas 'jog byed min pa'o// dang po ni/ kuṃn/ mig dbang gaṃzugs can pa chos can/ don rtogs so sor 'byed mi nus pa thal/ mig gi rnam par shes pa kun gyi mtshungs rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ de chos can/ mig gi rnam par shes pas sngo ser sogs rtogs pa so sor 'byed mi nus par thal/ sngo ser sogs kyi rnam par ma shar ba'i phyir/ 'diṃs/ dbang po don rtogs kyi 'jog byed tshad ma min par bstan pa'i rigs pa chos can/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ don la lta ba sogs kyang don rtogs kyi 'jog byed tshad ma min par bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ yon tan sogs khyad par 'dzin pa'i blo chos can/ khyad par can gyi yul can min par khyad par gyi yul can yin pa'i khyad par mi 'thad par thal/ de gnyis kyi rnam par ma shar bar mtshungs pa'i phyir/ bloṃ/ khyad par can rdzas 'dzin pa'i blo la'ang 'gre'o// byaṃ/ khyad par dang khyad par can gyi shes pa chos can/ dngos yul tha dad la 'jug pa mi srid pa thal/ rnam par gzhag 'jog gi bsgrub bya sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir/ donaṃ/ gal te skyon med de/ shes pa de gnyis dus snga phyir 'byung bas don gcig la 'jug pa'i phyir (253) zhe na/ khyad par gyi shes pa chos can/ don gcig la khyod kyi rjes su khyad par can gyi shes pa don med par thal/

khyod kyi don de nges shes 'dren pa'i tshul gyis rtogs zin pa'i phyir/ blo gnyis po chos can/ rim bzhin 'byung ba mi 'thad par thal/ gzung don gcig las skyes pa'i phyir/ bloṃ/ de gnyis cig car 'byung na blo de gnyis chos can/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed min par thal/ cig car 'byung ba'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ khyod rang la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ deṃ/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod kyi rdzas gcig la tshad 'bras kyi bsgrub bya sgrub byed gzhag tu rung ste/ khyod kyi rdzas gcig la sngon po dang 'dra ba'i cha dang*/ sngon po rtogs pa'i cha gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ bdaṃg bum 'dzin mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ bum pa'i chos kun dang 'phrad par khyad par med na yang*/ bum pa'i gzugs kho na rtogs pa'i nges pa med par thal/ bum pa'i skad cig sogs thams cad dang 'phrad par khyad par med pa'i phyir/ nyes pa de khyod rang la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ deṃ/ bum pa'i chos kun dang 'phrad par khyad par med na yang*/ bum pa'i gzugs kyis rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam par shar ba chos can/ bum gzugs rtogs pa'i mngon sum gyi sgrub byed yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ gal te shes pa snga mas phyi ma don so sor 'dzin par 'dus byas pa las don rtogs so sor 'jog pa yin no zhe na/ 'dusaṃ/ don so sor 'dzin par 'dus byas pa de chos can/ don rtogs so sor 'jog mi nus (254) par thal/ don gyi rnam par shar ba med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gaṃl/ don rtogs dang don 'dra ba chos can/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed min par thal/ rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma khyab par thal/ ldog pa tha dad la bsgrub bya sgrub byed 'jog tu rung ba'i phyir/ byaṃ/ bya ba dang byed pa tha dad pa'i tha snyad thams cad chos can/ ldog pa tha dad tsam yin gyi don la tha dad du med de/ bya byed kyi tha snyad yin pa'i phyir/

thaṃ/ dper na st+wa gris shing gcod pa lta bu la las shing dang gcod byed st+wa gri gnyis po las tha dad pa'i bya byed don gzhan med de/ shing dum bur song ba la bya ba dang st+wa gri la byed pa'i tha snyad sgro btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bag chags brtan byung rnam rig tshad 'bras bshad pa la gnyis te/ don dam rang rig tshad 'bras bshad/ tha snyad don rig tshad 'bras bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ snang ba don 'bras yin pa bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur bsgrub/ snang ba phyi don yin pa bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan bden pa dgag des na rang rig 'bras bur grub pa'o// dang po la lnga ste/ phyi don rig pa'i sgrub byed dgag des na gzung 'dzin gnyis med bsgrub/ rang nyid rig la rtsod pa spang*/ don gzhan rig la gnod byed bstan/ med kyang snang ba 'khrul ngor bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ phyi don rig pa'i sgrub byed dri/ brjod pa'i sgrub byed rgyas par dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ doṃn/ mdo sde pa khyod don rig 'bras bur 'dod na/ de'i (255) mtshan gzhi gang yin/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi rnam par shar ba'i mngon sum 'di nyid do zhe na/ de gang gis don rig tu 'jog don dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'dra ba tsam gyis bsgrub pa dgag skyes la 'dra bas bsgrub pa dgag nges dang bcas pas bsgrub pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khruṃl/ don dang 'dra ba chos can/ don rtogs pa'i 'jog byed min par thal/ khyod yin na don rtogs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'o na don snang gi shes pas don myong ba'i 'jog byed gang yin zhe na/ doṃn/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe khyod kyi don myong ba'i 'jog byed med par thal/ de'i tshe khyod kyis don myong ba nyid mi grub pa'i phyir/ rdulaṃ/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/

khyod phyi don rdul phran dang 'dra ba min par thal/ khyod la rags pa'i rnam par snang ba'i phyir/ deṃ/ de chos can/ khyod phyi don las phyi don dang 'dra ba skyes pa min par thal/ phyi don de khyod dang 'dra ba skyed byed min pa'i phyir/ yiṃn/ gal te 'dra ba yin yang don dang 'dra ba chos can/ khyod kyis don snang gi shes pas don rtogs par sgrub mi nus par thal/ khyod kyis de ltar sgrub pa'i khyab pa ma nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ don dang 'dra ba skyes pa de don myong ba'i phyir 'jog byed yin no zhe na/ doṃn/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyi rjes su skyes pa'i dran shes chos can/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum myong ba thal/ de las skyes pa 'dra ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'diṃ/ don las skyes pa 'dra ba dang*/ don la (256) nges pa 'dren nus gsum tshogs pa de don myong ba'i 'jog byed yin no zhe na/ gaṃng*/ de chos can/ de'i 'jog byed min par thal/ khyod mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ don snang gi shes pa don dang 'brel pa ma grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ don nges pa'i nges shes yin na don dang 'brel pa'i tshad ma sngon du song bas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃ/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ phyi don myong byed min te/ khyod kyis nyams su myang bya de khyod kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mngoṃn/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod kyis nyams su myang bya khyod las don gzhan du med de/ khyod la rang dus su snang ba'i rnam pa de khyod kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ don snang gi shes pa la rang dus su don du snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod kyi myong byed khyod las don gzhan du med de/ de yod pa de don snang gi shes pas myang bya rdzas gzhan 'gog pa'i rigs pas khegs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ don la rang gi ngo bo myong yang tha snyad du sngon po myong bar grags pa yin te/

khyod la snang ba'i sngon po'i rnam pa de tha snyad du sngon por gzhag pa'i phyir/ jiṃ/ sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ rig bya rig byed don gzhan med kyang rang gi ngo bo rig pa yin te/ rang nyid rig pa'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir/ dper na mar me gcig nyid la gsal bya gsal byed don gzhan med kyang*/ rang gsal du gzhag pa bzhin no// bzhi pa ni/ deṃ/ gal te sngor snang dbang shes kyi rig bya rig byed de don gzhan yod na sngon por snang ba'i rnam pa dang sngor snang dbang shes chos

(257) can/ myong bya myong byed min par thal/ don gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ riṃg sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ rig bya rig byed don gzhan med kyang rig bya rig byed tha dad du snang ba'i rgyu yod de/ gnyis snang gi bag chags kyi dbang gis de ltar snang ba'i phyir/ dper na skra shad 'dzag snang gi dbang shes bzhin/ lnga pa ni/ gaṃng*/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ tha snyad du gzugs 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag byas pa'i tshe/ don dam par gzugs 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag gang yin zhes brtsad par bya ba min te/ 'khrul ngor snang ba la tha snyad du gzugs 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag byas pa yin gyi don dam par gzugs 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag ma byas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ deṃs/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ dpyad na rang gi ngo bo rig pa 'bras bur grub ste/ tha snyad du sngon po rig pa gang zhig dpyad na rig bya don gzhan med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa snang ba phyi don yin pa bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ phyi don dngos su snang la sgrub byed med/ snang ba phyi don yin la gnod byed yod/ des na tshul gnyis sgo nas rang rig bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ gaṃl/ bye brag smra ba na re/ don snang gi shes pas rang dus su snang ba'i phyi don dngos su myong na khyod la nyes pa ci yod ce na/ sems tsam pa chos can/ don snang gi shes pas phyi don dngos su myong na khyod la nyes pa yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang rig 'bras bur 'chad pa ma yin te/ don snang gi shes pas rang dus su snang ba'i phyi don dngos su myong ba la sgrub byed med pa'i rgyu (258) mtshan gyis rang rig 'bras bur bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃl/ sgrub byed med pa ma grub ste/ don snang gi shes pa la don gyi rnam par snang ba'i phyir zhe na/ sngor snang dbang shes la sngon por snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ khyod phyi don dngos min te/

khyod phyi don dngos dang bag chags kyi dbang gis snang ba'i rnam pa gang yin zhes dpyad pa na phyi don dngos yin pa la rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir/ ci ltar gnod na/ mthoṃng*/ de chos can/ phyi don dngos min te/ sngor snang dbang shes dang lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir/ gal te 'bras bu dbang shes res 'ga' ldog pa'i rtags kyis rgyu phyi don yod par grub ce na/ 'diṃr/ bag chags brtan byung gi mer snang dbang shes chos can/ phyi don yod med kyis res 'ga' skye ba ma yin te/ bag chags sad byed kyi rkyen tshang ma tshang gis res 'ga' skye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ'i/ de chos can/ tha snyad du gzung bar snang ba dang 'dzin par snang ba'i tshul gnyis yod de/ tha snyad du gzugs 'dzin gnyis snang du rang rig mngon sum gyis myong ba dang*/ rjes kyi dran shes kyis dran pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi tshul gnyis las gzung ba'i rnam pa gzhal bya/ de yongs su dpyod par byed pa'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bur grub ste/ khyod tshul gnyis pa can gyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tha snyad don rig tshad 'bras bshad pa la gsum ste/ tshad 'bras dngos/ gzhal bya bsgrub/ 'bras bu bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ gang*/ bag chags brtan (259) byung gi sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ khyod la tha snyad du don rig 'bras bur grub ste/ khyod kyis shes pa rang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i rnam par 'dod mi 'dod du myong ba la tha snyad du phyi don 'dod mi 'dod myong ba 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃng*/ de chos can/ tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar gzhag tu rung ste/ shes pa rang nyid kyi gzung ba snang ba'i cha la tha snyad du phyi don du gzhag pa'i phyir te/ shes pa rang nyid kyi gzung ba snang ba'i cha la rjes kyi nges shes kyis phyi don du zhen pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gaṃl/ de chos can tha snyad du don rig 'bras bur grub ste/

shes pa rang nyid kyi gzung ba snang ba'i rnam pa rig pa la tha snyad du don rig pa 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phyi don yod kyang rang rig 'bras bur bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ rang rig 'bras bu yin par bsgrub/ gzung rnam tshad ma yin par bsgrub/ phyi don gzhal bya yin par bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ phyi don myong na ha cang thal/ de yi nyes spong rigs pas dgag des na rang rig 'bras bur bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ phyiṃ/ don snang gi mngon sum chos can/ tha snyad du phyi don yod na yang rang rig 'bras bur grub ste/ tha snyad du phyi don yod kyang rang la snang ba'i rnam pa 'dod mi 'dod du myong ba la tha snyad du phyi don 'dod mi 'dod du 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyis phyi don dngos su myong ba min par thal/ khyod kyis phyi don dngos su myong na don gcig nyid 'dod mi 'dod du mar thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ khaṃs/ don gcig nyid 'dod mi 'dod du (260) mar khas blangs pas skyon med do zhe na/ lha sbyin gyi gzugs la blta ba'i dgra gnyen gnyis kyi dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod gnyis kas lhas byin gyi gzugs de 'dod mi 'dod gnyis ka myong bar thal/ lhas byin gyi gzugs de 'dod mi 'dod gnyis ka yin pa gang zhig lhas byin gyi gzugs kyi gnas tshul mthong ba mtshungs pa'i phyir/ maṃ/ gal te ma mthong ba'i las kyis gang rung gcig bsgribs nas cig shos myong ngo zhe na/ de chos can/ lhas byin gyi gzugs gzung don yin pa'i dbang gis rtogs par mi 'gyur bar thal/ lhas byin gyi gzugs de 'dod mi 'dod gnyis ka yin pa gang zhig lhas byin gyi gzugs 'dod mi 'dod gang rung re re kho nar mthong ba'i phyir/ duṃ/ ma mthong ba'i las chos can/ don ci lta ba bzhin mthong bar byed pa'i rgyu min par thal/ gang zhig lhas byin gyi gzugs 'dod mi 'dod gang rung re re kho nar mthong bar byed pa'i phyir/

gaṃl/ gal te phyi rol gyi don 'dod mi 'dod du snang ba rtog pa yin gyi dbang shes min pas dbang shes kyis don ci lta ba bzhin 'dzin no zhe na/ deṃ/ dbang shes chos can/ khyod la tha snyad du don gcig nyid mdzes mi mdzes su snang ba yod par thal/ khyod la sngar don mdzes par snang ba de phyis 'chi ltas kyis zin pa'i tshe mi mdzes par snang ba yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ phyi rol don zhes pa'i ngag don dgod/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rnam pa gnyis la tshad ma yin min dbye/ gzung rnam tshad ma yin pa'i sgrub byed dgod/ tshad 'bras gnyis po yul gzhan 'gyur ba spong*/ don rig 'bras bur bshad dang (261) 'gal ba spong ba'o// dang po ni/ phyi don gzhal bya rang rig 'bras bu yin na 'dzin rnam tshad mar 'gyur ro zhe na/ deṃ'i/ phyi don lkog na mo'i tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar gzhag pa'i tshe chos can/ gzung rnam tshad ma yin te/ phyi don gzhal byar 'jog pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'dzin rnam tshad mar 'jog pa de phyi don gzhal byar 'jog pa la mi ltos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gaṃng*/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ don gyi rnam pa dngos su snang ba yin gyi don dngos su snang ba ma yin te/ rang dus su snang ba'i rnam pa gtsang mi gtsang du snang ba la tha snyad du phyi don gtsang mi gtsang du gzhag pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ tha snyad du dbang po'i mngon sum don dang 'dra ba bsgrub byed dang*/ dbang po'i mngon sum gyis tha snyad du don rig pa yin kyang dpyad na rang rig pa bsgrub bya yin te/ dbang po'i mngon sum la snang ba'i rnam pa gtsang mi gtsang du snang ba tha snyad du don gtsang mi gtsang du gzhag pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'o na tshad 'bras gnyis po yul tha dad du thal lo zhe na/ doṃn/ don snang gi shes pa'i tshad 'bras gnyis po chos can/ khyod yul gzhan ma yin te/ khyod dpyad na rang rig pa yin kyang tha snyad du don rig pa yin pa'i phyir te/

khyod la snang ba'i don gyi rnam pa de tha snyad du don dang dpyad na rang gi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ raṃng*/ 'o na sngar don rig 'bras bur bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ dpyad na rang rig 'bras bu yin pa dang*/ sngar don rig 'bras bur bshad pa dang mi (262) 'gal te/ sngar don rig 'bras bur bshad pa de tha snyad la dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ deṃ/ ci'i phyir phyi don gzhal byar 'jog ce na/ mdo sde pa ltar na don rig mngon sum chos can/ phyi don khyod kyi gzhal bya yin te/ phyi don de khyod la rang ngos nas rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ rnam rig pa ltar na bag chags brtan byung gi dbang shes chos can/ tha snyad du phyi don khyod kyi gzhal bya yin te/ tha snyad du phyi don de khyod kyi snang ba'i dmigs rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ jiṃ/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ rig pas dpyad pa'i tshe don mi 'dzin pa thal/ rig pas dpyad pa'i tshe don dngos su mi snang bar don gyi rnam par snang ba'i phyir/ dper na rmi lam la snang ba'i rta glang gi rnam pa bzhin no zhe na/ de lta bu'i thal 'gyur chos can/ chos grags la gnod byed kyi thal 'gyur yang dag min par thal/ chos grags kyis khyod la 'dod lan don mthun thebs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rnam pa rdzun yang rang rig 'bras bur bsgrub pa la gnyis te/ rnam pa rdzun pas de la rang rig min/ bdag nyid 'jal tshe rang rig tshad 'bras bsgrub pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ gzung 'dzin rig gsum med kyang 'khrul ngor snang*/ snang ba de la tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gzhag snang ba de nyid bden par grub pa dgag bden pa med na 'khrul pa'ang med pa spang pa'o// dang po ni/ kun btus su/ gang tshe snang ba de gzhal bya// tshad ma dang ni de yi 'bras// 'dzin rnam rig pa'o de yi phyir// de gsum tha dad du ma byas// zhes pa'i don 'grel te/

phyi don med na (263) tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi rnam gzhag ji ltar rung zhe na/ bloṃ/ bag chags brtan byung gi dbang shes chos can/ don la tshad 'bras gzhal gsum tha dad du med de/ khyod la gzung 'dzin rig gsum dbyer med kyang*/ 'khrul ngor gzung 'dzin rig gsum tha dad du snang ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ dpeṃr/ dper na sgyu ma'i sngags sman gyis bslad pa'i mig shes kyi ngor 'jim dum sogs rta glang du med kyang rta glang du snang ba bzhin no// gal te rta glang nyid du sngags sman gyi mthus gsar du skyes pa yin no zhe na/ deṃ/ 'jim dum sogs chos can/ rta glang sogs su gsar du skyes pa min te/ sngags sman gyis ma bslad pa'i mig shes kyis rta glang sogs su mthong ba med pa'i phyir/ dper na thag ring mya ngam gyi thang la rdzas chung ngu chen por ma skyes kyang chen por snang ba bzhin/ gnyis pa ni/ gzuṃng*/ bag chags brtan byung gi dbang shes chos can/ khyod la tha snyad du tshad 'bras gzhal gsum du 'jog pa mi 'gal te/ khyod la 'khrul ngor gzung 'dzin rig gsum tha dad du snang ba la tha snyad du tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi rnam gzhag byas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ phyogs chos bsgrub/ gtan tshigs dgod pa'o// dang po ni/ deṃ/ blo gcig la gzung 'dzin rig gsum tha dad du snang ba de snang ba ltar bden na/ khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo sna tshogs su snang ba de du mar bden nam/ gcig tu bden/ dang po ltar na khra 'dzin dbang shes chos can/ khyod la khra bo sna tshogs su snang ba de du mar (264) mi bden par thal/ de bden na khyod rdzas gcig yin pa nyams par thal ba'i phyir/ phyi ma ltar na khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo sna tshogs su snang ba chos can/ gcig tu mi bden par thal/ du mar snang ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzhan du na bde sdug sogs rdzas gzhan gyi sgrub byed med par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ rangaṃ*/

khra 'dzin dbang shes la khra bo sna tshogs su snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ gcig tu mi bden par thal/ gcig tu tshad mas mthong ba med par phyir/ khyab ste/ ldog khyab rtags/ gnyis pa ni/ gangaṃ*/ don snang gi shes pa la rang dus su snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ bden par med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang bden pa'i du ma gang rung du ma grub pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ choṃs/ gal te gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i shes pa la gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'khrul pa skye ba mi 'thad par thal/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'khrul pa'i rgyu gzung 'dzin bden pa ba dang*/ chos mthun mthong ba med pa'i phyir te/ gzung 'dzin bden pa ba med pa'i phyir/ snga ma la khyab pa yod de/ 'khrul pa skye ba na chos mthun mthong ba la ltos pa'i phyir zhe na/ nang*/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'khrul pa de gzung 'dzin bden pa ba'i chos mthun tshad mas mthong ba la ltos pa ma yin te/ khyod don snang snga ma'i bag chags kyi dbang gis rang bzhin gyis gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'khrul pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rab rib can la skra shad 'dzag par snang ba de chos mthun la mi ltos pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la gsum (265) ste/ 'dzin rnam bdag nyid myong ba rang rig grub/ rang rig tshad 'bras shes pa kun la sbyar/ rang rig tshad mar bshad dang 'gal ba spang ba'o// dang po ni/ 'o na rnam rdzun pa'i lugs la rang rig tshad 'bras ji lta bu zhe na/ deṃ/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod yongs su gcod par byed pa'i 'dzin rnam des bdag nyid rig pa yin te/ khyod rang yul yongs su gcod pa'i 'dzin rnam de'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin rnam chos can/ rang rig sgrub byed yin te/ rang rig mtshon par nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dpeṃr/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod gzhal bya/ khyod yongs su gcod par byed pa'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ khyod nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bur grub ste/

khyod shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rnam pa bden par 'dod pa'i lugs la'ang*/ 'dod chags gzhal byar gzhag pa'i tshe rang rig mtshan nyid pa'i tshad 'bras grub pa bzhin no// de nyid bsgrub pa ni/ deṃ/ chags sogs chos can/ rang nyid nyams su myong bar rung ste/ rang nyid myong ba'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir zhes 'dod pa ltar/ rnam rdzun pa'i lugs la'ang don snang gi shes pa chos can/ rang nyid nyams su myong bar rung bar byed pa nyid tshad ma dang*/ rang gzhal bya dang*/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bur grub ste/ rang nyid myong ba'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dzin pa'i rnam pa'am rang myong bar rung ba tshad ma yin na phyogs glang gis rang rig tshad mar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ bdaṃg phyogs glang (266) chos can/ 'dir 'dzin rnam dang nyams su myong ba nyid tshad mar bshad pa dang khyod kyis rang rig tshad mar bshad pa mi 'gal te/ khyod rang rig byed pa'i cha la dgongs nas tshad mar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam gzhag de'i sgrub byed bshad pa la gnyis te/ tshul gnyis sgrub byed rigs pa bshad/ rang rig sgrub byed rigs pa bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ yul shes de shes bshad de bsgrub/ dus phyis dran pa bshad de bsgrub pa'o// dang po la bdun te/ dogs pa yod med bye brag yod pas bsgrub/ rnam pa mang nyung bye brag yod pas bsgrub/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i rtags kyis bsgrub/ dbang po gsal dang mi gsal khyad las bsgrub/ med bzhin dkyil 'khor rnam par snang bas bsgrub/ nye ring bar ma'i khyad par gsum las bsgrub/ gzung yul 'gags kyang snang ba yod pas bsgrub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ don la don gyi rnam par skye bas bsgrub/ don med don gyi rnam par snang bas bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ mdor/ yul shes de yi shes pa yi// bye brag las ni tshul gnyis nyid// ces gsungs pa'i don la mdo mdzad pa rang nyid kyi rigs pa gnyis dang*/

bstan bcos mdzad pa'i rigs pa lnga ste bdun du yod pa las/ dang po ni/ yuṃl/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod kyi rkyen gsum ka khyod kyi rgyur mtshungs na yang khyod gzugs kyi rnam ldan du skye bar 'gyur te/ de ltar skye ba de rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dper na zas la sogs pa bu'i rgyu yin na'ang*/ bu tsha de pha ma gang rung gi gzugs

(267) dang 'dra bar skye ba bzhin no// deṃ/ gzugs chos can/ khyod dang rkyen gzhan gnyis gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyi rgyur mtshungs na yang khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum gyi yul du gzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum la rang ngos nas rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ don med phyir na rnam med dogs pa med/ don dang ldan par 'dod pa'i gzhan lan dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ doṃn/ gzung don can gyi shes pa chos can/ rang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i rnam pa med pa dogs pa skye srid de/ don nyid dngos su snang ba 'khrul pa'i phyir/ 'daṃs/ 'das pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ blo rang nyid tshul gnyis pa can du grub ste/ yul yul can gnyis su snang ba yod cing yul du snang ba rang nyid las gzhan pa'i don min pa'i phyir/ des na de chos can/ rang gi ngo bo rig pa grub ste/ rang nyid tshul gnyis pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la lnga ste/ rigs kyi don ldan yin pa dgag ldan pa min pa'i don ldan dgag de las gzhan pa'i don ldan dgag rnam pa don las skyes pa dgag rnam par shes las tha dad dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ sngoṃ/ 'das pa'i sngon po dran pa'i dran shes la snang ba de chos can/ sngon po'i rigs ma yin te/ sngo sogs tha dad pa can du snang ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang sngon po'i rigs de rtag pa yin nam/ mi rtag pa yin/ mi rtag pa yin na sngon po'i rigs de chos can/ rigs su mi 'gyur bar thal/ mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir// (268) rtag pa yin na sngon po'i rigs de chos can/ sngon po dran pa'i dran shes skyed byed min par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ miṃng*/ ming sogs chos can/ khyod dran shes kyi gzung don ma yin par thal/ khyod dran shes kyi gzhung don yin pa sngar ming sogs brjod na zhes pa'i skabs su bkag zin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ tshulaṃ/ dran shes chos can/ gzung don can ma yin te/ rang gi gzung don 'phen byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi byed pa'i phyir/ gal te dran shes don gyi rnam pa can yin yang de'i rgyu myong ba don gyi rnam pa can ma yin no zhe na/ sngon po dran pa'i dran shes chos can/ khyod don gyi rnam pa can min par thal/ khyod rang rgyu sngon po 'dzin pa'i mngon sum las byung ba gang zhig sngon po 'dzin pa'i mngon sum de don gyi rnam pas stong pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ gal te dran pa myong ba las byung ba min gyi dran bya'i don las dngos su skye'o zhe na/ deṃ/ sngon po dran pa'i dran shes chos can/ khyod sngon po las dngos su skyes pa min par thal/ sngon po de rang gi dngos rgyu'i dus su 'gags zin pa'i phyir/ don las skyes pa'i don gyi rnam pa dang ldan na/ sngo 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ don gyi rnam pa dang ldan par thal/ don las skyes pa'i phyir/ rnaṃm/ dran pa chos can/ khyod la snang ba'i don gyi rnam pa de don gyis dngos su gtad pa'i rnam pa ma yin te/ khyod rang yul mi gsal bar snang ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ rnaṃm/ dran shes la snang ba'i don gyi rnam pa chos can/ mthong rung gi yul la gnas pa'i gang zag gzhan gyis kyang mthong bar (269) thal/ shes pa las rdzas tha dad pa'i mthong rung gi don yin pa'i phyir/ bdaṃg don yin yang rang gi yul can gyi blo kho na la rtag tu yul du 'brel bas gzhan gyis mi rtogs so zhe na/ dran shes la snang ba'i rnam pa chos can/ dran pa pos brjod kyang gzhan gyis mi rtogs par thal/ dran pa po'i blo kho na'i yul du 'brel ba'i phyir/ deṃ/ gal te dran pa pos brjod pa'i tshe rang gi blo la snang ba kho na brjod cing*/ nyan pa pos rang gi blo la snang ba'i rnam pa kho na rtogs so zhe na/ 'chad pa po dang*/ nyan pa po'i blo gnyis chos can/

don gcig la mtshams sbyor bar mi 'gyur bar thal/ yul gzhan kho na la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gaṃl/ gal te blo'i yul gnyis po 'dra ba las gcig tu 'khrul ba yin no zhe na/ 'chad nyan byed pa'i blo gnyis po chos can/ gzung yul ji lta ba bzhin ma rtogs par thal/ 'dra ba las gcig tu 'khrul pa'i zhen blo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam pa mang nyung bye brag yod pas bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ shes pa dang po rnam pa gnyis par bstan/ phyi ma rnam pa re res lhag par bstan/ tshul des rnam bcas mi 'grub rnam pa dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ nyamaṃs/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod tshul gnyis pa can yin te/ khyod tshul gnyis pa can du rjes kyi dran shes kyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ldog khyab rtags/ gnyis pa ni/ 'diṃ/ gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod dang khyod la dmigs pa'i rtog pa sogs blo phyi ma phyi ma rnams rnam pa re res lhag pa yin te/ khyod (270) gzung rnam dang 'dzin rnam gyi tshul gnyis pa can dang*/ khyod la dmigs pa'i rtog pa de gzung rnam gyi tshul gnyis/ 'dzin rnam gyi tshul gcig ste tshul gsum pa can du rang rang gi shes pa phyi mas dmigs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la bzhi ste/ don 'bras yin pas bsre na ha cang thal/ don dang bsre ba 'dra ba las gzhan min/ 'dra ba'i phyir na don dang bsre ba bstan/ gzhan du phyi ma bsre ba med par thal ba'o// dang po ni/ doṃn/ don snang gi shes pa shes pa rang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i yul rnam yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rjes kyi shes pas yul gyi rnam pas khyad par du byas nas 'dzin pa ma yin gyi don gyi dngos 'bres yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes pa dran na don yang dran pa yin no zhe na/ dbang po'i mngon sum gyi rgyur gyur pa'i snang ba dang yid byed chos can/ dbang po'i mngon sum dran na khyod dran pas khyab par thal/

dbang po'i mngon sum de khyod kyi dngos 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ 'bras bu yin na rang rgyu dang lhan cig dran pas khyab par thal/ don snang gi shes pa don gyi dngos 'bras yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis don dang lhan cig dran pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rdza bum dran na rdza mkhan dran pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ don snang gi shes pa de la don gyis byas pa'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir na don dang lhan cig dran no zhe na/ khyadaṃ/ don snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod don dang lhan cig bsre ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i don gyis byas pa'i khyad par de don gyi rnam par shar ba las gzhan min par thal/ don gyi rnam par shar ba las ma gtogs pa'i khyod la don gyis byas pa'i (271) khyad par med pa'i phyir/ dper na 'dra ba las tshad ma gcig tu bsre ba'i rgyu mtshan med pa bzhin no// gsum pa ni/ daṃng*/ don snang gi shes pa tshul gnyis pa can min par 'dzin rnam rkyang pa can yin na don snang gi shes pa chos can/ khyod la dmigs pa'i shes pa phyi ma de 'dzin rnam rkyang pa can yin par thal/ khyod 'dzin rnam rkyang pa can yin pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod la dmigs pa'i shes pa phyi ma de khyod las rnam pa'i sgo nas khyad par du byed mi nus par thal/ khyod dang khyod la dmigs pa'i shes pa phyi ma gnyis ka 'dzin rnam rkyang pa can du mtshungs pa'i phyir/ deṃ/ sngor snang dbang shes chos can/ khyod rang dus su snang ba'i sngon po'i rnam pa dang ldan pa yin te/ khyod der rjes kyi dran shes kyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ gzhaṃn/ don snang gi shes pa don gyi rnam ldan yin pas don gyi rnam ldan du dran pa las gzhan don gyi dngos 'bras yin pas don gyi rnam ldan du dran na sngor snang dbang shes sngon po skad cig dang po chos can/ khyod kho na don gyi rnam ldan du dran gyi/
